				56 text #include <algorithm>

namespace batch_max_sum {
constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_ROWS = 32;
constexpr uint32_t DEFAULT_COLS = 128;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BALANCED_ROWS = 128;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BALANCED_COLS = 512;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_ROWS = 128;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_COLS = 256;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_REDUCE_COLS = 128;
constexpr uint32_t MIN_N_PARTS = 4;
constexpr uint32_t SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT = 64;
constexpr uint32_t SMALL_VECTOR_OUTPUT_LIMIT = 16;
constexpr uint32_t SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS = SMALL_VECTOR_OUTPUT_LIMIT * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT;
constexpr uint32_t SMALL_BATCH_LIMIT = 4;
constexpr uint32_t SMALL_BATCH_M_LIMIT = 8;
constexpr uint32_t SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT = 16;
constexpr uint32_t SMALL_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS = SMALL_BATCH_M_LIMIT * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT;
constexpr uint32_t SMALL_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS = SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT;
constexpr uint32_t SMALL_BATCH_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS =
    SMALL_BATCH_M_LIMIT * SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_LIMIT = 8;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT = 16;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_N_LIMIT = 32;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT = 128;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE = 16;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE = 64;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_ROW_TILE = 4;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS = MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS = MEDIUM_BATCH_N_LIMIT * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS =
    MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_DOT_ELEMENTS = MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE;
constexpr uint32_t MEDIUM_BATCH_OUTPUT_STRIDE = 8;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_LIMIT = 16;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_M_LIMIT = 32;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_N_LIMIT = 128;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_K_LIMIT = 256;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE = 8;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE = 16;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE = 64;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS = LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE * LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS = LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE * LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS =
    LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE * LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE * LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_DOT_ELEMENTS = LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE * LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE;
constexpr uint32_t LARGE_BATCH_M_TILES = LARGE_BATCH_M_LIMIT / LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE;
// 每个任务独占一个 64 字节槽，避免不同核写同一缓存行。
constexpr uint32_t PARTIAL_STRIDE = 16;

enum class ShapeKey : uint32_t {
    DEFAULT,
    COMPACT_16,
    COMPACT_32,
    LARGE_BALANCED,
    LARGE_TALL,
    SPLIT_K,
    TALL_NARROW,
    WIDE_SHALLOW,
};

struct Parameters {
    uint32_t batch;
    uint32_t m;
    uint32_t n;
    uint32_t k;
    uint32_t rowTiles;
    uint32_t tileRows;
    uint32_t tileCols;
    uint32_t cores;
    AscendC::tiling::TCubeTiling cube;
};

// 冷路径单独下发调度参数，保持热路径Parameters的布局与入口不变。
struct GenericParameters {
    Parameters base;
    uint32_t splitN;
    uint32_t directOutput;
    uint32_t parts;
    uint32_t partialStride;
};

// 单点积的Max和Sum均为恒等操作，用纯Vector消除Cube/KFC固定开销。
template <typename T>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeDot(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR y, uint32_t k)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_AIV_ONLY);
    using namespace AscendC;
    TPipe pipe;
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> convertedBuffer;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1, 2 * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT * sizeof(T));
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 32);
    pipe.InitBuffer(convertedBuffer, 2 * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT * sizeof(float));

    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1));
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
    auto input = inputQueue.AllocTensor<T>();
    DataCopyExtParams inputCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(input, a, inputCopy, padding);
    DataCopyPad(input[SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT], b, inputCopy, padding);
    inputQueue.EnQue(input);
    input = inputQueue.DeQue<T>();

    auto aFloat = convertedBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto bFloat = aFloat[SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT];
    // 两个输入槽分别以128字节间隔存放half、256字节间隔存放float。
    // 用两个repeat合并Cast发射，每次仅转换有效的k个元素，不读槽内空隙。
    UnaryRepeatParams castRepeats{1, 1, 8, 4};
    Cast(aFloat, input, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, static_cast<uint64_t>(k),
        static_cast<uint8_t>(2), castRepeats);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    Mul(aFloat, aFloat, bFloat, k);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    // 单点积路径的 K 不超过 64，FP32 一次 repeat 即可完成全部归约。
    WholeReduceSum(result, aFloat, static_cast<int32_t>(k), 1, 1, 1, 8);
    inputQueue.FreeTensor(input);
    outputQueue.EnQue(result);
    result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
    DataCopyExtParams outputCopy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(output, result, outputCopy);
    outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
}

// 单个FP32 Vector repeat可容纳的点积：静态UB容量64，实际K运行时传入。
template <typename T>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeSingleDot(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR y, uint32_t k)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_AIV_ONLY);
    using namespace AscendC;
    // 四核启动，仅核0执行完整点积并写出，其他核不访问输入输出。
    if (GetBlockIdx() != 0) {
        return;
    }
    constexpr uint32_t CAPACITY = SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT;
    const uint32_t alignedK = (k + 15) / 16 * 16;
    // 单任务固定UB布局，保留必要硬件状态设置，省去TPipe资源登记。
    SetAtomicNone();
    SetMaskNorm();
    ResetMask();
    constexpr uint32_t inputBufferOffset = 0;
    constexpr uint32_t inputBufferBytes = 2 * CAPACITY * sizeof(T);
    constexpr uint32_t convertedBufferOffset = (inputBufferOffset + inputBufferBytes + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t convertedBufferBytes = 2 * CAPACITY * sizeof(float);
    constexpr uint32_t outputBufferOffset = (convertedBufferOffset + convertedBufferBytes + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t outputBufferBytes = 32;
    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1));
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
    auto input = LocalTensor<T>(TPosition::VECCALC, inputBufferOffset, inputBufferBytes / sizeof(T));
    auto aFloat = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, convertedBufferOffset, convertedBufferBytes / sizeof(float));
    auto bFloat = aFloat[alignedK];
    auto result = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, outputBufferOffset, outputBufferBytes / sizeof(float));
    DataCopyExtParams inputCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPadExtParams<T> noPadding{false, 0, 0, 0};
    // 仅在两个完整输入区间紧邻时合并搬运，不读取间隙或扩大输入范围。
    const uintptr_t aAddress = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(x1);
    const uintptr_t bAddress = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(x2);
    const uint32_t bytesPerInput = k * sizeof(T);
    if (k == alignedK && bAddress == aAddress + bytesPerInput) {
        DataCopyExtParams contiguousCopy{1, 2 * bytesPerInput, 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPad(input, a, contiguousCopy, noPadding);
    } else if (k == alignedK && aAddress == bAddress + bytesPerInput) {
        // 单点积交换两个乘数不改变FP32乘法与归约语义。
        DataCopyExtParams contiguousCopy{1, 2 * bytesPerInput, 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPad(input, b, contiguousCopy, noPadding);
    } else {
        DataCopyPad(input, a, inputCopy, noPadding);
        DataCopyPad(input[alignedK], b, inputCopy, noPadding);
    }
    SetFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_V>(EVENT_ID0);
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_V>(EVENT_ID0);
    Cast(aFloat, input, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, 2 * alignedK);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    Mul(aFloat, aFloat, bFloat, k);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    WholeReduceSum(result, aFloat, static_cast<int32_t>(k), 1, 1, 1, 4);
    SetFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    DataCopyExtParams outputCopy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(output, result, outputCopy);
}

// NT批量小矩阵：完整K驻留L0，NZ结果分组Max后求和。
// 仅使用基础API，flag8遵循官方CrossCoreSetFlag的AIC->AIV示例，不与Matmul高阶API混用。
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeBatchResidentNT(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch, GM_ADDR y, uint32_t M, uint32_t N, uint32_t K)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    constexpr uint32_t PAD_M = 32;
    const uint32_t PAD_N = (N + 15) / 16 * 16;
    const uint32_t batch = GetBlockIdx();
    TPipe pipe;
    GlobalTensor<float> matrix;
    matrix.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch) + batch * PAD_M * PAD_N);
    if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
        TQue<TPosition::A1, 1> a1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B1, 1> b1Queue, bTailQueue;
        TQue<TPosition::A2, 1> a2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B2, 1> b2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::CO1, 1> c1Queue;
        pipe.InitBuffer(a1Queue, 1, PAD_M * K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b1Queue, 1, 32 * K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(bTailQueue, 1, (PAD_N - 32) * K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(a2Queue, 1, PAD_M * K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b2Queue, 1, PAD_N * K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(c1Queue, 1, PAD_M * PAD_N * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<bfloat16_t> a, b;
        a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(x1) + batch * M * K);
        b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(x2) + batch * N * K);
        auto a1 = a1Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
        auto b1 = b1Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
        auto bTail = bTailQueue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
        Nd2NzParams copyA{};
        copyA.ndNum = 1;
        copyA.nValue = M;
        copyA.dValue = K;
        copyA.srcDValue = K;
        copyA.dstNzC0Stride = PAD_M;
        copyA.dstNzNStride = 1;
        Nd2NzParams copyB = copyA;
        copyB.nValue = 32;
        copyB.dstNzC0Stride = 32;
        Nd2NzParams copyTail = copyB;
        copyTail.nValue = N - 32;
        copyTail.dstNzC0Stride = PAD_N - 32;
        DataCopy(a1, a, copyA);
        a1Queue.EnQue(a1);
        DataCopy(b1, b, copyB);
        b1Queue.EnQue(b1);
        DataCopy(bTail, b[32 * K], copyTail);
        bTailQueue.EnQue(bTail);
        a1 = a1Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
        auto a2 = a2Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
        auto b2 = b2Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
        LoadData2DParams loadA{};
        loadA.repeatTimes = K / 16;
        loadA.srcStride = PAD_M / 16;
        loadA.ifTranspose = false;
        for (uint32_t rowBlock = 0; rowBlock < PAD_M / 16; ++rowBlock) {
            LoadData(a2[rowBlock * K * 16], a1[rowBlock * 256], loadA);
        }
        LoadData2DParams loadB{};
        loadB.repeatTimes = K / 16;
        loadB.srcStride = 2;
        loadB.dstGap = PAD_N / 16 - 1;
        loadB.ifTranspose = false;
        b1 = b1Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
        for (uint32_t col = 0; col < 2; ++col) {
            LoadData(b2[col * 256], b1[col * 256], loadB);
        }
        bTail = bTailQueue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
        loadB.srcStride = (PAD_N - 32) / 16;
        for (uint32_t col = 0; col < (PAD_N - 32) / 16; ++col) {
            LoadData(b2[(col + 2) * 256], bTail[col * 256], loadB);
        }
        a2Queue.EnQue(a2);
        b2Queue.EnQue(b2);
        a1Queue.FreeTensor(a1);
        b1Queue.FreeTensor(b1);
        bTailQueue.FreeTensor(bTail);
        a2 = a2Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
        b2 = b2Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
        auto c1 = c1Queue.AllocTensor<float>();
        MmadParams multiply{};
        multiply.m = PAD_M;
        multiply.n = N;
        multiply.k = K;
        multiply.cmatrixInitVal = true;
        Mmad(c1, a2, b2, multiply);
        a2Queue.FreeTensor(a2);
        b2Queue.FreeTensor(b2);
        c1Queue.EnQue(c1);
        c1 = c1Queue.DeQue<float>();
        FixpipeParamsV220 copyC{};
        copyC.nSize = PAD_N;
        copyC.mSize = M;
        copyC.srcStride = PAD_M;
        copyC.dstStride = M * 16 * sizeof(float) / 32;
        copyC.ndNum = 1;
        copyC.quantPre = QuantMode_t::NoQuant;
        Fixpipe<float, float, CFG_NZ>(matrix, c1, copyC);
        CrossCoreSetFlag<0x2, PIPE_FIX>(0x8);
        c1Queue.FreeTensor(c1);
    }
    if ASCEND_IS_AIV {
        TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
        TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
        TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> firstBuffer, secondBuffer;
        pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1, M * PAD_N * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 32);
        pipe.InitBuffer(firstBuffer, PAD_M * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(secondBuffer, PAD_M * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<float> output;
        output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
        CrossCoreWaitFlag(0x8);
        auto input = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        DataCopy(input, matrix, M * PAD_N);
        inputQueue.EnQue(input);
        input = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        auto first = firstBuffer.Get<float>();
        auto second = secondBuffer.Get<float>();
        // NZ每个N16块分两组8列；mask只覆盖实际N，忽略尾块填充。
        const uint32_t firstCount = (N / 16) * 8 + (N % 16 < 8 ? N % 16 : 8);
        const uint32_t secondCount = (N / 16) * 8 + (N % 16 > 8 ? N % 16 - 8 : 0);
        WholeReduceMax(first, input, firstCount, M, 1, M * 2, 2, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
        WholeReduceMax(second, input[8], secondCount, M, 1, M * 2, 2, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Max(first, first, second, M);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        WholeReduceSum(result, first, M, 1, 1, 1, 4);
        inputQueue.FreeTensor(input);
        outputQueue.EnQue(result);
        result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        DataCopyExtParams copy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPad(output[batch], result, copy);
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
    }
}

// TN批量小矩阵：完整K驻留L0，ND结果折叠到64列后归约。
// 仅使用基础API，flag8遵循官方CrossCoreSetFlag的AIC->AIV示例，不与Matmul高阶API混用。
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeBatchResidentTN(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch, GM_ADDR y, uint32_t M, uint32_t N, uint32_t K)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    constexpr uint32_t PAD_M = 32;
    const uint32_t PAD_N = (N + 15) / 16 * 16;
    const uint32_t batch = GetBlockIdx();
    TPipe pipe;
    GlobalTensor<float> matrix;
    matrix.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch) + batch * PAD_M * PAD_N);
    if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
        TQue<TPosition::A1, 1> a1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B1, 1> b1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::A2, 1> a2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B2, 1> b2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::CO1, 1> c1Queue;
        pipe.InitBuffer(a1Queue, 1, PAD_M * K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b1Queue, 1, PAD_N * K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(a2Queue, 1, PAD_M * K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b2Queue, 1, PAD_N * K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(c1Queue, 1, PAD_M * PAD_N * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<half> a, b;
        a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ half*>(x1) + batch * M * K);
        b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ half*>(x2) + batch * N * K);
        auto a1 = a1Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
        auto b1 = b1Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
        Nd2NzParams copyA{};
        copyA.ndNum = 1;
        copyA.nValue = K;
        copyA.dValue = M;
        copyA.srcDValue = M;
        copyA.dstNzC0Stride = K;
        copyA.dstNzNStride = 1;
        Nd2NzParams copyB = copyA;
        copyB.nValue = K;
        copyB.dValue = N;
        copyB.srcDValue = N;
        copyB.dstNzC0Stride = K;
        DataCopy(a1, a, copyA);
        DataCopy(b1, b, copyB);
        a1Queue.EnQue(a1);
        b1Queue.EnQue(b1);
        a1 = a1Queue.DeQue<half>();
        b1 = b1Queue.DeQue<half>();
        auto a2 = a2Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
        auto b2 = b2Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
        LoadData2DParams loadA{};
        loadA.repeatTimes = K / 16;
        loadA.srcStride = 1;
        loadA.ifTranspose = true;
        for (uint32_t rowBlock = 0; rowBlock < PAD_M / 16; ++rowBlock) {
            LoadData(a2[rowBlock * K * 16], a1[rowBlock * K * 16], loadA);
        }
        LoadData2DParams loadB{};
        loadB.repeatTimes = PAD_N / 16;
        loadB.srcStride = K / 16;
        loadB.ifTranspose = true;
        for (uint32_t kBlock = 0; kBlock < K / 16; ++kBlock) {
            LoadData(b2[kBlock * PAD_N * 16], b1[kBlock * 256], loadB);
        }
        a2Queue.EnQue(a2);
        b2Queue.EnQue(b2);
        a1Queue.FreeTensor(a1);
        b1Queue.FreeTensor(b1);
        a2 = a2Queue.DeQue<half>();
        b2 = b2Queue.DeQue<half>();
        auto c1 = c1Queue.AllocTensor<float>();
        MmadParams multiply{};
        multiply.m = PAD_M;
        multiply.n = N;
        multiply.k = K;
        multiply.cmatrixInitVal = true;
        Mmad(c1, a2, b2, multiply);
        a2Queue.FreeTensor(a2);
        b2Queue.FreeTensor(b2);
        c1Queue.EnQue(c1);
        c1 = c1Queue.DeQue<float>();
        FixpipeParamsV220 copyC{};
        copyC.nSize = N;
        copyC.mSize = M;
        copyC.srcStride = PAD_M;
        copyC.dstStride = PAD_N;
        copyC.ndNum = 1;
        copyC.quantPre = QuantMode_t::NoQuant;
        Fixpipe(matrix, c1, copyC);
        CrossCoreSetFlag<0x2, PIPE_FIX>(0x8);
        c1Queue.FreeTensor(c1);
    }
    if ASCEND_IS_AIV {
        TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
        TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
        TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> firstBuffer, secondBuffer;
        pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1, M * PAD_N * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 32);
        pipe.InitBuffer(firstBuffer, PAD_M * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(secondBuffer, PAD_M * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<float> output;
        output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
        CrossCoreWaitFlag(0x8);
        auto input = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        DataCopy(input, matrix, M * PAD_N);
        inputQueue.EnQue(input);
        input = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        auto first = firstBuffer.Get<float>();
        auto second = secondBuffer.Get<float>();
        // 先把超过64列的尾段折叠到前段，再仅做一次水平Max。
        const uint8_t rowStride = static_cast<uint8_t>(PAD_N / 8);
        BinaryRepeatParams foldRepeat{1, 1, 1, rowStride, rowStride, rowStride};
        if (N > 64) {
            Max(input, input, input[64], N - 64, M, foldRepeat);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }
        WholeReduceMax(first, input, N < 64 ? N : 64, M, 1, 1, PAD_N / 8,
            ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        WholeReduceSum(result, first, M, 1, 1, 1, 4);
        inputQueue.FreeTensor(input);
        outputQueue.EnQue(result);
        result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        DataCopyExtParams copy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPad(output[batch], result, copy);
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
    }
}

// 紧凑矩阵的基础Cube与Vector融合；输入M/N/K采用运行时尺寸。
template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B, uint32_t PAD_N>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeSmallManualCube(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch,
    GM_ADDR y, uint32_t m, uint32_t n, uint32_t K)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    constexpr uint32_t PAD_M = 16;
    const uint32_t batch = GetBlockIdx();
    InitSocState();
    GlobalTensor<float> matrix;
    matrix.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch) + batch * PAD_M * PAD_N);
    if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
        // L1的A/B分区不重叠；L0A/L0B/L0C各用独立地址空间。
        auto a1 = LocalTensor<T>(TPosition::A1, 0, PAD_M * K);
        auto b1 = LocalTensor<T>(TPosition::B1, PAD_M * K * sizeof(T), PAD_N * K);
        auto a2 = LocalTensor<T>(TPosition::A2, 0, PAD_M * K);
        auto b2 = LocalTensor<T>(TPosition::B2, 0, PAD_N * K);
        auto c1 = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::CO1, 0, PAD_M * PAD_N);
        GlobalTensor<T> a, b;
        a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1) + batch * m * K);
        b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2) + batch * n * K);
        Nd2NzParams copyA{};
        copyA.ndNum = 1;
        copyA.nValue = TRANS_A ? K : m;
        copyA.dValue = TRANS_A ? m : K;
        copyA.srcDValue = TRANS_A ? m : K;
        copyA.dstNzC0Stride = TRANS_A ? K : PAD_M;
        copyA.dstNzNStride = 1;
        Nd2NzParams copyB{};
        copyB.ndNum = 1;
        copyB.nValue = TRANS_B ? n : K;
        copyB.dValue = TRANS_B ? K : n;
        copyB.srcDValue = TRANS_B ? K : n;
        copyB.dstNzC0Stride = TRANS_B ? PAD_N : K;
        copyB.dstNzNStride = 1;
        DataCopy(a1, a, copyA);
        DataCopy(b1, b, copyB);
        SetFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_MTE1>(EVENT_ID0);
        WaitFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_MTE1>(EVENT_ID0);
        LoadData2DParams loadA{};
        loadA.repeatTimes = K / 16;
        loadA.srcStride = 1;
        loadA.ifTranspose = TRANS_A;
        LoadData(a2, a1, loadA);
        LoadData2DParams loadB{};
        if constexpr (TRANS_B) {
            loadB.repeatTimes = (K / 16) * (PAD_N / 16);
            loadB.srcStride = 1;
            loadB.ifTranspose = false;
            LoadData(b2, b1, loadB);
        } else {
            loadB.repeatTimes = PAD_N / 16;
            loadB.srcStride = K / 16;
            loadB.ifTranspose = true;
            for (uint32_t kBlock = 0; kBlock < K / 16; ++kBlock) {
                LoadData(b2[kBlock * PAD_N * 16], b1[kBlock * 256], loadB);
            }
        }
        SetFlag<HardEvent::MTE1_M>(EVENT_ID0);
        WaitFlag<HardEvent::MTE1_M>(EVENT_ID0);
        MmadParams multiply{};
        // 保持L0A的16行NZ布局，避免M=1切换为GEMV的ND布局。
        multiply.m = PAD_M;
        multiply.n = PAD_N;
        multiply.k = K;
        multiply.cmatrixInitVal = true;
        Mmad(c1, a2, b2, multiply);
        SetFlag<HardEvent::M_FIX>(EVENT_ID0);
        WaitFlag<HardEvent::M_FIX>(EVENT_ID0);
        FixpipeParamsV220 copyC{};
        copyC.nSize = n;
        copyC.mSize = m;
        copyC.srcStride = PAD_M;
        copyC.dstStride = PAD_N;
        copyC.ndNum = 1;
        copyC.quantPre = QuantMode_t::NoQuant;
        Fixpipe(matrix, c1, copyC);
        CrossCoreSetFlag<0x2, PIPE_FIX>(0x8);
    }
    if ASCEND_IS_AIV {
        constexpr uint32_t matrixBytes = PAD_M * PAD_N * sizeof(float);
        auto input = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, 0, PAD_M * PAD_N);
        auto result = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, matrixBytes, 8);
        auto maxima = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, matrixBytes + 32, PAD_M);
        GlobalTensor<float> output;
        output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
        CrossCoreWaitFlag(0x8);
        DataCopy(input, matrix, m * PAD_N);
        SetFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_V>(EVENT_ID0);
        WaitFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_V>(EVENT_ID0);
        WholeReduceMax(maxima, input, n, m, 1, 1, PAD_N / 8, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        WholeReduceSum(result, maxima, m, 1, 1, 1, 2);
        SetFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
        WaitFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
        DataCopyExtParams copy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPad(output[batch], result, copy);
    }    // 对应原TPipe析构的流水线收尾，确保写回完成且不遗留未消费事件。
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL>();
}

// 小输出矩阵先把转置方向打包为连续K向量，再以FP32 Vector点积完成Max-Sum。
template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputePackedCastGather(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR y,
    uint32_t runtimeM, uint32_t runtimeN, uint32_t runtimeK)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_AIV_ONLY);
    using namespace AscendC;
    // 四核启动，仅核0读取输入、完成全部计算并写出结果。
    if (GetBlockIdx() != 0) {
        return;
    }
    const uint32_t m = runtimeM;
    const uint32_t n = runtimeN;
    const uint32_t k = runtimeK;
    static_assert(TRANS_A && !TRANS_B, "compact Cast-Gather requires TN layout");
    SetAtomicNone();
    SetMaskNorm();
    ResetMask();
    constexpr uint32_t outputEnd = 2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(T) + 32;
    constexpr uint32_t rawConvertedBufferOffset = (outputEnd + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t offsetBufferOffset = (rawConvertedBufferOffset + (2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t convertedBufferOffset = (offsetBufferOffset + (2 * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT * sizeof(uint32_t)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t productBufferOffset = (convertedBufferOffset + (2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t dotBufferOffset = (productBufferOffset + (SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t maximumBufferOffset = (dotBufferOffset + (SMALL_VECTOR_OUTPUT_LIMIT * 8 * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;

    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1));
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));

    auto input = LocalTensor<T>(TPosition::VECCALC, 0, 2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS);
    // 两段输入在UB中以32字节对齐存放；对齐间隙不参与有效计算。
    const uint32_t inputBOffset = (m * k + 15) / 16 * 16;
    DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams aCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(m * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams bCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(n * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(input, a, aCopy, padding);
    DataCopyPad(input[inputBOffset], b, bCopy, padding);
    SetFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_V>(EVENT_ID0);
    auto aOffsets = LocalTensor<int32_t>(TPosition::VECCALC, offsetBufferOffset, (2 * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT * sizeof(uint32_t)) / sizeof(int32_t));
    auto bOffsets = aOffsets[SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT];
    // 容量域K>=32：显式建立首个8元素索引块，并使用公开事件API同步。
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < 8; ++index) {
        aOffsets.SetValue(index, static_cast<int32_t>(index));
    }
    SetFlag<HardEvent::S_V>(EVENT_ID0);
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::S_V>(EVENT_ID0);
    for (uint32_t offset = 8; offset < k; offset += 8) {
        Adds(aOffsets[offset], aOffsets[offset - 8], static_cast<int32_t>(8),
            k - offset < 8 ? k - offset : 8);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    Muls(bOffsets, aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(n * sizeof(float)), k);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    Muls(aOffsets, aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(m * sizeof(float)), k);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_V>(EVENT_ID0);

    // 紧凑输入先连续转为FP32，再按原64元素行槽重排。
    auto rawA = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, rawConvertedBufferOffset, (2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    auto rawB = rawA[inputBOffset];
    // 一次连续Cast处理两段输入；对齐间隙不参与Gather和点积。
    Cast(rawA, input, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, inputBOffset + n * k);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    auto packedA = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, convertedBufferOffset, (2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    auto packedB = packedA[SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS];
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        auto gatherOffsets = aOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
        #pragma unroll
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < m; ++row) {
            Gather(packedA[row * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT], rawA, gatherOffsets,
                row * sizeof(float), k);
        }
    }
    if constexpr (!TRANS_B) {
        auto gatherOffsets = bOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
        for (uint32_t col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
            Gather(packedB[col * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT], rawB, gatherOffsets,
                col * sizeof(float), k);
        }
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto aFloat = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, convertedBufferOffset, (2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    auto bFloat = aFloat[SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS];
    // Gather已经写入FP32行槽，直接沿用原乘法和归约布局。

    auto products = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, productBufferOffset, (SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    auto dots = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, dotBufferOffset, (SMALL_VECTOR_OUTPUT_LIMIT * 8 * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    BinaryRepeatParams multiplyRepeats{1, 1, 1, 8, 0, 8};
    #pragma unroll
    for (uint32_t row = 0; row < m; ++row) {
        auto aVector = aFloat[row * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT];
        Mul(products[row * n * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT], aVector, bFloat,
            static_cast<uint64_t>(k), static_cast<uint8_t>(n), multiplyRepeats);
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    WholeReduceSum(dots, products, static_cast<int32_t>(k),
        static_cast<int32_t>(m * n), 8, 1, 8);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    auto maxima = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, maximumBufferOffset, (64) / sizeof(float));
    uint64_t maximumMask[2] = {0, 0};
    for (uint32_t col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
        maximumMask[col / 8] |= uint64_t{1} << ((col % 8) * 8);
    }
    // FP32单次repeat只有64个元素，间隔8存放时最多覆盖8列点积。
    const uint64_t tailMask = maximumMask[1];
    maximumMask[1] = 0;
    WholeReduceMax(maxima, dots, maximumMask, static_cast<int32_t>(m),
        1, 1, static_cast<int32_t>(n), ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    if (n > 8) {
        // m*n<=16保证此时m=1，maxima的后8个元素可用作尾段临时区。
        maximumMask[0] = tailMask;
        WholeReduceMax(maxima[8], dots[64], maximumMask, static_cast<int32_t>(m),
            1, 1, static_cast<int32_t>(n), ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Max(maxima, maxima, maxima[8], m);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    }
    auto result = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, 2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(T), 8);
    WholeReduceSum(result, maxima, static_cast<int32_t>(m), 1, 1, 1, 1);
    SetFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    DataCopyExtParams outputCopy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(output, result, outputCopy);
}

template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputePackedDots(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR y,
    uint32_t m, uint32_t n, uint32_t k)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_AIV_ONLY);
    using namespace AscendC;
    TPipe pipe;
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> packedBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> offsetBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> convertedBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> productBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> dotBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximumBuffer;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1, 2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(T));
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 32);
    pipe.InitBuffer(packedBuffer, 2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(T));
    pipe.InitBuffer(offsetBuffer, 2 * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT * sizeof(uint32_t));
    pipe.InitBuffer(convertedBuffer, 2 * SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(productBuffer, SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(dotBuffer, SMALL_VECTOR_OUTPUT_LIMIT * 8 * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(maximumBuffer, 64);

    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1));
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));

    auto input = inputQueue.AllocTensor<T>();
    DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams aCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(m * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams bCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(n * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    // 连续 K 向量在搬入 UB 时按 64 元素分槽，保证每一行 Cast 的源地址对齐。
    // GM 行距仍为实际 K；转置布局继续保留紧凑输入供 Gather 重排。
    const uint32_t alignedK = (k + 15) / 16 * 16;
    const uint32_t gapBlocks = (SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT - alignedK) / 16;
    if constexpr (!TRANS_A) {
        aCopy = {static_cast<uint16_t>(m), static_cast<uint32_t>(k * sizeof(T)),
            0, gapBlocks, 0};
    }
    if constexpr (TRANS_B) {
        bCopy = {static_cast<uint16_t>(n), static_cast<uint32_t>(k * sizeof(T)),
            0, gapBlocks, 0};
    }
    DataCopyPad(input, a, aCopy, padding);
    DataCopyPad(input[SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS], b, bCopy, padding);
    inputQueue.EnQue(input);
    auto aOffsets = offsetBuffer.Get<int32_t>();
    auto bOffsets = aOffsets[SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT];
    if constexpr (TRANS_A && !TRANS_B) {
        CreateVecIndex(aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Muls(bOffsets, aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(n * sizeof(T)), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Muls(aOffsets, aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(m * sizeof(T)), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    } else {
        if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
            CreateVecIndex(aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), k);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            Muls(aOffsets, aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(m * sizeof(T)), k);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }
        if constexpr (!TRANS_B) {
            CreateVecIndex(bOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), k);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            Muls(bOffsets, bOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(n * sizeof(T)), k);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }
    }
    input = inputQueue.DeQue<T>();

    auto rawA = input;
    auto rawB = input[SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS];
    auto packedA = packedBuffer.Get<T>();
    auto packedB = packedA[SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS];
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        auto gatherOffsets = aOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < m; ++row) {
            Gather(packedA[row * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT], rawA, gatherOffsets,
                row * sizeof(T), k);
        }
    }
    if constexpr (!TRANS_B) {
        auto gatherOffsets = bOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
        for (uint32_t col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
            Gather(packedB[col * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT], rawB, gatherOffsets,
                col * sizeof(T), k);
        }
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto aFloat = convertedBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto bFloat = aFloat[SMALL_VECTOR_MATRIX_ELEMENTS];
    // 保持每个输入向量的64元素对齐槽，只合并Cast发射；不改成实际K紧凑排布。
    UnaryRepeatParams castRepeats{1, 1, 8, 4};
    auto aSource = TRANS_A ? packedA : rawA;
    auto bSource = TRANS_B ? rawB : packedB;
    Cast(aFloat, aSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, static_cast<uint64_t>(k),
        static_cast<uint8_t>(m), castRepeats);
    Cast(bFloat, bSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, static_cast<uint64_t>(k),
        static_cast<uint8_t>(n), castRepeats);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto products = productBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto dots = dotBuffer.Get<float>();
    BinaryRepeatParams multiplyRepeats{1, 1, 1, 8, 0, 8};
    for (uint32_t row = 0; row < m; ++row) {
        auto aVector = aFloat[row * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT];
        Mul(products[row * n * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT], aVector, bFloat,
            static_cast<uint64_t>(k), static_cast<uint8_t>(n), multiplyRepeats);
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    for (uint32_t row = 0; row < m; ++row) {
        WholeReduceSum(dots[row * 8], products[row * n * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT],
            static_cast<int32_t>(k), static_cast<int32_t>(n), 1, 1, 8);
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    auto maxima = maximumBuffer.Get<float>();
    WholeReduceMax(maxima, dots, static_cast<int32_t>(n), static_cast<int32_t>(m),
        1, 1, 1, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    inputQueue.FreeTensor(input);
    auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    WholeReduceSum(result, maxima, static_cast<int32_t>(m), 1, 1, 1, 1);
    outputQueue.EnQue(result);
    result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
    DataCopyExtParams outputCopy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(output, result, outputCopy);
    outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
}

// 小批量短矩阵按batch分核；点积、行最大值和最终求和均在Vector流水中完成。
template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B, bool COMPACT_K>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeSmallBatchDots(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR y,
    uint32_t m, uint32_t n, uint32_t k)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_AIV_ONLY);
    using namespace AscendC;
    SetAtomicNone();
    SetMaskNorm();
    ResetMask();
    constexpr uint32_t inputQueueOffset = 0;
    constexpr uint32_t outputQueueOffset = (inputQueueOffset + ((SMALL_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + SMALL_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t packedBufferOffset = (outputQueueOffset + (32) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t offsetBufferOffset = (packedBufferOffset + ((SMALL_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + SMALL_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t convertedBufferOffset = (offsetBufferOffset + (2 * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT * sizeof(uint32_t)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t productBufferOffset = (convertedBufferOffset + ((SMALL_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + SMALL_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t dotBufferOffset = (productBufferOffset + (SMALL_BATCH_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t maximumBufferOffset = (dotBufferOffset + (SMALL_BATCH_M_LIMIT * SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;

    const uint32_t batch = GetBlockIdx();
    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * m * k);
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * n * k);
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));

    const uint32_t inputAElements = COMPACT_K && !TRANS_A && TRANS_B
        ? m * k : SMALL_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS;
    auto input = LocalTensor<T>(TPosition::VECCALC, inputQueueOffset, (SMALL_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + SMALL_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T) / sizeof(T));
    DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams aCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(m * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams bCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(n * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    const uint32_t alignedK = (k + 15) / 16 * 16;
    const uint32_t gapBlocks = (SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT - alignedK) / 16;
    if constexpr (!COMPACT_K && !TRANS_A) {
        // K40/56 的连续行距不是 32 字节倍数，搬运时放入 64 元素对齐槽。
        DataCopyExtParams alignedACopy{static_cast<uint16_t>(m),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(k * sizeof(T)), 0, gapBlocks, 0};
        DataCopyPad(input, a, alignedACopy, padding);
    } else {
        DataCopyPad(input, a, aCopy, padding);
    }
    if constexpr (!COMPACT_K && TRANS_B) {
        DataCopyExtParams alignedBCopy{static_cast<uint16_t>(n),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(k * sizeof(T)), 0, gapBlocks, 0};
        DataCopyPad(input[inputAElements], b, alignedBCopy, padding);
    } else {
        DataCopyPad(input[inputAElements], b, bCopy, padding);
    }
    SetFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_V>(EVENT_ID0);
    // 产品区与输入区独立，利用输入DMA等待窗口完成尾槽初始化。
    auto products = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, productBufferOffset, (SMALL_BATCH_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    const bool useBlockReduction = m * n >= 32;
    const uint32_t productStride = useBlockReduction ? 64 : (COMPACT_K ? k : SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT);
    if (useBlockReduction && k < 64) {
        Duplicate(products, 0.0f, m * SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT * productStride);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    }
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_V>(EVENT_ID0);

    auto rawA = input;
    auto rawB = input[inputAElements];
    auto packedA = LocalTensor<T>(TPosition::VECCALC, packedBufferOffset, ((SMALL_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + SMALL_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T)) / sizeof(T));
    auto packedB = packedA[SMALL_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS];
    auto aOffsets = LocalTensor<int32_t>(TPosition::VECCALC, offsetBufferOffset, (2 * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT * sizeof(uint32_t)) / sizeof(int32_t));
    auto bOffsets = aOffsets[SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT];
    const uint32_t vectorStride = COMPACT_K ? k : SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT;
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        CreateVecIndex(aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Muls(aOffsets, aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(m * sizeof(T)), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        auto gatherOffsets = aOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < m; ++row) {
            Gather(packedA[row * vectorStride], rawA, gatherOffsets,
                row * sizeof(T), k);
        }
    }
    if constexpr (!TRANS_B) {
        CreateVecIndex(bOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Muls(bOffsets, bOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(n * sizeof(T)), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        auto gatherOffsets = bOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
        for (uint32_t col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
            Gather(packedB[col * vectorStride], rawB, gatherOffsets,
                col * sizeof(T), k);
        }
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto aFloat = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, convertedBufferOffset, ((SMALL_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + SMALL_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    auto bFloat = aFloat[inputAElements];
    if constexpr (COMPACT_K) {
        auto aSource = TRANS_A ? packedA : rawA;
        auto bSource = TRANS_B ? rawB : packedB;
        if constexpr (!TRANS_A && TRANS_B) {
            Cast(aFloat, input, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, (m + n) * k);
        } else {
            Cast(aFloat, aSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, m * k);
            Cast(bFloat, bSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, n * k);
        }
    } else {
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < m; ++row) {
            auto source = TRANS_A ? packedA[row * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT] : rawA[row * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT];
            Cast(aFloat[row * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT], source, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, k);
        }
        for (uint32_t col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
            auto source = TRANS_B ? rawB[col * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT] : packedB[col * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT];
            Cast(bFloat[col * SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT], source, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, k);
        }
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    const uint32_t vectorBlocks = vectorStride * sizeof(float) / 32;
    BinaryRepeatParams multiplyRepeats{1, 1, 1,
        static_cast<uint8_t>(productStride / 8), 0, static_cast<uint8_t>(vectorBlocks)};
    for (uint32_t row = 0; row < m; ++row) {
        Mul(products[row * SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT * productStride],
            aFloat[row * vectorStride], bFloat,
            static_cast<uint64_t>(k), static_cast<uint8_t>(n), multiplyRepeats);
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto dots = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, dotBufferOffset, (SMALL_BATCH_M_LIMIT * SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    if (useBlockReduction) {
        // 点积计算已完成，复用原输入转换区存储每点积8个块和。
        BlockReduceSum(aFloat, products,
            static_cast<int32_t>(m * SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT), 64, 1, 1, 8);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        BlockReduceSum(dots, aFloat,
            static_cast<int32_t>(m * SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT / 8), 64, 1, 1, 8);
    } else {
        WholeReduceSum(dots, products, static_cast<int32_t>(k),
            static_cast<int32_t>(m * SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT), 1, 1,
            static_cast<int32_t>(vectorBlocks));
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto maxima = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, maximumBufferOffset, (SMALL_BATCH_M_LIMIT * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    WholeReduceMax(maxima, dots, static_cast<int32_t>(n), static_cast<int32_t>(m),
        1, 1, SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT * sizeof(float) / 32,
        ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto result = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, outputQueueOffset, 8);
    WholeReduceSum(result, maxima, static_cast<int32_t>(m), 1, 1, 1, 1);
    SetFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    DataCopyExtParams outputCopy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(output[batch], result, outputCopy);
    SetFlag<HardEvent::MTE3_S>(EVENT_ID0);
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::MTE3_S>(EVENT_ID0);
}

// 按batch和行块并行；按16列复用转换结果，K按64元素分段累加。
// 各任务先写独立32字节GM槽，再由0号任务合并写回，避免并发写同一缓存行。
template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeMediumBatchDots(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2,
    GM_ADDR staging, GM_ADDR y, uint32_t batchCount, uint32_t m, uint32_t n, uint32_t k)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIV_1_0);
    using namespace AscendC;
    if ASCEND_IS_AIV {
    TPipe pipe;
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> packedBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> offsetBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> convertedBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> productBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> dotBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximumBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> tileMaximumBuffer;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1,
        (MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T));
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 32);
    pipe.InitBuffer(packedBuffer,
        (MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T));
    pipe.InitBuffer(offsetBuffer, 2 * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT * sizeof(uint32_t));
    pipe.InitBuffer(convertedBuffer,
        (MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(productBuffer, MEDIUM_BATCH_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(dotBuffer, MEDIUM_BATCH_DOT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(maximumBuffer, MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(tileMaximumBuffer, MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * sizeof(float));

    const uint32_t rowTiles = (m + MEDIUM_BATCH_ROW_TILE - 1) / MEDIUM_BATCH_ROW_TILE;
    const uint32_t taskIndex = GetBlockIdx();
    const uint32_t batchIndex = taskIndex / rowTiles;
    const uint32_t rowTileIndex = taskIndex % rowTiles;
    const uint32_t rowStart = rowTileIndex * MEDIUM_BATCH_ROW_TILE;
    const uint32_t validRows = m - rowStart < MEDIUM_BATCH_ROW_TILE
        ? m - rowStart : MEDIUM_BATCH_ROW_TILE;
    const uint32_t taskCount = batchCount * rowTiles;
    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> stagedOutput;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(batchIndex) * m * k);
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(batchIndex) * n * k);
    stagedOutput.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(staging));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));

    auto input = inputQueue.AllocTensor<T>();
    DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams aCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(m * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams bCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(n * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        // 转置存储仍保留完整输入，供下面按原始行距Gather。
        DataCopyPad(input, a, aCopy, padding);
    } else {
        // 当前任务只需要连续的validRows行，避免每个行片重复搬入整个A。
        aCopy.blockLen = static_cast<uint32_t>(validRows * k * sizeof(T));
        DataCopyPad(input, a[rowStart * k], aCopy, padding);
    }
    DataCopyPad(input[MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS], b, bCopy, padding);
    inputQueue.EnQue(input);
    input = inputQueue.DeQue<T>();

    auto rawA = input;
    auto rawB = input[MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS];
    auto packedA = packedBuffer.Get<T>();
    auto packedB = packedA[MEDIUM_BATCH_ROW_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT];
    auto aOffsets = offsetBuffer.Get<int32_t>();
    auto bOffsets = aOffsets[MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT];
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        CreateVecIndex(aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Muls(aOffsets, aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(m * sizeof(T)), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        auto gatherOffsets = aOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
        for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
            Gather(packedA[localRow * k], rawA, gatherOffsets,
                (rowStart + localRow) * sizeof(T), k);
        }
    }
    if constexpr (!TRANS_B) {
        CreateVecIndex(bOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Muls(bOffsets, bOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(n * sizeof(T)), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        auto gatherOffsets = bOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
        for (uint32_t col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
            Gather(packedB[col * k], rawB, gatherOffsets, col * sizeof(T), k);
        }
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto aFloat = convertedBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto bFloat = aFloat[MEDIUM_BATCH_ROW_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT];
    auto aSource = TRANS_A ? packedA : rawA;
    auto bSource = TRANS_B ? rawB : packedB;
    Cast(aFloat, aSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, validRows * k);
    Cast(bFloat, bSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, n * k);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    inputQueue.FreeTensor(input);

    auto products = productBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto dots = dotBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto maxima = maximumBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto tileMaxima = tileMaximumBuffer.Get<float>();
    BinaryRepeatParams multiplyRepeats{1, 1, 1, 8, 0,
        static_cast<uint8_t>(k * sizeof(float) / 32)};
    for (uint32_t colStart = 0; colStart < n; colStart += MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE) {
        const uint32_t validCols = n - colStart < MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE
            ? n - colStart : MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE;
        for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
            auto destination = products[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE];
            Mul(destination, aFloat[localRow * k], bFloat[colStart * k],
                static_cast<uint64_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE),
                static_cast<uint8_t>(validCols), multiplyRepeats);
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        if (k > MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE) {
            for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
                auto destination = products[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE];
                MulAddDst(destination, aFloat[localRow * k + MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    bFloat[colStart * k + MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE),
                    static_cast<uint8_t>(validCols), multiplyRepeats);
            }
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }
        if (validCols == MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE) {
            WholeReduceSum(dots, products,
                static_cast<int32_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE),
                static_cast<int32_t>(validRows * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE), 1, 1, 8);
        } else {
            for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
                WholeReduceSum(dots[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE],
                    products[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    static_cast<int32_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE),
                    static_cast<int32_t>(validCols), 1, 1, 8);
            }
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        WholeReduceMax(tileMaxima, dots, static_cast<int32_t>(validCols),
            static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1,
            MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * sizeof(float) / 32,
            ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        if (colStart == 0) {
            Adds(maxima, tileMaxima, 0.0f, validRows);
        } else {
            Max(maxima, maxima, tileMaxima, validRows);
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    }

    auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    Duplicate(result, 0.0f, MEDIUM_BATCH_OUTPUT_STRIDE);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    WholeReduceSum(result, maxima, static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1, 1, 1);
    outputQueue.EnQue(result);
    result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
    DataCopy(stagedOutput[taskIndex * MEDIUM_BATCH_OUTPUT_STRIDE], result,
        MEDIUM_BATCH_OUTPUT_STRIDE);
    outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);

    SyncAll<true>();
    if (taskIndex == 0) {
        auto stagedInput = inputQueue.AllocTensor<T>();
        auto stagedFloat = stagedInput.template ReinterpretCast<float>();
        DataCopy(stagedFloat, stagedOutput,
            taskCount * MEDIUM_BATCH_OUTPUT_STRIDE);
        inputQueue.EnQue(stagedInput);
        stagedInput = inputQueue.DeQue<T>();
        stagedFloat = stagedInput.template ReinterpretCast<float>();

        auto gatherOffsets = offsetBuffer.Get<int32_t>();
        CreateVecIndex(gatherOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), rowTiles);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Muls(gatherOffsets, gatherOffsets,
            static_cast<int32_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_OUTPUT_STRIDE * sizeof(float)),
            rowTiles);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

        auto merged = productBuffer.Get<float>();
        for (uint32_t batch = 0; batch < batchCount; ++batch) {
            Gather(merged[batch * MEDIUM_BATCH_OUTPUT_STRIDE],
                stagedFloat[batch * rowTiles * MEDIUM_BATCH_OUTPUT_STRIDE],
                gatherOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>(), static_cast<uint32_t>(0), rowTiles);
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        inputQueue.FreeTensor(stagedInput);

        auto finalResults = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        WholeReduceSum(finalResults, merged, static_cast<int32_t>(rowTiles),
            static_cast<int32_t>(batchCount), 1, 1,
            MEDIUM_BATCH_OUTPUT_STRIDE * sizeof(float) / 32);
        outputQueue.EnQue(finalResults);
        finalResults = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        DataCopyExtParams outputCopy{1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(batchCount * sizeof(float)), 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPad(output, finalResults, outputCopy);
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(finalResults);
    }
    }
}

// 一个AIV完成一个batch，静态UB地址减少资源初始化。
template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeBatchStaticUB(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2,
    GM_ADDR staging, GM_ADDR y, uint32_t batchCount, uint32_t runtimeM, uint32_t runtimeN, uint32_t runtimeK)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_AIV_ONLY);
    using namespace AscendC;
    const uint32_t batchIndex = GetBlockIdx();
    // 启动配置可多于batch数，仅无分配任务的核退出。
    if (batchIndex >= batchCount) {
        return;
    }
    const uint32_t m = runtimeM;
    const uint32_t n = runtimeN;
    const uint32_t k = runtimeK;
    // 单次输入与输出使用静态UB和显式事件同步。
    SetAtomicNone();
    SetMaskNorm();
    ResetMask();

    constexpr uint32_t outputEnd = (MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T) + 32;
    constexpr uint32_t packedBufferOffset = (outputEnd + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t offsetBufferOffset = (packedBufferOffset + ((MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t convertedBufferOffset = (offsetBufferOffset + (2 * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT * sizeof(uint32_t)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t productBufferOffset = (convertedBufferOffset + ((MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t dotBufferOffset = (productBufferOffset + (MEDIUM_BATCH_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t maximumBufferOffset = (dotBufferOffset + (MEDIUM_BATCH_DOT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;
    constexpr uint32_t tileMaximumBufferOffset = (maximumBufferOffset + (MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * sizeof(float)) + 31) / 32 * 32;

    const uint32_t rowStart = 0;
    const uint32_t validRows = m;
    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> stagedOutput;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(batchIndex) * m * k);
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(batchIndex) * n * k);
    stagedOutput.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(staging));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));

    auto input = LocalTensor<T>(TPosition::VECCALC, 0, MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS);
    DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams aCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(m * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams bCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(n * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        // 转置存储仍保留完整输入，供下面按原始行距Gather。
        DataCopyPad(input, a, aCopy, padding);
    } else {
        // 当前任务只需要连续的validRows行，避免每个行片重复搬入整个A。
        aCopy.blockLen = static_cast<uint32_t>(validRows * k * sizeof(T));
        DataCopyPad(input, a[rowStart * k], aCopy, padding);
    }
    DataCopyPad(input[MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS], b, bCopy, padding);
    SetFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_V>(EVENT_ID0);

    auto rawA = input;
    auto rawB = input[MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS];
    auto packedA = LocalTensor<T>(TPosition::VECCALC, packedBufferOffset, ((MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T)) / sizeof(T));
    auto packedB = packedA[MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT];
    auto aOffsets = LocalTensor<int32_t>(TPosition::VECCALC, offsetBufferOffset, (2 * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT * sizeof(uint32_t)) / sizeof(int32_t));
    auto bOffsets = aOffsets[MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT];
    const bool useBlockTranspose = (m % 16 == 0) && (k % 16 == 0);
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        if (!useBlockTranspose) {
            // CreateVecIndex内部依赖TPipe；在本核显式建立索引并同步。
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
                aOffsets.SetValue(i, static_cast<int32_t>(i));
            }
            SetFlag<HardEvent::S_V>(EVENT_ID0);
            WaitFlag<HardEvent::S_V>(EVENT_ID0);
            for (uint32_t offset = 8; offset < 64; offset += 8) {
                Adds(aOffsets[offset], aOffsets[offset - 8], static_cast<int32_t>(8),
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(8), 1, UnaryRepeatParams{});
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            }
            if (k > 64) {
                Adds(aOffsets[64], aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(64),
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(64), 1, UnaryRepeatParams{});
            }
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            Muls(aOffsets, aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(m * sizeof(T)), k);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }
    }
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::MTE2_V>(EVENT_ID0);
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        if (useBlockTranspose) {
            // 完整16元素分块按位转置；重复间源前进16行，目的前进16列。
            auto sourceBits = rawA.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>();
            auto destinationBits = packedA.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>();
            for (uint32_t row = 0; row < validRows; row += 16) {
                uint64_t sourceAddresses[16];
                uint64_t destinationAddresses[16];
                for (uint32_t lane = 0; lane < 16; ++lane) {
                    sourceAddresses[lane] = sourceBits[lane * m + row].GetPhyAddr();
                    destinationAddresses[lane] = destinationBits[(row + lane) * k].GetPhyAddr();
                }
                TransDataTo5HDParams transposeParams{false, false,
                    static_cast<uint8_t>(k / 16), 1, static_cast<uint16_t>(m)};
                TransDataTo5HD<uint16_t>(destinationAddresses, sourceAddresses, transposeParams);
            }
        } else {
            auto gatherOffsets = aOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
            #pragma unroll
            for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
                Gather(packedA[localRow * k], rawA, gatherOffsets,
                    (rowStart + localRow) * sizeof(T), k);
            }
        }
    }
    if constexpr (!TRANS_B) {
        auto sourceBits = rawB.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>();
        auto destinationBits = packedB.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>();
        for (uint32_t colStart = 0; colStart < n; colStart += 16) {
            uint64_t sourceAddresses[16];
            uint64_t destinationAddresses[16];
            for (uint32_t lane = 0; lane < 16; ++lane) {
                sourceAddresses[lane] = sourceBits[lane * n + colStart].GetPhyAddr();
                destinationAddresses[lane] = destinationBits[(lane + colStart) * k].GetPhyAddr();
            }
            TransDataTo5HDParams transposeParams{false, false,
                static_cast<uint8_t>(k / 16), 1, static_cast<uint16_t>(n)};
            TransDataTo5HD<uint16_t>(destinationAddresses, sourceAddresses, transposeParams);
        }
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto aFloat = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, convertedBufferOffset, ((MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    auto bFloat = aFloat[MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT];
    auto aSource = TRANS_A ? packedA : rawA;
    auto bSource = TRANS_B ? rawB : packedB;
    Cast(aFloat, aSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, validRows * k);
    Cast(bFloat, bSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, n * k);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto products = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, productBufferOffset, (MEDIUM_BATCH_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    auto dots = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, dotBufferOffset, (MEDIUM_BATCH_DOT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    auto maxima = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, maximumBufferOffset, (MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    auto tileMaxima = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, tileMaximumBufferOffset, (MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * sizeof(float)) / sizeof(float));
    BinaryRepeatParams multiplyRepeats{1, 1, 1, 8, 0,
        static_cast<uint8_t>(k * sizeof(float) / 32)};
    for (uint32_t colStart = 0; colStart < n; colStart += MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE) {
        const uint32_t validCols = n - colStart < MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE
            ? n - colStart : MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE;
        #pragma unroll
        for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
            auto destination = products[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE];
            Mul(destination, aFloat[localRow * k], bFloat[colStart * k],
                static_cast<uint64_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE),
                static_cast<uint8_t>(validCols), multiplyRepeats);
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        if (k > MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE) {
            #pragma unroll
        for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
                auto destination = products[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE];
                MulAddDst(destination, aFloat[localRow * k + MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    bFloat[colStart * k + MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE),
                    static_cast<uint8_t>(validCols), multiplyRepeats);
            }
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }
        if (validCols >= 8) {
            // 两个首级分块的写区独立，先全部生产块和，再统一消费。
            // 每次仍最多128个repeat，保留原repeat上限。
            auto blockSums = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, packedBufferOffset, ((MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T)) / sizeof(float));
            for (uint32_t row = 0; row < validRows; row += 8) {
                const uint32_t rows = validRows - row < 8 ? validRows - row : 8;
                BlockReduceSum(blockSums[row * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * 8],
                    products[row * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    static_cast<int32_t>(rows * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE),
                    static_cast<int32_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE), 1, 1, 8);
            }
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            BlockReduceSum(dots, blockSums,
                static_cast<int32_t>(validRows * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE / 8),
                64, 1, 1, 8);
        } else {
            for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
                WholeReduceSum(dots[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE],
                    products[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    static_cast<int32_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE),
                    static_cast<int32_t>(validCols), 1, 1, 8);
            }
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        auto currentMaxima = colStart == 0 ? maxima : tileMaxima;
        WholeReduceMax(currentMaxima, dots, static_cast<int32_t>(validCols),
            static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1,
            MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * sizeof(float) / 32,
            ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        if (colStart != 0) {
            Max(maxima, maxima, tileMaxima, validRows);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }
    }

    auto result = LocalTensor<float>(TPosition::VECCALC, outputEnd - 32, 8);
    WholeReduceSum(result, maxima, static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1, 1, 1);
    SetFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::V_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    DataCopyExtParams outputCopy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(output[batchIndex], result, outputCopy);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL>();
}

template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeBatchDirectDots(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2,
    GM_ADDR staging, GM_ADDR y, uint32_t batchCount, uint32_t m, uint32_t n, uint32_t k)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_AIV_ONLY);
    using namespace AscendC;
    TPipe pipe;
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> packedBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> offsetBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> convertedBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> productBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> dotBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximumBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> tileMaximumBuffer;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1,
        (MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T));
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 32);
    pipe.InitBuffer(packedBuffer,
        (MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T));
    pipe.InitBuffer(offsetBuffer, 2 * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT * sizeof(uint32_t));
    pipe.InitBuffer(convertedBuffer,
        (MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(productBuffer, MEDIUM_BATCH_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(dotBuffer, MEDIUM_BATCH_DOT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(maximumBuffer, MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(tileMaximumBuffer, MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * sizeof(float));

    const uint32_t batchIndex = GetBlockIdx();
    const uint32_t rowStart = 0;
    const uint32_t validRows = m;
    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> stagedOutput;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(batchIndex) * m * k);
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(batchIndex) * n * k);
    stagedOutput.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(staging));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));

    auto input = inputQueue.AllocTensor<T>();
    DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams aCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(m * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams bCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(n * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        if (m < 16) {
            // 补齐输入短行，以保证16×16转置的源行首均32B对齐。
            DataCopyExtParams paddedACopy{static_cast<uint16_t>(k),
                static_cast<uint32_t>(m * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
            DataCopyPad(input, a, paddedACopy, padding);
        } else {
            DataCopyPad(input, a, aCopy, padding);
        }
    } else {
        // 当前任务只需要连续的validRows行，避免每个行片重复搬入整个A。
        aCopy.blockLen = static_cast<uint32_t>(validRows * k * sizeof(T));
        DataCopyPad(input, a[rowStart * k], aCopy, padding);
    }
    DataCopyPad(input[MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS], b, bCopy, padding);
    inputQueue.EnQue(input);
    input = inputQueue.DeQue<T>();

    auto rawA = input;
    auto rawB = input[MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS];
    auto packedA = packedBuffer.Get<T>();
    auto packedB = packedA[MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT];
    auto aOffsets = offsetBuffer.Get<int32_t>();
    auto bOffsets = aOffsets[MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT];
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        if (m < 16) {
            auto sourceBits = rawA.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>();
            auto destinationBits = packedA.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>();
            uint64_t sourceAddresses[16];
            uint64_t destinationAddresses[16];
            for (uint32_t lane = 0; lane < 16; ++lane) {
                sourceAddresses[lane] = sourceBits[lane * 16].GetPhyAddr();
                destinationAddresses[lane] = destinationBits[lane * k].GetPhyAddr();
            }
            TransDataTo5HDParams transposeParams{false, false,
                static_cast<uint8_t>(k / 16), 1, 16};
            TransDataTo5HD<uint16_t>(destinationAddresses, sourceAddresses, transposeParams);
        } else {
            CreateVecIndex(aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), k);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            Muls(aOffsets, aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(m * sizeof(T)), k);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            auto gatherOffsets = aOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
            for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
                Gather(packedA[localRow * k], rawA, gatherOffsets,
                    (rowStart + localRow) * sizeof(T), k);
            }
        }
    }
    if constexpr (!TRANS_B) {
        auto sourceBits = rawB.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>();
        auto destinationBits = packedB.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>();
        for (uint32_t colStart = 0; colStart < n; colStart += 16) {
            uint64_t sourceAddresses[16];
            uint64_t destinationAddresses[16];
            for (uint32_t lane = 0; lane < 16; ++lane) {
                sourceAddresses[lane] = sourceBits[lane * n + colStart].GetPhyAddr();
                destinationAddresses[lane] = destinationBits[(lane + colStart) * k].GetPhyAddr();
            }
            TransDataTo5HDParams transposeParams{false, false,
                static_cast<uint8_t>(k / 16), 1, static_cast<uint16_t>(n)};
            TransDataTo5HD<uint16_t>(destinationAddresses, sourceAddresses, transposeParams);
        }
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto aFloat = convertedBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto bFloat = aFloat[MEDIUM_BATCH_M_LIMIT * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT];
    auto aSource = TRANS_A ? packedA : rawA;
    auto bSource = TRANS_B ? rawB : packedB;
    Cast(aFloat, aSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, validRows * k);
    Cast(bFloat, bSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, n * k);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    inputQueue.FreeTensor(input);

    auto products = productBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto dots = dotBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto maxima = maximumBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto tileMaxima = tileMaximumBuffer.Get<float>();
    BinaryRepeatParams multiplyRepeats{1, 1, 1, 8, 0,
        static_cast<uint8_t>(k * sizeof(float) / 32)};
    for (uint32_t colStart = 0; colStart < n; colStart += MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE) {
        const uint32_t validCols = n - colStart < MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE
            ? n - colStart : MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE;
        for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
            auto destination = products[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE];
            Mul(destination, aFloat[localRow * k], bFloat[colStart * k],
                static_cast<uint64_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE),
                static_cast<uint8_t>(validCols), multiplyRepeats);
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        if (k > MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE) {
            for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
                auto destination = products[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE];
                MulAddDst(destination, aFloat[localRow * k + MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    bFloat[colStart * k + MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    static_cast<uint64_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE),
                    static_cast<uint8_t>(validCols), multiplyRepeats);
            }
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }
        if (validCols >= 8) {
            // 每次至多128个repeat，避免16行完整块产生256次repeat溢出。
            for (uint32_t row = 0; row < validRows; row += 8) {
                const uint32_t rows = validRows - row < 8 ? validRows - row : 8;
                // Cast已完成，可复用packed区存放每个点积的8个块和。
                auto blockSums = packedBuffer.Get<float>();
                BlockReduceSum(blockSums[row * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * 8],
                    products[row * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    static_cast<int32_t>(rows * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE),
                    static_cast<int32_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE), 1, 1, 8);
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                BlockReduceSum(dots[row * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE],
                    blockSums[row * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * 8],
                    static_cast<int32_t>(rows * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE / 8),
                    64, 1, 1, 8);
            }
        } else {
            for (uint32_t localRow = 0; localRow < validRows; ++localRow) {
                WholeReduceSum(dots[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE],
                    products[localRow * MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE],
                    static_cast<int32_t>(MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE),
                    static_cast<int32_t>(validCols), 1, 1, 8);
            }
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        auto currentMaxima = colStart == 0 ? maxima : tileMaxima;
        WholeReduceMax(currentMaxima, dots, static_cast<int32_t>(validCols),
            static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1,
            MEDIUM_BATCH_COL_TILE * sizeof(float) / 32,
            ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        if (colStart != 0) {
            Max(maxima, maxima, tileMaxima, validRows);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }
    }

    auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    WholeReduceSum(result, maxima, static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1, 1, 1);
    outputQueue.EnQue(result);
    result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
    DataCopyExtParams outputCopy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(output[batchIndex], result, outputCopy);
    outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
}

// 紧凑批量按batch、行块和列块分核，让全部AIV并行计算后在核内合并行最大值。
template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeLargeBatchDots(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR staging,
    GM_ADDR y, uint32_t batchCount, uint32_t m, uint32_t n, uint32_t k)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_AIV_ONLY);
    using namespace AscendC;
    TPipe pipe;
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> packedBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> offsetBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> convertedBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> productBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> dotBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximumBuffer;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1,
        (MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T));
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 32);
    pipe.InitBuffer(packedBuffer,
        (MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(T));
    pipe.InitBuffer(offsetBuffer, 2 * MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT * sizeof(uint32_t));
    pipe.InitBuffer(convertedBuffer,
        (MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS + MEDIUM_BATCH_B_ELEMENTS) * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(productBuffer, LARGE_BATCH_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(dotBuffer, LARGE_BATCH_DOT_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(maximumBuffer, LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE * sizeof(float));

    const uint32_t rowTiles = (m + LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE - 1) / LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE;
    const uint32_t colTiles = (n + LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE - 1) / LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE;
    const uint32_t tasksPerBatch = rowTiles * colTiles;
    const uint32_t taskIndex = GetBlockIdx();
    const uint32_t batch = taskIndex / tasksPerBatch;
    const uint32_t localTask = taskIndex % tasksPerBatch;
    const uint32_t rowTile = localTask / colTiles;
    const uint32_t colTile = localTask % colTiles;
    const uint32_t rowStart = rowTile * LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE;
    const uint32_t colStart = colTile * LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE;
    const uint32_t validRows = m - rowStart < LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE
        ? m - rowStart : LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE;
    const uint32_t validCols = n - colStart < LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE
        ? n - colStart : LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE;
    const uint32_t taskCount = batchCount * tasksPerBatch;
    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> stagedOutput;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * m * k);
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * n * k);
    stagedOutput.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(staging));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));

    auto input = inputQueue.AllocTensor<T>();
    DataCopyPadExtParams<T> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams aCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(m * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyExtParams bCopy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(n * k * sizeof(T)), 0, 0, 0};
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        // 转置存储保留完整A，供下面按原始行距Gather。
        DataCopyPad(input, a, aCopy, padding);
    } else {
        // 每个行列任务仅搬入所负责的连续A行片，列分片方式保持不变。
        aCopy.blockLen = static_cast<uint32_t>(validRows * k * sizeof(T));
        DataCopyPad(input, a[rowStart * k], aCopy, padding);
    }
    DataCopyPad(input[MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS], b, bCopy, padding);
    inputQueue.EnQue(input);
    input = inputQueue.DeQue<T>();

    auto rawA = input;
    auto rawB = input[MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS];
    auto packedA = packedBuffer.Get<T>();
    auto packedB = packedA[MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS];
    auto aOffsets = offsetBuffer.Get<int32_t>();
    auto bOffsets = aOffsets[MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT];
    if constexpr (TRANS_A) {
        CreateVecIndex(aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Muls(aOffsets, aOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(m * sizeof(T)), k);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        auto gatherOffsets = aOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < validRows; ++row) {
            Gather(packedA[row * k], rawA, gatherOffsets,
                (rowStart + row) * sizeof(T), k);
        }
    }
    if constexpr (!TRANS_B) {
        if ((n & 15u) == 0 && validCols == LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE) {
            // 原始 B 行距和列块起点均为 16 元素的倍数，可直接做 16 位硬件转置。
            auto sourceBits = rawB.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>();
            auto destinationBits = packedB.template ReinterpretCast<uint16_t>();
            uint64_t sourceAddresses[16];
            uint64_t destinationAddresses[16];
            for (uint32_t lane = 0; lane < 16; ++lane) {
                sourceAddresses[lane] = sourceBits[lane * n + colStart].GetPhyAddr();
                destinationAddresses[lane] = destinationBits[lane * k].GetPhyAddr();
            }
