            TransDataTo5HDParams transposeParams{false, false,
                static_cast<uint8_t>(k / 16), 1, static_cast<uint16_t>(n)};
            TransDataTo5HD<uint16_t>(destinationAddresses, sourceAddresses, transposeParams);
        } else {
            CreateVecIndex(bOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(0), k);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            Muls(bOffsets, bOffsets, static_cast<int32_t>(n * sizeof(T)), k);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            auto gatherOffsets = bOffsets.ReinterpretCast<uint32_t>();
            for (uint32_t col = 0; col < validCols; ++col) {
                Gather(packedB[col * k], rawB, gatherOffsets,
                    (colStart + col) * sizeof(T), k);
            }
        }
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto aFloat = convertedBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto bFloat = aFloat[MEDIUM_BATCH_A_ELEMENTS];
    auto aSource = TRANS_A ? packedA : rawA;
    auto bSource = TRANS_B ? rawB[colStart * k] : packedB;
    Cast(aFloat, aSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, validRows * k);
    Cast(bFloat, bSource, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, validCols * k);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    inputQueue.FreeTensor(input);

    auto products = productBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto dots = dotBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto maxima = maximumBuffer.Get<float>();
    BinaryRepeatParams multiplyRepeats{1, 1, 1, 8, 0,
        static_cast<uint8_t>(k * sizeof(float) / 32)};

    for (uint32_t row = 0; row < validRows; ++row) {
        auto destination = products[row * LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE * LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE];
        Mul(destination, aFloat[row * k], bFloat,
            static_cast<uint64_t>(LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE),
            static_cast<uint8_t>(validCols), multiplyRepeats);
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    if (k > LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE) {
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < validRows; ++row) {
            auto destination = products[row * LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE * LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE];
            MulAddDst(destination, aFloat[row * k + LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE],
                bFloat[LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE], static_cast<uint64_t>(LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE),
                static_cast<uint8_t>(validCols), multiplyRepeats);
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    }
    if (validCols == LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE) {
        // 完整列块的点积向量连续排列，至多8*16=128个repeat，可一次归约。
        WholeReduceSum(dots, products, static_cast<int32_t>(LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE),
            static_cast<int32_t>(validRows * LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE), 1, 1, 8);
    } else {
        // 尾列之间仍有未初始化间隔，逐行归约只读取有效乘积。
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < validRows; ++row) {
            WholeReduceSum(dots[row * LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE],
                products[row * LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE * LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE],
                static_cast<int32_t>(LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE),
                static_cast<int32_t>(validCols), 1, 1, 8);
        }
    }
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    WholeReduceMax(maxima, dots, static_cast<int32_t>(validCols),
        static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1,
        LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE * sizeof(float) / 32,
        ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();

    auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    Duplicate(result, 0.0f, LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE);
    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
    Adds(result, maxima, 0.0f, validRows);
    outputQueue.EnQue(result);
    result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
    DataCopy(stagedOutput[taskIndex * LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE], result, LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE);
    outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);

    SyncAll<true>();
    if (taskIndex == 0) {
        auto stagedInput = inputQueue.AllocTensor<T>();
        auto stagedFloat = stagedInput.template ReinterpretCast<float>();
        DataCopy(stagedFloat, stagedOutput, taskCount * LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE);
        inputQueue.EnQue(stagedInput);
        stagedInput = inputQueue.DeQue<T>();
        stagedFloat = stagedInput.template ReinterpretCast<float>();

        auto merged = productBuffer.Get<float>();
        const uint32_t rowGroups = batchCount * rowTiles;
        if (colTiles == 1) {
            Adds(merged, stagedFloat, 0.0f, rowGroups * LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE);
        } else {
            // 此路径N至多32，恰好两个16列分片；每个repeat合并一个8行块。
            // 输入跨两个32字节块，输出连续，最多16个repeat，源和目的不重叠。
            BinaryRepeatParams mergeRepeats{1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2};
            Max(merged, stagedFloat, stagedFloat[LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE],
                static_cast<uint64_t>(LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE),
                static_cast<uint8_t>(rowGroups), mergeRepeats);
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        inputQueue.FreeTensor(stagedInput);

        auto finalResults = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        // 每个batch连续存放一至两个8行块；尾行已补零，批量Sum仍保持先Max后Sum。
        WholeReduceSum(finalResults, merged,
            static_cast<int32_t>(rowTiles * LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE),
            static_cast<int32_t>(batchCount), 1, 1, static_cast<int32_t>(rowTiles));
        outputQueue.EnQue(finalResults);
        finalResults = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        DataCopyExtParams outputCopy{1,
            static_cast<uint32_t>(batchCount * sizeof(float)), 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPad(output, finalResults, outputCopy);
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(finalResults);
    }
}

__aicore__ inline void Finish(AscendC::TPipe& pipe, GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y,
    uint32_t rowTiles, uint32_t batch)
{
    using namespace AscendC;
    if (batch > 1 && rowTiles <= 4) {
        // 每个batch至多64个float（有效局部和与零填充），一次搬入所有batch。
        // 每个repeat独立归约一个batch，输出连续，避免逐批Scalar取值和同步。
        const uint32_t count = rowTiles * PARTIAL_STRIDE;
        TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> batchInputQueue;
        TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> batchOutputQueue;
        pipe.InitBuffer(batchInputQueue, 1, batch * count * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(batchOutputQueue, 1, 64 * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<float> batchInput;
        GlobalTensor<float> batchOutput;
        batchInput.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
        batchOutput.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
        auto local = batchInputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        DataCopy(local, batchInput, batch * count);
        batchInputQueue.EnQue(local);
        local = batchInputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        auto result = batchOutputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        WholeReduceSum(result, local, static_cast<int32_t>(count),
            static_cast<int32_t>(batch), 1, 1, static_cast<int32_t>(count / 8));
        batchOutputQueue.EnQue(result);
        result = batchOutputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        DataCopyExtParams copy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(batch * sizeof(float)), 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPad(batchOutput, result, copy);
        batchOutputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
        batchInputQueue.FreeTensor(local);
        return;
    }
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> tempBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> reduceBuffer;
    const uint32_t count = rowTiles * PARTIAL_STRIDE;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1, count * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 64 * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(tempBuffer, count * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(reduceBuffer, 32);
    GlobalTensor<float> input;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    input.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
    auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    auto reduced = reduceBuffer.Get<float>();
    for (uint32_t b = 0; b < batch; ++b) {
        auto local = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        DataCopy(local, input[b * count], count);
        inputQueue.EnQue(local);
        local = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        ReduceSum(reduced, local, tempBuffer.Get<float>(), count);
        SetFlag<HardEvent::V_S>(EVENT_ID0);
        WaitFlag<HardEvent::V_S>(EVENT_ID0);
        result.SetValue(b, reduced.GetValue(0));
        SetFlag<HardEvent::S_V>(EVENT_ID0);
        WaitFlag<HardEvent::S_V>(EVENT_ID0);
        inputQueue.FreeTensor(local);
    }
    SetFlag<HardEvent::S_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::S_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    outputQueue.EnQue(result);
    result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
    // 单核连续写 B 个 float，既不越界，也不产生跨核缓存行共享写。
    DataCopyExtParams copy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(batch * sizeof(float)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(output, result, copy);
    outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
}


// N 分片不能先对行求和：先合并同一行的各片局部最大值，再沿 M 求和。
template <uint32_t TILE_ROWS, bool BULK_PARTIAL = false>
__aicore__ inline void FinishSplitN(AscendC::TPipe& pipe, GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y,
    const Parameters& params)
{
    using namespace AscendC;
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximaBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> sumsBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> tempBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> reduceBuffer;
    const uint32_t count = params.rowTiles * PARTIAL_STRIDE;
    // 分片分支的全部任务恰好各占一核，可由核数还原片数，无须扩展核参数布局。
    const uint32_t parts = params.cores / (params.batch * params.rowTiles);
    // 调用方仅在128行/1024列分段归约路径启用，原输入双缓冲占128KiB。
    // 最多额外容纳16KiB partial；超过上限保持逐行块搬运。
    const uint64_t batchElements = static_cast<uint64_t>(params.rowTiles) * parts * TILE_ROWS;
    const bool bulkPartial = BULK_PARTIAL && batchElements * sizeof(float) <= 16 * 1024;
    const uint32_t tempCount = TILE_ROWS > 64 && count < TILE_ROWS ? TILE_ROWS : count;
    // 当前所有调用方已有显式UB分配的完整域上界；另保留SDK临时区和KFC消息。
    constexpr uint64_t callerUbUpperBound = 133120;
    const uint64_t ubBudget = static_cast<uint64_t>(TOTAL_VEC_LOCAL_SIZE) - sizeof(KfcMsg);
    const uint64_t fixedBytes = callerUbUpperBound + 64 * sizeof(float)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * sizeof(float)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(tempCount) * sizeof(float) + 32;
    const uint64_t rowInputElements = static_cast<uint64_t>(parts) * TILE_ROWS;
    const uint64_t rowInputBytes = rowInputElements * sizeof(float);
    const uint64_t rowMaximumBytes = TILE_ROWS * sizeof(float);
    uint64_t groupLimit = params.rowTiles < 255 ? params.rowTiles : 255;
    if (parts >= 2 && TILE_ROWS % 8 == 0 && TILE_ROWS / 8 <= 255
        && rowInputElements / 8 <= 255 && fixedBytes < ubBudget) {
        const uint64_t remainingBytes = ubBudget - fixedBytes;
        if (bulkPartial) {
            // 已有bulk路径仍一次搬入整个batch，容量不能只按当前组输入计算。
            const uint64_t batchInputBytes = batchElements * sizeof(float);
            const uint64_t capacityGroups = remainingBytes > batchInputBytes
                ? (remainingBytes - batchInputBytes) / rowMaximumBytes : 0;
            groupLimit = groupLimit < capacityGroups ? groupLimit : capacityGroups;
        } else {
            const uint64_t inputGroups = 16 * 1024 / rowInputBytes;
            const uint64_t capacityGroups = remainingBytes / (rowInputBytes + rowMaximumBytes);
            groupLimit = groupLimit < inputGroups ? groupLimit : inputGroups;
            groupLimit = groupLimit < capacityGroups ? groupLimit : capacityGroups;
        }
    } else {
        groupLimit = 0;
    }
    const bool groupedRows = groupLimit >= 2;
    const uint32_t groupTiles = groupedRows ? static_cast<uint32_t>(groupLimit) : 1;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1,
        (bulkPartial ? batchElements : rowInputElements * groupTiles) * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 64 * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(maximaBuffer, groupTiles * TILE_ROWS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(sumsBuffer, count * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(tempBuffer, tempCount * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(reduceBuffer, 32);
    GlobalTensor<float> input;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    input.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
    auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    auto maxima = maximaBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto sums = sumsBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto reduced = reduceBuffer.Get<float>();
    for (uint32_t b = 0; b < params.batch; ++b) {
        Duplicate(sums, 0.0f, count);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        LocalTensor<float> batchLocal;
        if (bulkPartial) {
            batchLocal = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            DataCopy(batchLocal, input[b * batchElements], static_cast<uint32_t>(batchElements));
            inputQueue.EnQue(batchLocal);
            batchLocal = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        }
        if (groupedRows) {
            for (uint32_t firstTile = 0; firstTile < params.rowTiles; firstTile += groupTiles) {
                const uint32_t activeTiles = params.rowTiles - firstTile < groupTiles
                    ? params.rowTiles - firstTile : groupTiles;
                LocalTensor<float> local;
                if (bulkPartial) {
                    local = batchLocal[firstTile * rowInputElements];
                } else {
                    local = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
                    const uint64_t offset = (static_cast<uint64_t>(b) * params.rowTiles + firstTile)
                        * rowInputElements;
                    DataCopy(local, input[offset], activeTiles * rowInputElements);
                    inputQueue.EnQue(local);
                    local = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
                }
                // 输入为[tile][part][行]，输出为[tile][行]；每个元素仍按part顺序合并。
                const uint8_t sourceStride = static_cast<uint8_t>(rowInputElements / 8);
                const uint8_t maximumStride = static_cast<uint8_t>(TILE_ROWS / 8);
                for (uint32_t part = 1; part < parts; ++part) {
                    BinaryRepeatParams repeats{1, 1, 1, maximumStride,
                        part == 1 ? sourceStride : maximumStride, sourceStride};
                    for (uint32_t row = 0; row < TILE_ROWS; row += 64) {
                        const uint32_t rows = TILE_ROWS - row < 64 ? TILE_ROWS - row : 64;
                        auto left = part == 1 ? local[row] : maxima[row];
                        Max(maxima[row], left, local[part * TILE_ROWS + row],
                            static_cast<uint64_t>(rows), static_cast<uint8_t>(activeTiles), repeats);
                    }
                    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                }
                // 调用方写满每个R行槽并将尾行置零；仍仅对validRows做原顺序Sum。
                for (uint32_t tile = 0; tile < activeTiles; ++tile) {
                    const uint32_t rowTile = firstTile + tile;
                    const uint32_t rowStart = rowTile * TILE_ROWS;
                    const uint32_t validRows = params.m - rowStart < TILE_ROWS
                        ? params.m - rowStart : TILE_ROWS;
                    if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 64) {
                        ReduceSum(sums[rowTile * PARTIAL_STRIDE], maxima[tile * TILE_ROWS],
                            tempBuffer.Get<float>(), validRows);
                    } else {
                        WholeReduceSum(sums[rowTile * PARTIAL_STRIDE], maxima[tile * TILE_ROWS],
                            static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1, 1, 1);
                    }
                    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                }
                if (!bulkPartial) {
                    inputQueue.FreeTensor(local);
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (uint32_t rowTile = 0; rowTile < params.rowTiles; ++rowTile) {
                const uint32_t rowStart = rowTile * TILE_ROWS;
                const uint32_t validRows = params.m - rowStart < TILE_ROWS ? params.m - rowStart : TILE_ROWS;
                const uint32_t offset = (b * params.rowTiles + rowTile) * parts * TILE_ROWS;
                LocalTensor<float> local;
                if (bulkPartial) {
                    local = batchLocal[rowTile * parts * TILE_ROWS];
                } else {
                    local = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
                    DataCopy(local, input[offset], parts * TILE_ROWS);
                    inputQueue.EnQue(local);
                    local = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
                }
                Max(maxima, local, local[TILE_ROWS], validRows);
                for (uint32_t part = 2; part < parts; ++part) {
                    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    Max(maxima, maxima, local[part * TILE_ROWS], validRows);
                }
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 64) {
                    // 128行N分片归约必须使用多段Sum，单条WholeReduceSum至多64个float。
                    ReduceSum(sums[rowTile * PARTIAL_STRIDE], maxima,
                        tempBuffer.Get<float>(), validRows);
                } else {
                    WholeReduceSum(sums[rowTile * PARTIAL_STRIDE], maxima,
                        static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1, 1, 1);
                }
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                if (!bulkPartial) {
                    inputQueue.FreeTensor(local);
                }
            }
        }
        if (bulkPartial) {
            inputQueue.FreeTensor(batchLocal);
        }
        ReduceSum(reduced, sums, tempBuffer.Get<float>(), count);
        SetFlag<HardEvent::V_S>(EVENT_ID0);
        WaitFlag<HardEvent::V_S>(EVENT_ID0);
        result.SetValue(b, reduced.GetValue(0));
        SetFlag<HardEvent::S_V>(EVENT_ID0);
        WaitFlag<HardEvent::S_V>(EVENT_ID0);
    }
    SetFlag<HardEvent::S_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    WaitFlag<HardEvent::S_MTE3>(EVENT_ID0);
    outputQueue.EnQue(result);
    result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
    DataCopyExtParams copy{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(params.batch * sizeof(float)), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(output, result, copy);
    outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
}



// 异步模式显式请求完成通知，读回对应结果块前必须 WaitIterateAll。
template <uint32_t TILE_COLS, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B, bool ASYNC, typename MM, typename T>
__aicore__ inline void StartColumn(MM& mm, const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& a,
    const AscendC::GlobalTensor<T>& b, const AscendC::GlobalTensor<float>& destination,
    const Parameters& params, uint64_t aOffset, uint64_t bOffset,
    uint32_t validRows, uint32_t colStart)
{
    const uint32_t validCols = params.n - colStart < TILE_COLS ? params.n - colStart : TILE_COLS;
    const uint64_t tileBOffset = bOffset
        + (TRANS_B ? static_cast<uint64_t>(colStart) * params.k : colStart);
    mm.SetTail(validRows, validCols, params.k);
    mm.SetTensorA(a[aOffset], TRANS_A);
    mm.SetTensorB(b[tileBOffset], TRANS_B);
    mm.template IterateAll<!ASYNC>(destination, 0, false, ASYNC);
}

// 大矩阵、512×64高窄块和64×256矮宽块使用MDL，保持UnitFlag。
// 其他块形状保持原执行模板。
template <uint32_t TILE_ROWS, uint32_t TILE_COLS>
constexpr MatmulConfig MakeComputeConfig()
{
    constexpr bool largeTile = (TILE_ROWS == 208 && TILE_COLS == 128) || ((TILE_ROWS == 128 || TILE_ROWS == 112) && TILE_COLS == 256)
        || (TILE_ROWS == 256 && TILE_COLS == 128);
    constexpr bool tallTile = (TILE_ROWS == 512 || TILE_ROWS == 416) && TILE_COLS == 64;
    constexpr bool wideTile = TILE_ROWS == 64 && TILE_COLS == 256;
    MatmulConfig config = TILE_COLS == 512 || largeTile || tallTile || wideTile
        ? CFG_MDL : CFG_NORM;
    if (largeTile || tallTile || wideTile) {
        // 高窄和矮宽块原NORM模板已开启UnitFlag，切换MDL时保持这一配置。
        config.enUnitFlag = true;
    }
    if constexpr ((TILE_ROWS == DEFAULT_ROWS && TILE_COLS == DEFAULT_COLS)
        || wideTile || tallTile || largeTile) {
        // 默认块、矮宽块、高窄块与大矩阵块使用官方双主模式，减少KFC消息发射。
        config.enableMixDualMaster = true;
    }
    return config;
}

template <uint32_t TILE_ROWS, uint32_t TILE_COLS>
constexpr MatmulConfig COMPUTE_CONFIG = MakeComputeConfig<TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS>();

// 仅固定默认块和大矩阵块的base形状；singleCore和K步长仍由运行时tiling提供。
// 常量与Host实际参数匹配时才分发至此模板，其他场景保留动态版本。
template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B,
    uint32_t TILE_ROWS, uint32_t TILE_COLS, bool STATIC_BASE>
__aicore__ constexpr auto MakeKernelMatmulConfig()
{
    if constexpr (STATIC_BASE) {
        constexpr bool largeTile = (TILE_ROWS == 208 && TILE_COLS == 128) || (TILE_ROWS == 112 && TILE_COLS == 256) || ((TILE_ROWS == 128 || TILE_ROWS == 64) && TILE_COLS == 256)
            || (TILE_ROWS == 256 && TILE_COLS == 128);
        static_assert((TILE_ROWS == DEFAULT_ROWS && TILE_COLS == DEFAULT_COLS) || largeTile,
            "Static base tiling is restricted to default and large tiles");
        MatmulConfig config = COMPUTE_CONFIG<TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS>;
        config.basicM = TILE_ROWS;
        config.basicN = TILE_COLS;
        config.basicK = largeTile ? 64 : 128;
        config.enableSetBias = false;
        using AType = AscendC::MatmulType<AscendC::TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, TRANS_A>;
        using BType = AscendC::MatmulType<AscendC::TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, TRANS_B>;
        using CType = AscendC::MatmulType<AscendC::TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>;
        auto constant = AscendC::GetMatmulApiTiling<AType, BType, CType, CType>(config);
        return constant;
    } else {
        return COMPUTE_CONFIG<TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS>;
    }
}

template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B,
    uint32_t TILE_ROWS, uint32_t TILE_COLS, bool STATIC_BASE>
constexpr auto KERNEL_MATMUL_CONFIG =
    MakeKernelMatmulConfig<T, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS, STATIC_BASE>();

// 矮宽矩阵按512列分核，每核两次256列Cube，共享驻留A。
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeWideResidentNT(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch,
    GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y, Parameters params)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    constexpr uint32_t COLS = 512, TILE_N = 256;
    const uint32_t M = params.m, K = params.k;
    const uint32_t task = GetBlockIdx();
    TPipe pipe;
    GlobalTensor<float> matrix;
    // host为分N路径分配双槽，每核保持相同地址步长。
    matrix.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch) + task * 2 * M * COLS);
    if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
        TQue<TPosition::A1, 1> a1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B1, 1> b1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::A2, 1> a2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B2, 1> b2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::CO1, 1> c1Queue;
        pipe.InitBuffer(a1Queue, 1, M * K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b1Queue, 1, TILE_N * K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(a2Queue, 1, M * K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b2Queue, 1, TILE_N * K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(c1Queue, 1, M * TILE_N * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<bfloat16_t> a, b;
        a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(x1));
        b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(x2) + task * COLS * K);
        auto a1 = a1Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
        Nd2NzParams copyA{};
        copyA.ndNum = 1;
        copyA.nValue = M;
        copyA.dValue = K;
        copyA.srcDValue = K;
        copyA.dstNzC0Stride = M;
        copyA.dstNzNStride = 1;
        DataCopy(a1, a, copyA);
        a1Queue.EnQue(a1);
        a1 = a1Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
        auto a2 = a2Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
        LoadData2DParams loadA{};
        loadA.repeatTimes = K / 16;
        loadA.srcStride = M / 16;
        loadA.ifTranspose = false;
        for (uint32_t rowBlock = 0; rowBlock < M / 16; ++rowBlock) {
            LoadData(a2[rowBlock * K * 16], a1[rowBlock * 256], loadA);
        }
        a2Queue.EnQue(a2);
        a1Queue.FreeTensor(a1);
        a2 = a2Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
        for (uint32_t col = 0; col < COLS; col += TILE_N) {
            auto b1 = b1Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
            Nd2NzParams copyB{};
            copyB.ndNum = 1;
            copyB.nValue = TILE_N;
            copyB.dValue = K;
            copyB.srcDValue = K;
            copyB.dstNzC0Stride = TILE_N;
            copyB.dstNzNStride = 1;
            DataCopy(b1, b[col * K], copyB);
            b1Queue.EnQue(b1);
            b1 = b1Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
            auto b2 = b2Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
            LoadData2DParams loadB{};
            loadB.repeatTimes = (K / 16) * (TILE_N / 16);
            loadB.srcStride = 1;
            loadB.ifTranspose = false;
            LoadData(b2, b1, loadB);
            b2Queue.EnQue(b2);
            b1Queue.FreeTensor(b1);
            b2 = b2Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
            auto c1 = c1Queue.AllocTensor<float>();
            MmadParams multiply{};
            multiply.m = M;
            multiply.n = TILE_N;
            multiply.k = K;
            multiply.cmatrixInitVal = true;
            Mmad(c1, a2, b2, multiply);
            b2Queue.FreeTensor(b2);
            c1Queue.EnQue(c1);
            c1 = c1Queue.DeQue<float>();
            FixpipeParamsV220 copyC{};
            copyC.nSize = TILE_N;
            copyC.mSize = M;
            copyC.srcStride = M;
            copyC.dstStride = COLS;
            copyC.ndNum = 1;
            copyC.quantPre = QuantMode_t::NoQuant;
            Fixpipe(matrix[col], c1, copyC);
            CrossCoreSetFlag<0x2, PIPE_FIX>(0x8 + col / TILE_N);
            c1Queue.FreeTensor(c1);
        }
        a2Queue.FreeTensor(a2);
    }
    if ASCEND_IS_AIV {
        TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 2> inputQueue;
        TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
        TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximumBuffer, tempBuffer;
        pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 2, M * TILE_N * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, M * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(maximumBuffer, M * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(tempBuffer, M * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<float> scores;
        scores.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
        auto maxima = maximumBuffer.Get<float>();
        auto temporary = tempBuffer.Get<float>();
        for (uint32_t tileCol = 0; tileCol < COLS; tileCol += TILE_N) {
            CrossCoreWaitFlag(0x8 + tileCol / TILE_N);
            auto input = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            DataCopyParams copyTile{static_cast<uint16_t>(M), TILE_N / 8, (COLS - TILE_N) / 8, 0};
            DataCopy(input, matrix[tileCol], copyTile);
            inputQueue.EnQue(input);
            input = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
            BinaryRepeatParams foldRepeat{1, 1, 1, TILE_N / 8, TILE_N / 8, TILE_N / 8};
            for (uint32_t width = TILE_N / 2; width >= 64; width /= 2) {
                for (uint32_t col = 0; col < width; col += 64) {
                    Max(input[col], input[col], input[col + width], 64, M, foldRepeat);
                }
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            }
            auto currentMaxima = tileCol == 0 ? maxima : temporary;
            WholeReduceMax(currentMaxima, input, 64, M, 1, 1, TILE_N / 8,
                ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            if (tileCol != 0) {
                Max(maxima, maxima, temporary, M);
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            }
            inputQueue.FreeTensor(input);
        }
        auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        Adds(result, maxima, 0.0f, M);
        outputQueue.EnQue(result);
        result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        DataCopy(scores[task * M], result, M);
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
        SyncAll<true>();
        if (task == 0) {
            // 单batch单行片：先合并各N片Max，再对实际M行求和。
            auto local = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            DataCopy(local, scores, params.cores * M);
            inputQueue.EnQue(local);
            local = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
            Max(maxima, local, local[M], M);
            for (uint32_t part = 2; part < params.cores; ++part) {
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                Max(maxima, maxima, local[part * M], M);
            }
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            auto finalResult = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            WholeReduceSum(finalResult, maxima, M, 1, 1, 1, 1);
            inputQueue.FreeTensor(local);
            outputQueue.EnQue(finalResult);
            finalResult = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
            GlobalTensor<float> output;
            output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
            DataCopyExtParams copy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
            DataCopyPad(output, finalResult, copy);
            outputQueue.FreeTensor(finalResult);
        }
    }
}

// 高窄矩阵按核数平衡行片，每次计算至多128行，复用驻留B。
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeTallResidentNN(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch,
    GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y, Parameters params)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    constexpr uint32_t TILE_M = 128, N = 64;
    const uint32_t ROWS = params.tileRows, K = params.k;
    const uint32_t task = GetBlockIdx();
    const uint32_t validRows = params.m - task * ROWS < ROWS ? params.m - task * ROWS : ROWS;
    TPipe pipe;
    GlobalTensor<float> matrix;
    matrix.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch) + task * ROWS * N);
    if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
        TQue<TPosition::A1, 1> a1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B1, 1> b1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::A2, 1> a2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B2, 1> b2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::CO1, 1> c1Queue;
        pipe.InitBuffer(a1Queue, 1, TILE_M * K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b1Queue, 1, N * K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(a2Queue, 1, TILE_M * K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b2Queue, 1, N * K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(c1Queue, 1, TILE_M * N * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<half> a, b;
        a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ half*>(x1) + task * ROWS * K);
        b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ half*>(x2));
        auto b1 = b1Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
        Nd2NzParams copyB{};
        copyB.ndNum = 1;
        copyB.nValue = K;
        copyB.dValue = params.n;
        copyB.srcDValue = params.n;
        copyB.dstNzC0Stride = K;
        copyB.dstNzNStride = 1;
        DataCopy(b1, b, copyB);
        b1Queue.EnQue(b1);
        b1 = b1Queue.DeQue<half>();
        auto b2 = b2Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
        LoadData2DParams loadB{};
        loadB.repeatTimes = N / 16;
        loadB.srcStride = K / 16;
        loadB.ifTranspose = true;
        for (uint32_t kBlock = 0; kBlock < K / 16; ++kBlock) {
            LoadData(b2[kBlock * N * 16], b1[kBlock * 256], loadB);
        }
        b2Queue.EnQue(b2);
        b1Queue.FreeTensor(b1);
        b2 = b2Queue.DeQue<half>();
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < validRows; row += TILE_M) {
            const uint32_t currentRows = validRows - row < TILE_M ? validRows - row : TILE_M;
            auto a1 = a1Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
            Nd2NzParams copyA{};
            copyA.ndNum = 1;
            copyA.nValue = currentRows;
            copyA.dValue = K;
            copyA.srcDValue = K;
            copyA.dstNzC0Stride = TILE_M;
            copyA.dstNzNStride = 1;
            DataCopy(a1, a[row * K], copyA);
            a1Queue.EnQue(a1);
            a1 = a1Queue.DeQue<half>();
            auto a2 = a2Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
            LoadData2DParams loadA{};
            loadA.repeatTimes = K / 16;
            loadA.srcStride = TILE_M / 16;
            loadA.ifTranspose = false;
            for (uint32_t rowBlock = 0; rowBlock < TILE_M / 16; ++rowBlock) {
                LoadData(a2[rowBlock * K * 16], a1[rowBlock * 256], loadA);
            }
            a2Queue.EnQue(a2);
            a1Queue.FreeTensor(a1);
            a2 = a2Queue.DeQue<half>();
            auto c1 = c1Queue.AllocTensor<float>();
            MmadParams multiply{};
            multiply.m = (currentRows + 15) / 16 * 16;
            multiply.n = N;
            multiply.k = K;
            multiply.cmatrixInitVal = true;
            Mmad(c1, a2, b2, multiply);
            a2Queue.FreeTensor(a2);
            c1Queue.EnQue(c1);
            c1 = c1Queue.DeQue<float>();
            FixpipeParamsV220 copyC{};
            copyC.nSize = N;
            copyC.mSize = currentRows;
            copyC.srcStride = (currentRows + 15) / 16 * 16;
            copyC.dstStride = N;
            copyC.ndNum = 1;
            copyC.quantPre = QuantMode_t::NoQuant;
            Fixpipe(matrix[row * N], c1, copyC);
            CrossCoreSetFlag<0x2, PIPE_FIX>(row / TILE_M);
            c1Queue.FreeTensor(c1);
        }
        b2Queue.FreeTensor(b2);
    }
    if ASCEND_IS_AIV {
        TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 2> inputQueue;
        TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
        TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximumBuffer, tempBuffer, blockMaximumBuffer;
        pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 2, TILE_M * N * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, PARTIAL_STRIDE * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(maximumBuffer, ROWS * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(tempBuffer, (ROWS > params.rowTiles * PARTIAL_STRIDE
            ? ROWS : params.rowTiles * PARTIAL_STRIDE) * sizeof(float));
        // 64列完整向量的两级Max使用每行8个临时块最大值。
        pipe.InitBuffer(blockMaximumBuffer, TILE_M * 8 * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<float> scores;
        scores.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
        auto maxima = maximumBuffer.Get<float>();
        // 两个不同事件分别保护两段GM结果，防止同一事件被提前重复置位。
        for (uint32_t row = 0; row < validRows; row += TILE_M) {
            const uint32_t currentRows = validRows - row < TILE_M ? validRows - row : TILE_M;
            CrossCoreWaitFlag(row / TILE_M);
            auto input = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            DataCopy(input, matrix[row * N], currentRows * N);
            inputQueue.EnQue(input);
            input = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
            // 第一阶段64列缩为8个块最大值，第二阶段每8个值缩为一行最大值。
            // 批量阶段仅处理8行的整数倍；尾行沿用WholeReduceMax。
            const uint32_t blockRows = params.n == N ? currentRows / 8 * 8 : 0;
            if (blockRows > 0) {
                auto blockMaxima = blockMaximumBuffer.Get<float>();
                BlockReduceMax(blockMaxima, input, static_cast<int32_t>(blockRows),
                    64, 1, 1, 8);
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                BlockReduceMax(maxima[row], blockMaxima, static_cast<int32_t>(blockRows / 8),
                    64, 1, 1, 8);
                // 下一子块复用临时区前，确保本次读取已完成。
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            }
            if (blockRows < currentRows) {
                WholeReduceMax(maxima[row + blockRows], input[blockRows * N],
                    params.n, currentRows - blockRows, 1, 1, N / 8,
                    ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
            }
            inputQueue.FreeTensor(input);
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        Duplicate(result, 0.0f, PARTIAL_STRIDE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        ReduceSum(result, maxima, tempBuffer.Get<float>(), validRows);
        outputQueue.EnQue(result);
        result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        DataCopy(scores[task * PARTIAL_STRIDE], result, PARTIAL_STRIDE);
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
        SyncAll<true>();
        if (task == 0) {
            // 单batch按行片次序合并；每片独占一个对齐槽。
            const uint32_t count = params.rowTiles * PARTIAL_STRIDE;
            auto local = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            DataCopy(local, scores, count);
            inputQueue.EnQue(local);
            local = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
            auto finalResult = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            ReduceSum(finalResult, local, tempBuffer.Get<float>(), count);
            inputQueue.FreeTensor(local);
            outputQueue.EnQue(finalResult);
            finalResult = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
            GlobalTensor<float> output;
            output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
            DataCopyExtParams copy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
            DataCopyPad(output, finalResult, copy);
            outputQueue.FreeTensor(finalResult);
        }
    }
}


// TT矩阵完整A行片驻留L1，112列B分块限制L0C容量并与Vector归约流水。
template <uint32_t ROWS = 128, bool PREFETCH_B = false>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeResidentTT(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch,
    GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y, Parameters params)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    constexpr uint32_t TILE_N = 64, TILE_K = 128;
    const uint32_t PAD_K = (params.k + 15) / 16 * 16;
    const uint32_t task = GetBlockIdx();
    const uint32_t parts = params.cores / (params.batch * params.rowTiles);
    const uint32_t rowTask = task / parts;
    const uint32_t batch = rowTask / params.rowTiles;
    const uint32_t originalRow = (rowTask % params.rowTiles) * ROWS;
    const uint32_t columnTiles = (params.n + 511) / 512;
    const uint32_t firstN = columnTiles * (task % parts) / parts * 512;
    const uint32_t endN = columnTiles * (task % parts + 1) / parts * 512;
    const uint32_t validRows = params.m - originalRow < ROWS ? params.m - originalRow : ROWS;
    const uint32_t padRows = (validRows + 15) / 16 * 16;
    const uint32_t validN = (endN < params.n ? endN : params.n) - firstN;
    TPipe pipe;
    GlobalTensor<float> matrix;
    // 每个64列结果占独立连续GM槽，容量仍覆盖每片最多1024列。
    matrix.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch) + task * 2 * ROWS * 512);
    if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
        TQue<TPosition::A1, 1> a1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B1, PREFETCH_B ? 2 : 1> b1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::A2, 2> a2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B2, 2> b2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::CO1, 2> c1Queue;
        pipe.InitBuffer(a1Queue, 1, ROWS * PAD_K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b1Queue, PREFETCH_B ? 2 : 1, TILE_N * PAD_K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(a2Queue, 2, ROWS * TILE_K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b2Queue, 2, TILE_N * TILE_K * sizeof(bfloat16_t));
        pipe.InitBuffer(c1Queue, 2, ROWS * TILE_N * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<bfloat16_t> a, b;
        a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(x1) + static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.m * params.k);
        b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(x2) + static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.n * params.k);
        auto a1 = a1Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
        Nd2NzParams copyA{};
        copyA.ndNum = 1;
        copyA.nValue = params.k;
        copyA.dValue = validRows;
        copyA.srcDValue = params.m;
        copyA.dstNzC0Stride = PAD_K;
        copyA.dstNzNStride = 1;
        DataCopy(a1, a[originalRow], copyA);
        a1Queue.EnQue(a1);
        a1 = a1Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
        if constexpr (PREFETCH_B) {
            const uint32_t columns = validN < TILE_N ? validN : TILE_N;
            auto firstB = b1Queue.template AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
            Nd2NzParams firstCopy{};
            firstCopy.ndNum = 1;
            firstCopy.nValue = columns;
            firstCopy.dValue = params.k;
            firstCopy.srcDValue = params.k;
            firstCopy.dstNzC0Stride = (columns + 15) / 16 * 16;
            firstCopy.dstNzNStride = 1;
            DataCopy(firstB, b[firstN * params.k], firstCopy);
            b1Queue.EnQue(firstB);
        }
        for (uint32_t col = 0; col < validN; col += TILE_N) {
            const uint32_t columns = validN - col < TILE_N ? validN - col : TILE_N;
            const uint32_t padColumns = (columns + 15) / 16 * 16;
            if constexpr (!PREFETCH_B) {
                auto b1 = b1Queue.template AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
                Nd2NzParams copyB{};
                copyB.ndNum = 1;
                copyB.nValue = columns;
                copyB.dValue = params.k;
                copyB.srcDValue = params.k;
                copyB.dstNzC0Stride = padColumns;
                copyB.dstNzNStride = 1;
                DataCopy(b1, b[(firstN + col) * params.k], copyB);
                b1Queue.EnQue(b1);
            }
            auto b1 = b1Queue.template DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
            if constexpr (PREFETCH_B) {
                if (col + TILE_N < validN) {
                    // 当前B由MTE1消费，另一L1槽同时预取下一N块。
                    const uint32_t nextCol = col + TILE_N;
                    const uint32_t nextColumns = validN - nextCol < TILE_N ? validN - nextCol : TILE_N;
                    auto nextB = b1Queue.template AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
                    Nd2NzParams nextCopy{};
                    nextCopy.ndNum = 1;
                    nextCopy.nValue = nextColumns;
                    nextCopy.dValue = params.k;
                    nextCopy.srcDValue = params.k;
                    nextCopy.dstNzC0Stride = (nextColumns + 15) / 16 * 16;
                    nextCopy.dstNzNStride = 1;
                    DataCopy(nextB, b[(firstN + nextCol) * params.k], nextCopy);
                    b1Queue.EnQue(nextB);
                }
            }
            auto c1 = c1Queue.AllocTensor<float>();
            for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < params.k; offset += TILE_K) {
                const uint32_t validK = params.k - offset < TILE_K ? params.k - offset : TILE_K;
                const uint32_t currentK = (validK + 15) / 16 * 16;
                auto a2 = a2Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
                auto b2 = b2Queue.AllocTensor<bfloat16_t>();
                LoadData2DParams loadA{};
                loadA.repeatTimes = currentK / 16;
                loadA.srcStride = 1;
                loadA.ifTranspose = true;
                if (currentK == 16) {
                    // 单K分形沿行方向合并搬运，转置后的目的分形恰好连续。
                    loadA.repeatTimes = padRows / 16;
                    loadA.srcStride = PAD_K / 16;
                    LoadData(a2, a1[offset * 16], loadA);
                } else {
                    for (uint32_t rowBlock = 0; rowBlock < padRows / 16; ++rowBlock) {
                        LoadData(a2[rowBlock * currentK * 16],
                            a1[rowBlock * PAD_K * 16 + offset * 16], loadA);
                    }
                }
                LoadData2DParams loadB{};
                loadB.repeatTimes = currentK / 16 * (padColumns / 16);
                loadB.srcStride = 1;
                loadB.ifTranspose = false;
                LoadData(b2, b1[offset * padColumns], loadB);
                a2Queue.EnQue(a2);
                b2Queue.EnQue(b2);
                a2 = a2Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
                b2 = b2Queue.DeQue<bfloat16_t>();
                MmadParams multiply{};
                // M=1会启用ND格式GEMV；按补齐16行MMAD，Fixpipe仍仅写有效行。
                multiply.m = padRows;
                multiply.n = columns;
                // 只累加实际K；转置A的nValue尾部没有文档保证补零。
                multiply.k = validK;
                multiply.cmatrixInitVal = offset == 0;
                Mmad(c1, a2, b2, multiply);
                // 累加同一L0C前完成上一条MMAD，避免短尾块读写冲突。
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_M>();
                a2Queue.FreeTensor(a2);
                b2Queue.FreeTensor(b2);
            }
            b1Queue.FreeTensor(b1);
            c1Queue.EnQue(c1);
            c1 = c1Queue.DeQue<float>();
            FixpipeParamsV220 copyC{};
            copyC.nSize = columns;
            copyC.mSize = validRows;
            copyC.srcStride = padRows;
            copyC.dstStride = TILE_N;
            copyC.ndNum = 1;
            copyC.quantPre = QuantMode_t::NoQuant;
            Fixpipe(matrix[col * ROWS], c1, copyC);
            // 两个64列块共用一个完成事件；单片至多1024列，只用事件0至7。
            // 各块写入独立GM片段，通知之前的两次Fixpipe都须完成。
            if ((col / TILE_N) % 2 == 1 || col + TILE_N >= validN) {
                CrossCoreSetFlag<0x2, PIPE_FIX>(col / (2 * TILE_N));
            }
            c1Queue.FreeTensor(c1);
        }
        a1Queue.FreeTensor(a1);
    }
    if ASCEND_IS_AIV {
        TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
        TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
        TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximumBuffer, currentBuffer, tempBuffer;
        pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1, ROWS * TILE_N * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, ROWS * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(maximumBuffer, ROWS * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(currentBuffer, ROWS * sizeof(float));
        pipe.InitBuffer(tempBuffer, ROWS * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<float> scores;
        scores.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
        auto maxima = maximumBuffer.Get<float>();
        auto current = currentBuffer.Get<float>();
        auto temporary = tempBuffer.Get<float>();
        DataCopyPadExtParams<float> noPadding{false, 0, 0, 0};
        for (uint32_t col = 0; col < validN; col += TILE_N) {
            const uint32_t columns = validN - col < TILE_N ? validN - col : TILE_N;
            const uint32_t localStride = (columns + 7) / 8 * 8;
            if ((col / TILE_N) % 2 == 0) {
                CrossCoreWaitFlag(col / (2 * TILE_N));
            }
            auto input = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            if (columns == TILE_N) {
                // 完整块连续读取，避免逐行跨越整个N分片。
                DataCopy(input, matrix[col * ROWS], validRows * TILE_N);
            } else {
                DataCopyExtParams readCopy{static_cast<uint16_t>(validRows), columns * 4U,
                    (TILE_N - columns) * 4U, 0, 0};
                DataCopyPad(input, matrix[col * ROWS], readCopy, noPadding);
            }
            inputQueue.EnQue(input);
            input = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
            WholeReduceMax(current, input, columns < 64 ? columns : 64, validRows, 1, 1, localStride / 8,
                ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
            if (columns > 64) {
                WholeReduceMax(temporary, input[64], columns - 64, validRows, 1, 1,
                    localStride / 8, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                Max(current, current, temporary, validRows);
            }
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            if (col == 0) {
                Adds(maxima, current, 0.0f, validRows);
            } else {
                Max(maxima, maxima, current, validRows);
            }
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            inputQueue.FreeTensor(input);
        }
        auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        Duplicate(result, 0.0f, ROWS);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Adds(result, maxima, 0.0f, validRows);
        outputQueue.EnQue(result);
        result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        DataCopy(scores[task * ROWS], result, ROWS);
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
        SyncAll<true>();
        if (task == 0) {
            FinishSplitN<ROWS>(pipe, partial, y, params);
        }
    }
}

template <typename T, uint32_t BASE_ROWS, uint32_t BASE_COLS, bool TRANS_RIGHT>
__aicore__ constexpr auto MakeSwappedTTConfig()
{
    MatmulConfig config = CFG_MDL;
    config.enUnitFlag = true;
    config.enableMixDualMaster = true;
    config.basicM = BASE_ROWS;
    config.basicN = BASE_COLS;
    config.basicK = 64;
    config.enableSetBias = false;
    using InputA = AscendC::MatmulType<AscendC::TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, false>;
    using InputB = AscendC::MatmulType<AscendC::TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, TRANS_RIGHT>;
    using Output = AscendC::MatmulType<AscendC::TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>;
    return AscendC::GetMatmulApiTiling<InputA, InputB, Output, Output>(config);
}
template <typename T, uint32_t BASE_ROWS, uint32_t BASE_COLS, bool TRANS_RIGHT>
constexpr auto SWAPPED_TT_CONFIG = MakeSwappedTTConfig<T, BASE_ROWS, BASE_COLS, TRANS_RIGHT>();

// C'=C转置：原TT使用NN，原NT使用NT；对C'按行取Max得到原C的逐行Max。
// 只交换矩阵乘法的表示，不交换最终Max和Sum的数学顺序。
template <typename T, uint32_t ROWS, uint32_t BASE_ROWS, uint32_t BASE_COLS,
    bool TRANS_RIGHT = false>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeSwappedTT(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch,
    GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y, __kfc_workspace__ GM_ADDR workspace, Parameters params)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    constexpr uint32_t CHUNK_ROWS = ROWS > 128 ? 64 : 128;
    const uint32_t N_PART = params.tileCols;
    TPipe pipe;
    Matmul<MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, false>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, TRANS_RIGHT>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>, SWAPPED_TT_CONFIG<T, BASE_ROWS, BASE_COLS, TRANS_RIGHT>> mm;
    REGIST_MATMUL_OBJ(&pipe, GetSysWorkSpacePtr(), mm, &params.cube);
    const uint32_t parts = params.cores / params.rowTiles;
    const uint32_t task = GetBlockIdx();
    const uint32_t rowTask = task / parts;
    const uint32_t part = task % parts;
    const uint32_t originalRow = rowTask * ROWS;
    const uint32_t validOriginalRows = params.m - originalRow < ROWS ? params.m - originalRow : ROWS;
    const uint32_t columnTiles = (params.n + N_PART - 1) / N_PART;
    const uint32_t firstN = columnTiles * part / parts * N_PART;
    const uint32_t endNUnclamped = columnTiles * (part + 1) / parts * N_PART;
    const uint32_t endN = endNUnclamped < params.n ? endNUnclamped : params.n;
    const uint32_t validN = endN - firstN;
    GlobalTensor<T> physicalA;
    GlobalTensor<T> physicalB;
    GlobalTensor<float> matrix;
    GlobalTensor<float> scores;
    physicalA.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2));
    physicalB.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1));
    matrix.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch)
        + static_cast<uint64_t>(task) * (params.n > N_PART ? 2 : 1) * ROWS * N_PART);
    scores.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
    mm.SetOrgShape(params.n, params.m, params.k, params.k, ROWS);
    mm.SetTail(validN, validOriginalRows, params.k);
    mm.SetTensorA(physicalA[static_cast<uint64_t>(firstN) * params.k], false);
    mm.SetTensorB(physicalB[TRANS_RIGHT ? static_cast<uint64_t>(originalRow) * params.k : originalRow], TRANS_RIGHT);
    mm.template IterateAll<true>(matrix);
    mm.End();
    if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
        return;
    }
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 2> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximaBuffer;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 2, CHUNK_ROWS * ROWS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, ROWS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(maximaBuffer, ROWS * sizeof(float));
    auto maxima = maximaBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto initial = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    const uint32_t initialRows = validN < CHUNK_ROWS ? validN : CHUNK_ROWS;
    DataCopy(initial, matrix, initialRows * ROWS);
    inputQueue.EnQue(initial);
    for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < validN; offset += CHUNK_ROWS) {
        const uint32_t rows = validN - offset < CHUNK_ROWS ? validN - offset : CHUNK_ROWS;
        auto tile = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        const uint32_t nextOffset = offset + CHUNK_ROWS;
        if (nextOffset < validN) {
            auto next = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            const uint32_t nextRows = validN - nextOffset < CHUNK_ROWS ? validN - nextOffset : CHUNK_ROWS;
            DataCopy(next, matrix[nextOffset * ROWS], nextRows * ROWS);
            inputQueue.EnQue(next);
        }
        // 固定二叉树按N归约；奇数行保留中间未配对行，所有有效行恰好使用一次。
        for (uint32_t activeRows = rows; activeRows > 1;) {
            const uint32_t nextRows = (activeRows + 1) / 2;
            const uint32_t pairs = activeRows - nextRows;
            Max(tile, tile, tile[nextRows * ROWS], pairs * ROWS);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            activeRows = nextRows;
        }
        if (offset == 0) {
            Adds(maxima, tile, 0.0f, validOriginalRows);
        } else {
            Max(maxima, maxima, tile, validOriginalRows);
        }
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        inputQueue.FreeTensor(tile);
    }
    auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    if (parts > 1) {
        Duplicate(result, 0.0f, ROWS);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        Adds(result, maxima, 0.0f, validOriginalRows);
    } else {
        TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> sumTemp;
        pipe.InitBuffer(sumTemp, ROWS * sizeof(float));
        auto temporary = sumTemp.Get<float>();
        Duplicate(result, 0.0f, PARTIAL_STRIDE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        ReduceSum(result, maxima, temporary, validOriginalRows);
    }
    outputQueue.EnQue(result);
    result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
    if (parts > 1) {
        DataCopy(scores[task * ROWS], result, ROWS);
    } else {
        DataCopy(scores[task * PARTIAL_STRIDE], result, PARTIAL_STRIDE);
    }
    outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
    SyncAll<true>();
    if (task == 0) {
        if (parts > 1) {
            FinishSplitN<ROWS>(pipe, partial, y, params);
        } else {
            Finish(pipe, partial, y, params.rowTiles, params.batch);
        }
    }
}

template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B, bool SPLIT_N,
    uint32_t TILE_ROWS, uint32_t TILE_COLS, bool DIRECT_RESULT, bool STATIC_BASE,
    uint32_t BASIC_COLS = TILE_COLS, uint32_t BASIC_ROWS = TILE_ROWS>
__global__ __aicore__ void Compute(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch,
    GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y, __kfc_workspace__ GM_ADDR workspace, Parameters params)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    TPipe pipe;
    Matmul<MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, TRANS_A>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, TRANS_B>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>,
        KERNEL_MATMUL_CONFIG<T, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, BASIC_ROWS, BASIC_COLS, STATIC_BASE>> mm;
    // 专用参数绑定系统工作区；形参是用户区地址，不能作为 KFC 通信区。
    // 必须与编译器初始化的系统区使用同一地址，避免重复调用读取旧退出消息。
    REGIST_MATMUL_OBJ(&pipe, GetSysWorkSpacePtr(), mm, &params.cube);
    // 同次核调用的原始形状与输出行距不变，只发送一次KFC形状消息。
    // 必须在各列块的SetTail、SetTensorA和SetTensorB之前完成设置。
    mm.SetOrgShape(params.m, params.n, params.k, params.k, TILE_COLS);

    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> c;
    GlobalTensor<float> scores;
    GlobalTensor<float> finalOutput;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1));
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2));
    const uint32_t scratchTiles = params.n > TILE_COLS ? 2 : 1;
    c.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch)
        + GetBlockIdx() * scratchTiles * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS);
    scores.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
    finalOutput.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));

    if constexpr (COMPUTE_CONFIG<BASIC_ROWS, BASIC_COLS>.enableMixDualMaster) {
        if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
            // AIC按与AIV相同的任务/列块顺序运行；SDK的IterateAll等待AIV许可，
            // 完成FIXPIPE后通知AIV。无需另行占用跨核flag，UB归约仅在AIV执行。
            const uint32_t cubeParts = SPLIT_N ? params.cores / (params.batch * params.rowTiles) : 1;
            const uint32_t cubeTasks = params.batch * params.rowTiles * cubeParts;
            for (uint32_t task = GetBlockIdx(); task < cubeTasks; task += params.cores) {
                const uint32_t rowTask = task / cubeParts;
                const uint32_t columnTiles = (params.n + TILE_COLS - 1) / TILE_COLS;
                const uint32_t part = task % cubeParts;
                const uint32_t firstCol = (columnTiles * part / cubeParts) * TILE_COLS;
                const uint32_t endTileCol = (columnTiles * (part + 1) / cubeParts) * TILE_COLS;
                const uint32_t endCol = endTileCol < params.n ? endTileCol : params.n;
                const uint32_t batch = rowTask / params.rowTiles;
                const uint32_t rowStart = (rowTask % params.rowTiles) * TILE_ROWS;
                const uint32_t validRows = params.m - rowStart < TILE_ROWS ? params.m - rowStart : TILE_ROWS;
                const uint64_t aOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.m * params.k
                    + (TRANS_A ? rowStart : static_cast<uint64_t>(rowStart) * params.k);
                const uint64_t bOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.k * params.n;
                for (uint32_t colStart = firstCol; colStart < endCol; colStart += TILE_COLS) {
                    const uint32_t slot = ((colStart - firstCol) / TILE_COLS) % scratchTiles;
                    if (params.n > TILE_COLS) {
                        StartColumn<TILE_COLS, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, true>(mm, a, b,
                            c[slot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS], params, aOffset, bOffset, validRows, colStart);
                    } else {
                        StartColumn<TILE_COLS, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, false>(mm, a, b, c,
                            params, aOffset, bOffset, validRows, colStart);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    // 每个batch仅有一个行块且未按N分片时，本核已得到该batch的最终结果。
    // 通过MTE3按字节搬出独立float，不使用会整缓存行回写的GlobalTensor::SetValue。
    const bool directBatchOutput = !SPLIT_N
        && TILE_ROWS == DEFAULT_ROWS && TILE_COLS == DEFAULT_COLS
        && params.batch > 1 && params.rowTiles == 1;

    constexpr bool SEGMENT_REDUCTION = TILE_COLS > 256 || TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS > 32768;
    constexpr uint32_t REDUCTION_COLUMNS = TILE_ROWS > 128 ? 64 : 128;
    constexpr uint32_t INPUT_BUFFER_COUNT = SEGMENT_REDUCTION ? 2 : 1;
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, INPUT_BUFFER_COUNT> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> reduceBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> resultBuffer;
    constexpr uint32_t INPUT_COLS = SEGMENT_REDUCTION ? REDUCTION_COLUMNS : TILE_COLS;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, INPUT_BUFFER_COUNT, TILE_ROWS * INPUT_COLS * sizeof(float));
    constexpr uint32_t outputStride = SPLIT_N ? TILE_ROWS : PARTIAL_STRIDE;
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, outputStride * sizeof(float));
    constexpr uint32_t REDUCE_ELEMENTS = SEGMENT_REDUCTION ? TILE_ROWS
        : (TILE_COLS > 64 && TILE_ROWS > TILE_COLS ? TILE_ROWS : TILE_COLS);
    pipe.InitBuffer(reduceBuffer, REDUCE_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(resultBuffer, 2 * TILE_ROWS * sizeof(float));
    auto reduceTemp = reduceBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto reduced = resultBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto rowMax = reduced[TILE_ROWS];

    const uint32_t parts = SPLIT_N ? params.cores / (params.batch * params.rowTiles) : 1;
    const uint32_t tasks = params.batch * params.rowTiles * parts;
    for (uint32_t task = GetBlockIdx(); task < tasks; task += params.cores) {
        const uint32_t rowTask = task / parts;
        uint32_t firstCol = 0;
        uint32_t endCol = params.n;
        if (SPLIT_N) {
            const uint32_t part = task % parts;
            const uint32_t columnTiles = (params.n + TILE_COLS - 1) / TILE_COLS;
            firstCol = (columnTiles * part / parts) * TILE_COLS;
            const uint32_t endTileCol = (columnTiles * (part + 1) / parts) * TILE_COLS;
            endCol = endTileCol < params.n ? endTileCol : params.n;
        }
        const uint32_t batch = rowTask / params.rowTiles;
        const uint32_t rowStart = (rowTask % params.rowTiles) * TILE_ROWS;
        const uint32_t validRows = params.m - rowStart < TILE_ROWS ? params.m - rowStart : TILE_ROWS;
        const uint64_t aOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.m * params.k
            + (TRANS_A ? rowStart : static_cast<uint64_t>(rowStart) * params.k);
        const uint64_t bOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.k * params.n;
        // 多列块采用两个 GM 槽：当前块读回/归约时，Cube 计算下一块。
        if (params.n > TILE_COLS) {
            StartColumn<TILE_COLS, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, true>(mm, a, b, c, params,
                aOffset, bOffset, validRows, firstCol);
        }
        // K 的完整点积仍由 Cube 以 FP32 累加；N 分块之间只合并最大值。
        for (uint32_t colStart = firstCol; colStart < endCol; colStart += TILE_COLS) {
            const uint32_t validCols = params.n - colStart < TILE_COLS ? params.n - colStart : TILE_COLS;
            const uint32_t slot = ((colStart - firstCol) / TILE_COLS) % scratchTiles;
            if (params.n > TILE_COLS) {
                mm.WaitIterateAll();
            } else {
                StartColumn<TILE_COLS, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, false>(mm, a, b, c, params,
                    aOffset, bOffset, validRows, colStart);
            }
            mm.End();

            const uint32_t nextCol = colStart + TILE_COLS;
            if (nextCol < endCol) {
                const uint32_t nextSlot = (slot + 1) % scratchTiles;
                StartColumn<TILE_COLS, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, true>(mm, a, b,
                    c[nextSlot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS], params, aOffset, bOffset, validRows, nextCol);
            }
            if constexpr (SEGMENT_REDUCTION) {
                // 逻辑宽块在Matmul内复用A；AIV按128列分段读取，避免占满UB。
                // 先搬入首段；随后在归约当前段前发出下一段搬运。
                // 两个UB槽只在本列块内流水，列块末尾仍保留完整屏障。
                const uint32_t initialColumns = validCols < REDUCTION_COLUMNS
                    ? validCols : REDUCTION_COLUMNS;
                auto initialTile = inputQueue.template AllocTensor<float>();
                DataCopyExtParams initialCopy{static_cast<uint16_t>(validRows),
                    static_cast<uint32_t>(initialColumns * sizeof(float)),
                    static_cast<uint32_t>((TILE_COLS - initialColumns) * sizeof(float)), 0, 0};
                DataCopyPadExtParams<float> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
                DataCopyPad(initialTile, c[slot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS], initialCopy, padding);
                inputQueue.EnQue(initialTile);
                for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < validCols; offset += REDUCTION_COLUMNS) {
                    const uint32_t columns = validCols - offset < REDUCTION_COLUMNS
                        ? validCols - offset : REDUCTION_COLUMNS;
                    const uint32_t localColumns = (columns + 7) / 8 * 8;
                    auto tile = inputQueue.template DeQue<float>();
                    const uint32_t nextOffset = offset + REDUCTION_COLUMNS;
                    if (nextOffset < validCols) {
                        const uint32_t nextColumns = validCols - nextOffset < REDUCTION_COLUMNS
                            ? validCols - nextOffset : REDUCTION_COLUMNS;
                        auto nextTile = inputQueue.template AllocTensor<float>();
                        DataCopyExtParams nextCopy{static_cast<uint16_t>(validRows),
                            static_cast<uint32_t>(nextColumns * sizeof(float)),
                            static_cast<uint32_t>((TILE_COLS - nextColumns) * sizeof(float)), 0, 0};
                        DataCopyPad(nextTile, c[slot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS + nextOffset],
                            nextCopy, padding);
                        inputQueue.EnQue(nextTile);
                    }
                    if constexpr ((TILE_ROWS == 112 && TILE_COLS == 1024
                        && !TRANS_A && TRANS_B && !SPLIT_N)
                        || (TILE_ROWS == 128 && TILE_COLS == 1024
                            && TRANS_A && !TRANS_B && SPLIT_N)) {
                        // 每段128列先逐元素折成64列，只保留一次水平归约。
                        const uint8_t rowStride = static_cast<uint8_t>(localColumns / 8);
                        if (columns > 64) {
                            BinaryRepeatParams fold{1, 1, 1, rowStride, rowStride, rowStride};
                            Max(tile, tile, tile[64], columns - 64, validRows, fold);
                            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                        }
                        const uint32_t firstColumns = columns < 64 ? columns : 64;
                        WholeReduceMax(reduced, tile, firstColumns, validRows, 1, 1, rowStride,
                            ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    } else {
                        const uint32_t firstColumns = columns < 64 ? columns : 64;
                        const uint32_t rowStride = localColumns * sizeof(float) / 32;
                        if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 128) {
                            for (uint32_t rowOffset = 0; rowOffset < validRows; rowOffset += 128) {
                                const uint32_t rows = validRows - rowOffset < 128
                                    ? validRows - rowOffset : 128;
                                WholeReduceMax(reduced[rowOffset], tile[rowOffset * localColumns],
                                    firstColumns, rows, 1, 1, rowStride,
                                    ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                            }
                        } else {
                            WholeReduceMax(reduced, tile, firstColumns, validRows, 1, 1, rowStride,
                                ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                        }
                        if (columns > 64) {
                            if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 128) {
                                for (uint32_t rowOffset = 0; rowOffset < validRows; rowOffset += 128) {
                                    const uint32_t rows = validRows - rowOffset < 128
                                        ? validRows - rowOffset : 128;
                                    WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp[rowOffset],
                                        tile[rowOffset * localColumns + 64], columns - 64,
                                        rows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                                }
                            } else {
                                WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp, tile[64], columns - 64,
                                    validRows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                            }
                            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                            Max(reduced, reduced, reduceTemp, validRows);
                        }
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    }
                    // 第一段直接初始化，不能与0取Max，否则全负相似度会错误。
                    if (colStart == firstCol && offset == 0) {
                        Adds(rowMax, reduced, 0.0f, validRows);
                    } else {
                        Max(rowMax, rowMax, reduced, validRows);
                    }
                    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    inputQueue.FreeTensor(tile);
                }
            } else {
                auto tile = inputQueue.template AllocTensor<float>();
                DataCopy(tile, c[slot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS], validRows * TILE_COLS);
                inputQueue.EnQue(tile);
                // 上次使用同一 GM 槽的数据已完成搬运和归约，才会再次提交到该槽。
                tile = inputQueue.template DeQue<float>();
                // 每个 repeat 处理一行的至多64个float，行间跨度由列块宽度决定。
                // 只输出最值时 dstRepStride=1，结果连续存放，无须逐行经 Scalar 中转。
                const uint32_t halfColumns = TILE_COLS < 64 ? TILE_COLS : 64;
                const uint32_t firstColumns = validCols < halfColumns ? validCols : halfColumns;
                const uint32_t rowStride = TILE_COLS * sizeof(float) / 32;
                if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 128) {
                    // 高窄大行块分组发射，避免repeat次数达到256时溢出。
                    for (uint32_t rowOffset = 0; rowOffset < validRows; rowOffset += 128) {
                        const uint32_t rows = validRows - rowOffset < 128
                            ? validRows - rowOffset : 128;
                        WholeReduceMax(reduced[rowOffset], tile[rowOffset * TILE_COLS],
                            firstColumns, rows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                    }
                } else {
                    WholeReduceMax(reduced, tile, firstColumns, validRows, 1, 1, rowStride,
                        ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                }
                if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 128 && TILE_COLS > 64) {
                    // 256行分块的后续列段也按128行分组，避免repeat=256溢出。
                    for (uint32_t offset = halfColumns; offset < validCols; offset += halfColumns) {
                        const uint32_t columns = validCols - offset < halfColumns
                            ? validCols - offset : halfColumns;
                        for (uint32_t rowOffset = 0; rowOffset < validRows; rowOffset += 128) {
                            const uint32_t rows = validRows - rowOffset < 128
                                ? validRows - rowOffset : 128;
                            WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp[rowOffset], tile[rowOffset * TILE_COLS + offset],
                                columns, rows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                        }
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                        Max(reduced, reduced, reduceTemp, validRows);
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    }
                } else if constexpr (TILE_COLS > 128) {
                    // 每段至多64个float，加宽列块的最后一段只读有效列。
                    for (uint32_t offset = halfColumns; offset < validCols; offset += halfColumns) {
                        const uint32_t columns = validCols - offset < halfColumns
                            ? validCols - offset : halfColumns;
                        WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp, tile[offset], columns,
                            validRows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                        Max(reduced, reduced, reduceTemp, validRows);
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    }
                } else if (validCols > halfColumns) {
                    WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp, tile[halfColumns], validCols - halfColumns,
                        validRows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    Max(reduced, reduced, reduceTemp, validRows);
                }
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                // 第一块直接初始化，不能与0取Max，否则全负相似度会错误。
                if (colStart == firstCol) {
                    Adds(rowMax, reduced, 0.0f, validRows);
                } else {
                    Max(rowMax, rowMax, reduced, validRows);
                }
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                inputQueue.FreeTensor(tile);
            }
            // 诊断列块间状态复用：完成当前列块的全部流水后再推进下一轮。
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL>();
        }

        auto output = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        if (SPLIT_N) {
            // 每个分片独占一个完整行块槽，尾行补零仅用于写满槽，不参与最终 Max/Sum。
            Duplicate(output, 0.0f, TILE_ROWS);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            Adds(output, rowMax, 0.0f, validRows);
        } else {
            Duplicate(output, 0.0f, PARTIAL_STRIDE);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 64) {
                // 单条WholeReduceSum至多归约64个float，长行块使用多段归约API。
                ReduceSum(output, rowMax, reduceTemp, validRows);
            } else {
                WholeReduceSum(output, rowMax, static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1, 1, 1);
            }
        }
        outputQueue.EnQue(output);
        output = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        if (DIRECT_RESULT || directBatchOutput) {
            DataCopyExtParams copy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
            DataCopyPad(finalOutput[batch], output, copy);
        } else {
            DataCopy(scores[task * outputStride], output, outputStride);
        }
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(output);
    }

    if (DIRECT_RESULT || directBatchOutput) {
        return;
    }

    // 普通模式的AIC留在KFC服务循环，双主模式的AIC已执行完独立循环并返回。
    // 等待所有 Vector 核的局部结果落入 GM，再由 0 号核顺序完成最终归约。
    // 不能使用包含Cube的同步：普通模式的Cube仍在服务循环，双主模式已退出。
    if (params.cores > 1) {
        SyncAll<true>();
    } else {
        // 单核无需跨核屏障，但必须等待 partial 写回后才能读取。
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL>();
    }
    if (GetBlockIdx() == 0) {
        if (SPLIT_N) {
            FinishSplitN<TILE_ROWS, TILE_ROWS == 128 && TILE_COLS == 1024
                && TRANS_A && !TRANS_B>(pipe, partial, y, params);
        } else {
            Finish(pipe, partial, y, params.rowTiles, params.batch);
        }
    }
}


// 显式L1输入使用本地Cube实现，由当前kernel负责C/V交接。
constexpr MatmulConfig MakeResidentAConfig()
{
    MatmulConfig config = CFG_MDL;
    config.enableMixDualMaster = false;
    config.enUnitFlag = false;
    return config;
}
constexpr MatmulConfig RESIDENT_A_CONFIG = MakeResidentAConfig();

__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeResidentA(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch,
    GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y, __kfc_workspace__ GM_ADDR workspace, Parameters params)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    using T = bfloat16_t;
    constexpr bool TRANS_A = true, TRANS_B = false, SPLIT_N = true, DIRECT_RESULT = false;
    constexpr uint32_t TILE_ROWS = 128, TILE_COLS = 1024;
    TPipe pipe;
    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> c;
    GlobalTensor<float> scores;
    GlobalTensor<float> finalOutput;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1));
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2));
    const uint32_t scratchTiles = params.n > TILE_COLS ? 2 : 1;
    c.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch)
        + GetBlockIdx() * scratchTiles * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS);
    scores.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
    finalOutput.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));

    if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
        // A的L1分配由当前kernel持有，直到全部列块消费结束。
        TQue<TPosition::A1, 1> residentQueue;
        pipe.InitBuffer(residentQueue, 1, TILE_ROWS * params.k * sizeof(T));
        MatmulImpl<MatmulType<TPosition::TSCM, CubeFormat::NZ, T, true>,
            MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, false>,
            MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>,
            MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>, RESIDENT_A_CONFIG> mm;
        mm.Init(&params.cube, &pipe);
        mm.SetOrgShape(TILE_ROWS, params.n, params.k, params.k, TILE_COLS);
        const uint32_t parts = params.cores / (params.batch * params.rowTiles);
        const uint32_t task = GetBlockIdx();
        const uint32_t rowTask = task / parts;
        const uint32_t columnTiles = params.n / TILE_COLS;
        const uint32_t firstCol = (columnTiles * (task % parts) / parts) * TILE_COLS;
        const uint32_t endCol = (columnTiles * (task % parts + 1) / parts) * TILE_COLS;
        const uint32_t batch = rowTask / params.rowTiles;
        const uint32_t rowStart = (rowTask % params.rowTiles) * TILE_ROWS;
        auto localA = residentQueue.AllocTensor<T>();
        Nd2NzParams copyA{};
        copyA.ndNum = 1;
        copyA.nValue = params.k;
        copyA.dValue = TILE_ROWS;
        copyA.srcDValue = params.m;
        copyA.dstNzC0Stride = params.k;
        copyA.dstNzNStride = 1;
        DataCopy(localA, a[static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.m * params.k + rowStart], copyA);
        residentQueue.EnQue(localA);
        localA = residentQueue.DeQue<T>();
        uint32_t count = 0;
        for (uint32_t col = firstCol; col < endCol; col += TILE_COLS, ++count) {
            const uint32_t slot = count % 2;
            if (count >= 2) CrossCoreWaitFlag(10 + slot);
            mm.SetTail(TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS, params.k);
            mm.SetTensorA(localA, true);
            mm.SetTensorB(b[static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.k * params.n + col], false);
            mm.IterateAll<true>(c[slot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS]);
            mm.End();
            CrossCoreSetFlag<0x2, PIPE_FIX>(8 + slot);
        }
        for (uint32_t slot = 0; slot < 2 && slot < count; ++slot) CrossCoreWaitFlag(10 + slot);
        residentQueue.FreeTensor(localA);
        return;
    }

    // 每个batch仅有一个行块且未按N分片时，本核已得到该batch的最终结果。
    // 通过MTE3按字节搬出独立float，不使用会整缓存行回写的GlobalTensor::SetValue。
    const bool directBatchOutput = !SPLIT_N
        && TILE_ROWS == DEFAULT_ROWS && TILE_COLS == DEFAULT_COLS
        && params.batch > 1 && params.rowTiles == 1;

    constexpr bool SEGMENT_REDUCTION = TILE_COLS > 256 || TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS > 32768;
    constexpr uint32_t REDUCTION_COLUMNS = TILE_ROWS > 128 ? 64 : 128;
    constexpr uint32_t INPUT_BUFFER_COUNT = SEGMENT_REDUCTION ? 2 : 1;
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, INPUT_BUFFER_COUNT> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> reduceBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> resultBuffer;
    constexpr uint32_t INPUT_COLS = SEGMENT_REDUCTION ? REDUCTION_COLUMNS : TILE_COLS;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, INPUT_BUFFER_COUNT, TILE_ROWS * INPUT_COLS * sizeof(float));
    constexpr uint32_t outputStride = SPLIT_N ? TILE_ROWS : PARTIAL_STRIDE;
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, outputStride * sizeof(float));
    constexpr uint32_t REDUCE_ELEMENTS = SEGMENT_REDUCTION ? TILE_ROWS
        : (TILE_COLS > 64 && TILE_ROWS > TILE_COLS ? TILE_ROWS : TILE_COLS);
    pipe.InitBuffer(reduceBuffer, REDUCE_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(resultBuffer, 2 * TILE_ROWS * sizeof(float));
    auto reduceTemp = reduceBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto reduced = resultBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto rowMax = reduced[TILE_ROWS];

    const uint32_t parts = SPLIT_N ? params.cores / (params.batch * params.rowTiles) : 1;
    const uint32_t tasks = params.batch * params.rowTiles * parts;
    for (uint32_t task = GetBlockIdx(); task < tasks; task += params.cores) {
        const uint32_t rowTask = task / parts;
        uint32_t firstCol = 0;
        uint32_t endCol = params.n;
        if (SPLIT_N) {
            const uint32_t part = task % parts;
            const uint32_t columnTiles = (params.n + TILE_COLS - 1) / TILE_COLS;
            firstCol = (columnTiles * part / parts) * TILE_COLS;
            const uint32_t endTileCol = (columnTiles * (part + 1) / parts) * TILE_COLS;
            endCol = endTileCol < params.n ? endTileCol : params.n;
        }
        const uint32_t batch = rowTask / params.rowTiles;
        const uint32_t rowStart = (rowTask % params.rowTiles) * TILE_ROWS;
        const uint32_t validRows = params.m - rowStart < TILE_ROWS ? params.m - rowStart : TILE_ROWS;
        const uint64_t aOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.m * params.k
            + (TRANS_A ? rowStart : static_cast<uint64_t>(rowStart) * params.k);
        const uint64_t bOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.k * params.n;
        // K 的完整点积仍由 Cube 以 FP32 累加；N 分块之间只合并最大值。
        for (uint32_t colStart = firstCol; colStart < endCol; colStart += TILE_COLS) {
            const uint32_t validCols = params.n - colStart < TILE_COLS ? params.n - colStart : TILE_COLS;
            const uint32_t slot = ((colStart - firstCol) / TILE_COLS) % scratchTiles;
            CrossCoreWaitFlag(8 + slot);
            if constexpr (SEGMENT_REDUCTION) {
                // 逻辑宽块在Matmul内复用A；AIV按128列分段读取，避免占满UB。
                // 先搬入首段；随后在归约当前段前发出下一段搬运。
                // 两个UB槽只在本列块内流水，列块末尾仍保留完整屏障。
                const uint32_t initialColumns = validCols < REDUCTION_COLUMNS
                    ? validCols : REDUCTION_COLUMNS;
                auto initialTile = inputQueue.template AllocTensor<float>();
                DataCopyExtParams initialCopy{static_cast<uint16_t>(validRows),
                    static_cast<uint32_t>(initialColumns * sizeof(float)),
                    static_cast<uint32_t>((TILE_COLS - initialColumns) * sizeof(float)), 0, 0};
                DataCopyPadExtParams<float> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
                DataCopyPad(initialTile, c[slot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS], initialCopy, padding);
                inputQueue.EnQue(initialTile);
                for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < validCols; offset += REDUCTION_COLUMNS) {
                    const uint32_t columns = validCols - offset < REDUCTION_COLUMNS
                        ? validCols - offset : REDUCTION_COLUMNS;
                    const uint32_t localColumns = (columns + 7) / 8 * 8;
                    auto tile = inputQueue.template DeQue<float>();
                    const uint32_t nextOffset = offset + REDUCTION_COLUMNS;
                    if (nextOffset < validCols) {
                        const uint32_t nextColumns = validCols - nextOffset < REDUCTION_COLUMNS
