                            ? validCols - nextOffset : REDUCTION_COLUMNS;
                        auto nextTile = inputQueue.template AllocTensor<float>();
                        DataCopyExtParams nextCopy{static_cast<uint16_t>(validRows),
                            static_cast<uint32_t>(nextColumns * sizeof(float)),
                            static_cast<uint32_t>((TILE_COLS - nextColumns) * sizeof(float)), 0, 0};
                        DataCopyPad(nextTile, c[slot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS + nextOffset],
                            nextCopy, padding);
                        inputQueue.EnQue(nextTile);
                    }
                    if constexpr ((TILE_ROWS == 112 && TILE_COLS == 1024
                        && !TRANS_A && TRANS_B && !SPLIT_N)
                        || (TILE_ROWS == 128 && TILE_COLS == 1024
                            && TRANS_A && !TRANS_B && SPLIT_N)) {
                        // 每段128列先逐元素折成64列，只保留一次水平归约。
                        const uint8_t rowStride = static_cast<uint8_t>(localColumns / 8);
                        if (columns > 64) {
                            BinaryRepeatParams fold{1, 1, 1, rowStride, rowStride, rowStride};
                            Max(tile, tile, tile[64], columns - 64, validRows, fold);
                            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                        }
                        const uint32_t firstColumns = columns < 64 ? columns : 64;
                        WholeReduceMax(reduced, tile, firstColumns, validRows, 1, 1, rowStride,
                            ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    } else {
                        const uint32_t firstColumns = columns < 64 ? columns : 64;
                        const uint32_t rowStride = localColumns * sizeof(float) / 32;
                        if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 128) {
                            for (uint32_t rowOffset = 0; rowOffset < validRows; rowOffset += 128) {
                                const uint32_t rows = validRows - rowOffset < 128
                                    ? validRows - rowOffset : 128;
                                WholeReduceMax(reduced[rowOffset], tile[rowOffset * localColumns],
                                    firstColumns, rows, 1, 1, rowStride,
                                    ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                            }
                        } else {
                            WholeReduceMax(reduced, tile, firstColumns, validRows, 1, 1, rowStride,
                                ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                        }
                        if (columns > 64) {
                            if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 128) {
                                for (uint32_t rowOffset = 0; rowOffset < validRows; rowOffset += 128) {
                                    const uint32_t rows = validRows - rowOffset < 128
                                        ? validRows - rowOffset : 128;
                                    WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp[rowOffset],
                                        tile[rowOffset * localColumns + 64], columns - 64,
                                        rows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                                }
                            } else {
                                WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp, tile[64], columns - 64,
                                    validRows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                            }
                            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                            Max(reduced, reduced, reduceTemp, validRows);
                        }
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    }
                    // 第一段直接初始化，不能与0取Max，否则全负相似度会错误。
                    if (colStart == firstCol && offset == 0) {
                        Adds(rowMax, reduced, 0.0f, validRows);
                    } else {
                        Max(rowMax, rowMax, reduced, validRows);
                    }
                    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    inputQueue.FreeTensor(tile);
                }
            } else {
                auto tile = inputQueue.template AllocTensor<float>();
                DataCopy(tile, c[slot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS], validRows * TILE_COLS);
                inputQueue.EnQue(tile);
                // 上次使用同一 GM 槽的数据已完成搬运和归约，才会再次提交到该槽。
                tile = inputQueue.template DeQue<float>();
                // 每个 repeat 处理一行的至多64个float，行间跨度由列块宽度决定。
                // 只输出最值时 dstRepStride=1，结果连续存放，无须逐行经 Scalar 中转。
                const uint32_t halfColumns = TILE_COLS < 64 ? TILE_COLS : 64;
                const uint32_t firstColumns = validCols < halfColumns ? validCols : halfColumns;
                const uint32_t rowStride = TILE_COLS * sizeof(float) / 32;
                if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 128) {
                    // 高窄大行块分组发射，避免repeat次数达到256时溢出。
                    for (uint32_t rowOffset = 0; rowOffset < validRows; rowOffset += 128) {
                        const uint32_t rows = validRows - rowOffset < 128
                            ? validRows - rowOffset : 128;
                        WholeReduceMax(reduced[rowOffset], tile[rowOffset * TILE_COLS],
                            firstColumns, rows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                    }
                } else {
                    WholeReduceMax(reduced, tile, firstColumns, validRows, 1, 1, rowStride,
                        ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                }
                if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 128 && TILE_COLS > 64) {
                    // 256行分块的后续列段也按128行分组，避免repeat=256溢出。
                    for (uint32_t offset = halfColumns; offset < validCols; offset += halfColumns) {
                        const uint32_t columns = validCols - offset < halfColumns
                            ? validCols - offset : halfColumns;
                        for (uint32_t rowOffset = 0; rowOffset < validRows; rowOffset += 128) {
                            const uint32_t rows = validRows - rowOffset < 128
                                ? validRows - rowOffset : 128;
                            WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp[rowOffset], tile[rowOffset * TILE_COLS + offset],
                                columns, rows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                        }
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                        Max(reduced, reduced, reduceTemp, validRows);
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    }
                } else if constexpr (TILE_COLS > 128) {
                    // 每段至多64个float，加宽列块的最后一段只读有效列。
                    for (uint32_t offset = halfColumns; offset < validCols; offset += halfColumns) {
                        const uint32_t columns = validCols - offset < halfColumns
                            ? validCols - offset : halfColumns;
                        WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp, tile[offset], columns,
                            validRows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                        Max(reduced, reduced, reduceTemp, validRows);
                        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    }
                } else if (validCols > halfColumns) {
                    WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp, tile[halfColumns], validCols - halfColumns,
                        validRows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                    Max(reduced, reduced, reduceTemp, validRows);
                }
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                // 第一块直接初始化，不能与0取Max，否则全负相似度会错误。
                if (colStart == firstCol) {
                    Adds(rowMax, reduced, 0.0f, validRows);
                } else {
                    Max(rowMax, rowMax, reduced, validRows);
                }
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                inputQueue.FreeTensor(tile);
            }
            // 诊断列块间状态复用：完成当前列块的全部流水后再推进下一轮。
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL>();
            CrossCoreSetFlag<0x2, PIPE_MTE2>(10 + slot);
        }

        auto output = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        if (SPLIT_N) {
            // 每个分片独占一个完整行块槽，尾行补零仅用于写满槽，不参与最终 Max/Sum。
            Duplicate(output, 0.0f, TILE_ROWS);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            Adds(output, rowMax, 0.0f, validRows);
        } else {
            Duplicate(output, 0.0f, PARTIAL_STRIDE);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            if constexpr (TILE_ROWS > 64) {
                // 单条WholeReduceSum至多归约64个float，长行块使用多段归约API。
                ReduceSum(output, rowMax, reduceTemp, validRows);
            } else {
                WholeReduceSum(output, rowMax, static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1, 1, 1);
            }
        }
        outputQueue.EnQue(output);
        output = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        if (DIRECT_RESULT || directBatchOutput) {
            DataCopyExtParams copy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
            DataCopyPad(finalOutput[batch], output, copy);
        } else {
            DataCopy(scores[task * outputStride], output, outputStride);
        }
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(output);
    }

    if (DIRECT_RESULT || directBatchOutput) {
        return;
    }

    // 普通模式的AIC留在KFC服务循环，双主模式的AIC已执行完独立循环并返回。
    // 等待所有 Vector 核的局部结果落入 GM，再由 0 号核顺序完成最终归约。
    // 不能使用包含Cube的同步：普通模式的Cube仍在服务循环，双主模式已退出。
    if (params.cores > 1) {
        SyncAll<true>();
    } else {
        // 单核无需跨核屏障，但必须等待 partial 写回后才能读取。
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL>();
    }
    if (GetBlockIdx() == 0) {
        if (SPLIT_N) {
            FinishSplitN<TILE_ROWS, TILE_ROWS == 128 && TILE_COLS == 1024
                && TRANS_A && !TRANS_B>(pipe, partial, y, params);
        } else {
            Finish(pipe, partial, y, params.rowTiles, params.batch);
        }
    }
}


// 冷路径统一32×128块；N分片与直接输出仅由tiling参数选择。
// 计算、双GM槽、反向屏障与先Max后Sum的顺序沿用已验证实现。
template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeGeneric(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch,
    GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y, __kfc_workspace__ GM_ADDR workspace, GenericParameters generic)
{
    constexpr uint32_t TILE_ROWS = DEFAULT_ROWS;
    constexpr uint32_t TILE_COLS = DEFAULT_COLS;
    constexpr bool STATIC_BASE = false;
    auto& params = generic.base;
    const bool splitN = generic.splitN != 0;
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    TPipe pipe;
    Matmul<MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, TRANS_A>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, TRANS_B>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>,
        KERNEL_MATMUL_CONFIG<T, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS, STATIC_BASE>> mm;
    // 专用参数绑定系统工作区；形参是用户区地址，不能作为 KFC 通信区。
    // 必须与编译器初始化的系统区使用同一地址，避免重复调用读取旧退出消息。
    REGIST_MATMUL_OBJ(&pipe, GetSysWorkSpacePtr(), mm, &params.cube);
    // 同次核调用的原始形状与输出行距不变，只发送一次KFC形状消息。
    // 必须在各列块的SetTail、SetTensorA和SetTensorB之前完成设置。
    mm.SetOrgShape(params.m, params.n, params.k, params.k, TILE_COLS);

    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> c;
    GlobalTensor<float> scores;
    GlobalTensor<float> finalOutput;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1));
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2));
    const uint32_t scratchTiles = params.n > TILE_COLS ? 2 : 1;
    c.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch)
        + GetBlockIdx() * scratchTiles * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS);
    scores.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
    finalOutput.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));

    if constexpr (COMPUTE_CONFIG<TILE_ROWS, TILE_COLS>.enableMixDualMaster) {
        if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
            // AIC按与AIV相同的任务/列块顺序运行；SDK的IterateAll等待AIV许可，
            // 完成FIXPIPE后通知AIV。无需另行占用跨核flag，UB归约仅在AIV执行。
            const uint32_t cubeParts = generic.parts;
            const uint32_t cubeTasks = params.batch * params.rowTiles * cubeParts;
            for (uint32_t task = GetBlockIdx(); task < cubeTasks; task += params.cores) {
                const uint32_t rowTask = task / cubeParts;
                const uint32_t columnTiles = (params.n + TILE_COLS - 1) / TILE_COLS;
                const uint32_t part = task % cubeParts;
                const uint32_t firstCol = (columnTiles * part / cubeParts) * TILE_COLS;
                const uint32_t endTileCol = (columnTiles * (part + 1) / cubeParts) * TILE_COLS;
                const uint32_t endCol = endTileCol < params.n ? endTileCol : params.n;
                const uint32_t batch = rowTask / params.rowTiles;
                const uint32_t rowStart = (rowTask % params.rowTiles) * TILE_ROWS;
                const uint32_t validRows = params.m - rowStart < TILE_ROWS ? params.m - rowStart : TILE_ROWS;
                const uint64_t aOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.m * params.k
                    + (TRANS_A ? rowStart : static_cast<uint64_t>(rowStart) * params.k);
                const uint64_t bOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.k * params.n;
                for (uint32_t colStart = firstCol; colStart < endCol; colStart += TILE_COLS) {
                    const uint32_t slot = ((colStart - firstCol) / TILE_COLS) % scratchTiles;
                    if (params.n > TILE_COLS) {
                        StartColumn<TILE_COLS, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, true>(mm, a, b,
                            c[slot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS], params, aOffset, bOffset, validRows, colStart);
                    } else {
                        StartColumn<TILE_COLS, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, false>(mm, a, b, c,
                            params, aOffset, bOffset, validRows, colStart);
                    }
                }
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    // 每个batch仅有一个行块且未按N分片时，本核已得到该batch的最终结果。
    // 通过MTE3按字节搬出独立float，不使用会整缓存行回写的GlobalTensor::SetValue。
    const bool directOutput = generic.directOutput != 0;

    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> reduceBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> resultBuffer;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1, TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS * sizeof(float));
    const uint32_t outputStride = generic.partialStride;
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, outputStride * sizeof(float));
    constexpr uint32_t REDUCE_ELEMENTS = TILE_COLS > 64 && TILE_ROWS > TILE_COLS
        ? TILE_ROWS : TILE_COLS;
    pipe.InitBuffer(reduceBuffer, REDUCE_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(resultBuffer, 2 * TILE_ROWS * sizeof(float));
    auto reduceTemp = reduceBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto reduced = resultBuffer.Get<float>();
    auto rowMax = reduced[TILE_ROWS];

    const uint32_t parts = generic.parts;
    const uint32_t tasks = params.batch * params.rowTiles * parts;
    for (uint32_t task = GetBlockIdx(); task < tasks; task += params.cores) {
        const uint32_t rowTask = task / parts;
        uint32_t firstCol = 0;
        uint32_t endCol = params.n;
        if (splitN) {
            const uint32_t part = task % parts;
            const uint32_t columnTiles = (params.n + TILE_COLS - 1) / TILE_COLS;
            firstCol = (columnTiles * part / parts) * TILE_COLS;
            const uint32_t endTileCol = (columnTiles * (part + 1) / parts) * TILE_COLS;
            endCol = endTileCol < params.n ? endTileCol : params.n;
        }
        const uint32_t batch = rowTask / params.rowTiles;
        const uint32_t rowStart = (rowTask % params.rowTiles) * TILE_ROWS;
        const uint32_t validRows = params.m - rowStart < TILE_ROWS ? params.m - rowStart : TILE_ROWS;
        const uint64_t aOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.m * params.k
            + (TRANS_A ? rowStart : static_cast<uint64_t>(rowStart) * params.k);
        const uint64_t bOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * params.k * params.n;
        // 多列块采用两个 GM 槽：当前块读回/归约时，Cube 计算下一块。
        if (params.n > TILE_COLS) {
            StartColumn<TILE_COLS, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, true>(mm, a, b, c, params,
                aOffset, bOffset, validRows, firstCol);
        }
        // K 的完整点积仍由 Cube 以 FP32 累加；N 分块之间只合并最大值。
        for (uint32_t colStart = firstCol; colStart < endCol; colStart += TILE_COLS) {
            const uint32_t validCols = params.n - colStart < TILE_COLS ? params.n - colStart : TILE_COLS;
            const uint32_t slot = ((colStart - firstCol) / TILE_COLS) % scratchTiles;
            if (params.n > TILE_COLS) {
                mm.WaitIterateAll();
            } else {
                StartColumn<TILE_COLS, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, false>(mm, a, b, c, params,
                    aOffset, bOffset, validRows, colStart);
            }
            mm.End();

            auto tile = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            DataCopy(tile, c[slot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS], validRows * TILE_COLS);
            inputQueue.EnQue(tile);
            const uint32_t nextCol = colStart + TILE_COLS;
            if (nextCol < endCol) {
                const uint32_t nextSlot = (slot + 1) % scratchTiles;
                StartColumn<TILE_COLS, TRANS_A, TRANS_B, true>(mm, a, b,
                    c[nextSlot * TILE_ROWS * TILE_COLS], params, aOffset, bOffset, validRows, nextCol);
            }
            // 上次使用同一 GM 槽的数据已完成搬运和归约，才会再次提交到该槽。
            tile = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
            // 每个 repeat 处理一行的至多64个float，行间跨度由列块宽度决定。
            // 只输出最值时 dstRepStride=1，结果连续存放，无须逐行经 Scalar 中转。
            const uint32_t halfColumns = TILE_COLS < 64 ? TILE_COLS : 64;
            const uint32_t firstColumns = validCols < halfColumns ? validCols : halfColumns;
            const uint32_t rowStride = TILE_COLS * sizeof(float) / 32;
            WholeReduceMax(reduced, tile, firstColumns, validRows, 1, 1, rowStride,
                ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
            if (validCols > halfColumns) {
                WholeReduceMax(reduceTemp, tile[halfColumns], validCols - halfColumns,
                    validRows, 1, 1, rowStride, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                Max(reduced, reduced, reduceTemp, validRows);
            }
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            // 第一块直接初始化，不能与0取Max，否则全负相似度会错误。
            if (colStart == firstCol) {
                Adds(rowMax, reduced, 0.0f, validRows);
            } else {
                Max(rowMax, rowMax, reduced, validRows);
            }
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            inputQueue.FreeTensor(tile);
            // 诊断列块间状态复用：完成当前列块的全部流水后再推进下一轮。
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL>();
        }

        auto output = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        if (splitN) {
            // 每个分片独占一个完整行块槽，尾行补零仅用于写满槽，不参与最终 Max/Sum。
            Duplicate(output, 0.0f, TILE_ROWS);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            Adds(output, rowMax, 0.0f, validRows);
        } else {
            Duplicate(output, 0.0f, PARTIAL_STRIDE);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            WholeReduceSum(output, rowMax, static_cast<int32_t>(validRows), 1, 1, 1, 1);
        }
        outputQueue.EnQue(output);
        output = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        if (directOutput) {
            DataCopyExtParams copy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
            DataCopyPad(finalOutput[batch], output, copy);
        } else {
            DataCopy(scores[task * outputStride], output, outputStride);
        }
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(output);
    }

    if (directOutput) {
        return;
    }

    // 普通模式的AIC留在KFC服务循环，双主模式的AIC已执行完独立循环并返回。
    // 等待所有 Vector 核的局部结果落入 GM，再由 0 号核顺序完成最终归约。
    // 不能使用包含Cube的同步：普通模式的Cube仍在服务循环，双主模式已退出。
    if (params.cores > 1) {
        SyncAll<true>();
    } else {
        // 单核无需跨核屏障，但必须等待 partial 写回后才能读取。
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL>();
    }
    if (GetBlockIdx() == 0) {
        if (splitN) {
            FinishSplitN<TILE_ROWS>(pipe, partial, y, params);
        } else {
            Finish(pipe, partial, y, params.rowTiles, params.batch);
        }
    }
}


__aicore__ constexpr auto MakeSplitKDualConfig()
{
    MatmulConfig config = CFG_NORM;
    config.enableMixDualMaster = true;
    config.basicM = 64;
    config.basicN = 64;
    config.basicK = 256;
    config.enableSetBias = false;
    using AType = AscendC::MatmulType<AscendC::TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, half, true>;
    using BType = AscendC::MatmulType<AscendC::TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, half, true>;
    using CType = AscendC::MatmulType<AscendC::TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>;
    auto tiling = AscendC::GetMatmulApiTiling<AType, BType, CType, CType>(config);
    return tiling;
}
constexpr auto SPLIT_K_DUAL_CONFIG = MakeSplitKDualConfig();

// 小输出大K矩阵按K分片，所有分片的逐元素FP32和完成后才允许归约N。
template <typename T, bool TRANS_A, bool TRANS_B>
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeSplitK(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch,
    GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y, __kfc_workspace__ GM_ADDR workspace, Parameters params)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    constexpr uint32_t SIDE = 64;
    constexpr uint32_t MATRIX_ELEMENTS = SIDE * SIDE;
    TPipe pipe;
    Matmul<MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, TRANS_A>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, T, TRANS_B>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>,
        MatmulType<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float>, SPLIT_K_DUAL_CONFIG> mm;
    REGIST_MATMUL_OBJ(&pipe, GetSysWorkSpacePtr(), mm, &params.cube);

    const uint32_t part = GetBlockIdx();
    const uint32_t partK = ((params.k + params.cores - 1) / params.cores + 15) / 16 * 16;
    const uint32_t firstK = part * partK;
    const uint32_t validK = params.k - firstK < partK ? params.k - firstK : partK;
    GlobalTensor<T> a;
    GlobalTensor<T> b;
    GlobalTensor<float> partialDots;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x1));
    b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ T*>(x2));
    partialDots.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
    const uint64_t aOffset = TRANS_A ? static_cast<uint64_t>(firstK) * params.m : firstK;
    const uint64_t bOffset = TRANS_B ? firstK : static_cast<uint64_t>(firstK) * params.n;
    // 原始K仍作为输入行距；SetTail只限定本片参与点积的K长度。
    mm.SetOrgShape(params.m, params.n, params.k, params.k, SIDE);
    mm.SetTail(params.m, params.n, validK);
    mm.SetTensorA(a[aOffset], TRANS_A);
    mm.SetTensorB(b[bOffset], TRANS_B);
    mm.template IterateAll<true>(partialDots[part * MATRIX_ELEMENTS]);
    mm.End();
    // 双主模式的Cube执行完本片后退出；后续只由Vector合并。
    if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
        return;
    }

    // 各Vector按行分工合并K片，逐元素加法顺序仍由片0到片末。
    SyncAll<true>();
    const uint32_t rowsPerCore = (params.m + params.cores - 1) / params.cores;
    const uint32_t firstRow = part * rowsPerCore;
    const uint32_t validRows = firstRow < params.m
        ? (params.m - firstRow < rowsPerCore ? params.m - firstRow : rowsPerCore) : 0;
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> accumulatedBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximaBuffer;
    constexpr uint32_t MERGE_GROUP = 8;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1, MERGE_GROUP * MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 32);
    pipe.InitBuffer(accumulatedBuffer, MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(maximaBuffer, SIDE * sizeof(float));
    GlobalTensor<float> rowSums;
    rowSums.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
    auto accumulated = accumulatedBuffer.Get<float>();
    const uint32_t count = validRows * SIDE;
    if (validRows > 0) {
        Duplicate(accumulated, 0.0f, count);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        for (uint32_t sourcePart = 0; sourcePart < params.cores; sourcePart += MERGE_GROUP) {
            const uint32_t remainingParts = params.cores - sourcePart;
            const uint32_t groupParts = remainingParts < MERGE_GROUP ? remainingParts : MERGE_GROUP;
            auto local = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            DataCopyParams copyParts{
                static_cast<uint16_t>(groupParts),
                static_cast<uint16_t>(count * sizeof(float) / 32),
                static_cast<uint16_t>((MATRIX_ELEMENTS - count) * sizeof(float) / 32), 0};
            DataCopy(local, partialDots[sourcePart * MATRIX_ELEMENTS + firstRow * SIDE], copyParts);
            inputQueue.EnQue(local);
            local = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
            for (uint32_t groupPart = 0; groupPart < groupParts; ++groupPart) {
                Add(accumulated, accumulated, local[groupPart * count], count);
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            }
            inputQueue.FreeTensor(local);
        }
    }
    auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    if (validRows > 0) {
        auto maxima = maximaBuffer.Get<float>();
        WholeReduceMax(maxima, accumulated, params.n, validRows, 1, 1,
            SIDE * sizeof(float) / 32, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        WholeReduceSum(result, maxima, validRows, 1, 1, 1, 1);
    } else {
        Duplicate(result, 0.0f, 8);
    }
    outputQueue.EnQue(result);
    result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
    DataCopyExtParams copy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(rowSums[part], result, copy);
    outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
    SyncAll<true>();
    if (part == 0) {
        auto local = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        DataCopyExtParams read{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(params.cores * sizeof(float)), 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPadExtParams<float> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPad(local, rowSums, read, padding);
        inputQueue.EnQue(local);
        local = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        WholeReduceSum(result, local, params.cores, 1, 1, 1, 1);
        outputQueue.EnQue(result);
        result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        DataCopyPad(output, result, copy);
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
        inputQueue.FreeTensor(local);
    }
}


// 小输出长K按L1容量分片，K256双缓冲计算，FP32确定性合并后Max/Sum。
__global__ __aicore__ void ComputeSplitKResidentTT(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch,
    GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y, Parameters params)
{
    KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1);
    using namespace AscendC;
    constexpr uint32_t SIDE = 64;
    constexpr uint32_t MATRIX_ELEMENTS = SIDE * SIDE;
    const uint32_t FULL_K = params.k;
    const uint32_t PART_K = ((params.k + params.cores - 1) / params.cores + 15) / 16 * 16;
    constexpr uint32_t TILE_K = 256;
    TPipe pipe;
    const uint32_t part = GetBlockIdx();
    const uint32_t firstK = part * PART_K;
    const uint32_t validK = FULL_K - firstK < PART_K ? FULL_K - firstK : PART_K;
    const uint32_t paddedK = (validK + 15) / 16 * 16;
    GlobalTensor<float> partialDots;
    GlobalTensor<float> output;
    partialDots.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(scratch));
    output.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(y));
    if ASCEND_IS_AIC {
        TQue<TPosition::A1, 1> a1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B1, 1> b1Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::A2, 2> a2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::B2, 2> b2Queue;
        TQue<TPosition::CO1, 1> c1Queue;
        pipe.InitBuffer(a1Queue, 1, SIDE * PART_K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b1Queue, 1, SIDE * PART_K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(a2Queue, 2, SIDE * TILE_K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(b2Queue, 2, SIDE * TILE_K * sizeof(half));
        pipe.InitBuffer(c1Queue, 1, MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
        GlobalTensor<half> a, b;
        a.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ half*>(x1) + firstK * params.m);
        b.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ half*>(x2) + firstK);
        auto a1 = a1Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
        auto b1 = b1Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
        Nd2NzParams copyA{};
        copyA.ndNum = 1;
        copyA.nValue = validK;
        copyA.dValue = params.m;
        copyA.srcDValue = params.m;
        copyA.dstNzC0Stride = paddedK;
        copyA.dstNzNStride = 1;
        Nd2NzParams copyB{};
        copyB.ndNum = 1;
        copyB.nValue = params.n;
        copyB.dValue = validK;
        copyB.srcDValue = FULL_K;
        copyB.dstNzC0Stride = SIDE;
        copyB.dstNzNStride = 1;
        DataCopy(a1, a, copyA);
        DataCopy(b1, b, copyB);
        a1Queue.EnQue(a1);
        b1Queue.EnQue(b1);
        a1 = a1Queue.DeQue<half>();
        b1 = b1Queue.DeQue<half>();
        auto c1 = c1Queue.AllocTensor<float>();
        for (uint32_t piece = 0; piece * TILE_K < validK; ++piece) {
            const uint32_t actualK = validK - piece * TILE_K < TILE_K ? validK - piece * TILE_K : TILE_K;
            const uint32_t localK = (actualK + 15) / 16 * 16;
            auto a2 = a2Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
            auto b2 = b2Queue.AllocTensor<half>();
            LoadData2DParams loadA{};
            loadA.repeatTimes = localK / 16;
            loadA.srcStride = 1;
            loadA.ifTranspose = true;
            for (uint32_t rowBlock = 0; rowBlock < SIDE / 16; ++rowBlock) {
                LoadData(a2[rowBlock * localK * 16],
                    a1[rowBlock * paddedK * 16 + piece * TILE_K * 16], loadA);
            }
            LoadData2DParams loadB{};
            loadB.repeatTimes = (localK / 16) * (SIDE / 16);
            loadB.srcStride = 1;
            loadB.ifTranspose = false;
            LoadData(b2, b1[piece * TILE_K * SIDE], loadB);
            a2Queue.EnQue(a2);
            b2Queue.EnQue(b2);
            a2 = a2Queue.DeQue<half>();
            b2 = b2Queue.DeQue<half>();
            MmadParams multiply{};
            multiply.m = SIDE;
            multiply.n = SIDE;
            multiply.k = actualK;
            multiply.cmatrixInitVal = piece == 0;
            Mmad(c1, a2, b2, multiply);
            a2Queue.FreeTensor(a2);
            b2Queue.FreeTensor(b2);
        }
        a1Queue.FreeTensor(a1);
        b1Queue.FreeTensor(b1);
        c1Queue.EnQue(c1);
        c1 = c1Queue.DeQue<float>();
        FixpipeParamsV220 copyC{};
        copyC.nSize = params.n;
        copyC.mSize = params.m;
        copyC.srcStride = SIDE;
        copyC.dstStride = SIDE;
        copyC.ndNum = 1;
        copyC.quantPre = QuantMode_t::NoQuant;
        Fixpipe(partialDots[part * MATRIX_ELEMENTS], c1, copyC);
        CrossCoreSetFlag<0x2, PIPE_FIX>(0x8);
        c1Queue.FreeTensor(c1);
    }
    if ASCEND_IS_AIV {
    // 各Vector按行分工合并K片，逐元素加法顺序仍由片0到片末。
    const uint32_t rowsPerCore = (params.m + params.cores - 1) / params.cores;
    const uint32_t firstRow = part * rowsPerCore;
    const uint32_t validRows = firstRow < params.m
        ? (params.m - firstRow < rowsPerCore ? params.m - firstRow : rowsPerCore) : 0;
    TQue<TPosition::VECIN, 1> inputQueue;
    TQue<TPosition::VECOUT, 1> outputQueue;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> accumulatedBuffer;
    TBuf<TPosition::VECCALC> maximaBuffer;
    constexpr uint32_t MERGE_GROUP = 8;
    pipe.InitBuffer(inputQueue, 1, MERGE_GROUP * MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(outputQueue, 1, 32);
    pipe.InitBuffer(accumulatedBuffer, MATRIX_ELEMENTS * sizeof(float));
    pipe.InitBuffer(maximaBuffer, SIDE * sizeof(float));
    GlobalTensor<float> rowSums;
    rowSums.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial));
    auto accumulated = accumulatedBuffer.Get<float>();
    const uint32_t count = validRows * SIDE;
    // 本地队列与地址计算先完成，GM结果只在Cube和全核同步之后读取。
    CrossCoreWaitFlag(0x8);
    SyncAll<true>();
    if (validRows > 0) {
        if (params.cores != 8) {
            Duplicate(accumulated, 0.0f, count);
            PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        }
        for (uint32_t sourcePart = 0; sourcePart < params.cores; sourcePart += MERGE_GROUP) {
            const uint32_t remainingParts = params.cores - sourcePart;
            const uint32_t groupParts = remainingParts < MERGE_GROUP ? remainingParts : MERGE_GROUP;
            auto local = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
            DataCopyParams copyParts{
                static_cast<uint16_t>(groupParts),
                static_cast<uint16_t>(count * sizeof(float) / 32),
                static_cast<uint16_t>((MATRIX_ELEMENTS - count) * sizeof(float) / 32), 0};
            DataCopy(local, partialDots[sourcePart * MATRIX_ELEMENTS + firstRow * SIDE], copyParts);
            inputQueue.EnQue(local);
            local = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
            if (params.cores == 8 && groupParts == 8) {
                // 固定二叉树，不使用原子加法；每个元素的加法顺序跨次调用一致。
                Add(accumulated, local, local[4 * count], 4 * count);
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                Add(accumulated, accumulated, accumulated[2 * count], 2 * count);
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                Add(accumulated, accumulated, accumulated[count], count);
                PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
            } else {
                for (uint32_t groupPart = 0; groupPart < groupParts; ++groupPart) {
                    Add(accumulated, accumulated, local[groupPart * count], count);
                    PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
                }
            }
            inputQueue.FreeTensor(local);
        }
    }
    auto result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
    if (validRows > 0) {
        auto maxima = maximaBuffer.Get<float>();
        WholeReduceMax(maxima, accumulated, params.n, validRows, 1, 1,
            SIDE * sizeof(float) / 32, ReduceOrder::ORDER_ONLY_VALUE);
        PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>();
        WholeReduceSum(result, maxima, validRows, 1, 1, 1, 1);
    } else {
        Duplicate(result, 0.0f, 8);
    }
    outputQueue.EnQue(result);
    result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
    DataCopyExtParams copy{1, sizeof(float), 0, 0, 0};
    DataCopyPad(rowSums[part], result, copy);
    outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
    SyncAll<true>();
    if (part == 0) {
        auto local = inputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        DataCopyExtParams read{1, static_cast<uint32_t>(params.cores * sizeof(float)), 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPadExtParams<float> padding{false, 0, 0, 0};
        DataCopyPad(local, rowSums, read, padding);
        inputQueue.EnQue(local);
        local = inputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        result = outputQueue.AllocTensor<float>();
        WholeReduceSum(result, local, params.cores, 1, 1, 1, 1);
        outputQueue.EnQue(result);
        result = outputQueue.DeQue<float>();
        DataCopyPad(output, result, copy);
        outputQueue.FreeTensor(result);
        inputQueue.FreeTensor(local);
    }
    }
}

// 按正式N分片规则估计单batch大矩阵的参与核数，不改变分片算法。
inline uint32_t EstimateLargeCores(int64_t m, int64_t n, uint32_t rows,
    uint32_t columns, int64_t availableCores)
{
    const int64_t rowTasks = (m + rows - 1) / rows;
    const int64_t columnTiles = (n + columns - 1) / columns;
    if (rowTasks * 2 > availableCores || columnTiles < 2) {
        return std::min<int64_t>(availableCores, rowTasks);
    }
    const int64_t maxParts = std::min<int64_t>(availableCores / rowTasks, columnTiles);
    const int64_t blocksPerPart = (columnTiles + maxParts - 1) / maxParts;
    const int64_t parts = (columnTiles + blocksPerPart - 1) / blocksPerPart;
    return std::min<int64_t>(availableCores, rowTasks * parts);
}

inline void CheckAcl(aclError code, const char* operation)
{
    if (code != ACL_SUCCESS) {
        throw std::runtime_error(std::string(operation) + ": " + std::to_string(code));
    }
}

// 普通调用在同步后释放；捕获调用的工作区必须存活到计算图销毁。
struct DeviceMemory {
    void* address = nullptr;
    ~DeviceMemory()
    {
        if (address != nullptr) {
            aclrtFree(address);
        }
    }
    void Allocate(size_t bytes)
    {
        CheckAcl(aclrtMalloc(&address, bytes, ACL_MEM_MALLOC_HUGE_FIRST), "aclrtMalloc");
    }
};

struct KernelWorkspace {
    DeviceMemory scratch;
    DeviceMemory partial;
    DeviceMemory system;
};

void DestroyCapturedWorkspace(void* address)
{
    delete static_cast<KernelWorkspace*>(address);
}

void DestroyCapturedDeviceMemory(void* address)
{
    delete static_cast<DeviceMemory*>(address);
}


// 通用路径只实例化两类型×四布局，分片及直写由运行时参数控制。
template <typename T>
void LaunchGeneric(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch, GM_ADDR partial, GM_ADDR y,
    GM_ADDR workspace, const Parameters& params, aclrtStream stream,
    bool transA, bool transB, bool splitN)
{
    GenericParameters generic{};
    generic.base = params;
    generic.splitN = splitN;
    generic.directOutput = !splitN && params.rowTiles == 1;
    generic.parts = splitN ? params.cores / (params.batch * params.rowTiles) : 1;
    generic.partialStride = splitN ? DEFAULT_ROWS : PARTIAL_STRIDE;
    if (transA && transB) {
        ComputeGeneric<T, true, true><<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, generic);
    } else if (transA) {
        ComputeGeneric<T, true, false><<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, generic);
    } else if (transB) {
        ComputeGeneric<T, false, true><<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, generic);
    } else {
        ComputeGeneric<T, false, false><<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, generic);
    }
}


inline bool MatchesStaticBase(const Parameters& params, uint32_t rows, uint32_t columns)
{
    const uint32_t baseK = rows == DEFAULT_ROWS && columns == DEFAULT_COLS ? 128 : 64;
    return params.cube.baseM == rows && params.cube.baseN == columns
        && params.cube.baseK == baseK && params.cube.dbL0A == 2
        && params.cube.dbL0B == 2 && params.cube.isBias == 0;
}

// 基础Cube的L0/L1容量、输入对齐及单轮任务覆盖条件。
inline bool CanBatchResidentNT(const Parameters& p) {
    return p.m <= 32 && p.n > 32 && p.n <= 128 && p.k % 16 == 0
        && static_cast<uint64_t>((p.n + 15) / 16 * 16) * p.k * 2 <= 64 * 1024
        && p.k <= 256 && p.cores >= p.batch;
}
inline bool CanBatchResidentTN(const Parameters& p) {
    return p.m <= 32 && p.n <= 128 && p.k <= 256 && p.k % 16 == 0
        && p.cores >= p.batch;
}
inline bool CanTallResident(const Parameters& p) {
    return p.batch == 1 && p.n <= 64 && p.k <= 128 && p.k % 16 == 0
        && p.tileRows <= 512 && p.cores == p.rowTiles;
}
inline bool CanWideResident(const Parameters& p) {
    return p.batch == 1 && p.m <= 64 && p.m % 16 == 0 && p.k <= 128
        && p.k % 16 == 0 && p.n % 512 == 0 && p.cores == p.n / 512;
}
inline bool CanResidentTT(const Parameters& p) {
    const uint32_t parts = p.cores / (p.batch * p.rowTiles);
    const uint32_t columns = (p.n + 511) / 512;
    // 完整A和112列B驻留512KiB L1；每片至多两个512列输出块。
    return parts > 0 && p.cores == p.batch * p.rowTiles * parts
        && (columns + parts - 1) / parts <= 2
        && static_cast<uint64_t>(p.tileRows == 112 ? 112 + 2 * 64 : 128 + 112)
            * ((p.k + 15) / 16 * 16) * 2 <= 512 * 1024;
}
bool SupportsOptimizedCube(const Parameters& p, bool fp16, bool transA, bool transB,
    ShapeKey key, bool splitN)
{
    switch (key) {
        case ShapeKey::DEFAULT:
            return !splitN && ((fp16 && !transB) || (!fp16 && !transA && transB));
        case ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED:
            return (splitN && !fp16 && transA)
                || (!splitN && !transA && ((fp16 && transB) || (!fp16 && !transB)));
        case ShapeKey::LARGE_TALL:
            return fp16 && transA && transB && splitN;
        case ShapeKey::TALL_NARROW:
            return fp16 && !transA && !transB && !splitN;
        case ShapeKey::WIDE_SHALLOW:
            return !fp16 && !transA && transB && splitN;
        case ShapeKey::SPLIT_K:
            return fp16 && transA && transB && !splitN;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

// 保留专用核；通用参数已在Host重新计算，不复用专用核的块宽或K分片。
enum class KernelKey {
    GENERIC,
    BATCH_RESIDENT_NT,
    BATCH_RESIDENT_TN,
    DEFAULT_NN,
    DEFAULT_TN,
    DEFAULT_NT,
    RESIDENT_TT,
    BALANCED_TT,
    BALANCED_COMPACT_ROWS,
    BALANCED_NT,
    BALANCED_EXPANDED_ROWS,
    BALANCED_NN,
    SWAPPED_TT,
    BALANCED_TN,
    TALL_RESIDENT,
    TALL_TILED,
    WIDE_RESIDENT,
    WIDE_TILED,
    SPLIT_K_RESIDENT,
    SPLIT_K_TILED
};

// 每个key表示布局、硬件容量和分块方式；实际尺寸始终由Parameters传入。
KernelKey SelectKernelKey(const Parameters& params, bool fp16, bool transA, bool transB,
    ShapeKey key, bool splitN, bool genericFallback)
{
    if ((!fp16 && !transA && transB && CanBatchResidentNT(params)) && params.tileRows == 32 && params.tileCols == 128) {
        return KernelKey::BATCH_RESIDENT_NT;
    }
    if ((fp16 && transA && !transB && CanBatchResidentTN(params)) && params.tileRows == 32 && params.tileCols == 128) {
        return KernelKey::BATCH_RESIDENT_TN;
    }
    if (genericFallback) {
        return KernelKey::GENERIC;
    }
    if (fp16 && !transA && !transB && key == ShapeKey::DEFAULT && !splitN) {
        return KernelKey::DEFAULT_NN;
    }
    if (fp16 && transA && !transB && key == ShapeKey::DEFAULT && !splitN) {
        return KernelKey::DEFAULT_TN;
    }
    if (!fp16 && !transA && transB && key == ShapeKey::DEFAULT && !splitN) {
        return KernelKey::DEFAULT_NT;
    }
    if (!fp16 && transA && transB && key == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && splitN
        && CanResidentTT(params)) {
        return KernelKey::RESIDENT_TT;
    }
    if (!fp16 && transA && transB && key == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && splitN) {
        return KernelKey::BALANCED_TT;
    }
    if (fp16 && !transA && transB && key == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && !splitN
        && params.tileRows == 112) {
        return KernelKey::BALANCED_COMPACT_ROWS;
    }
    if (fp16 && !transA && transB && key == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && !splitN) {
        return KernelKey::BALANCED_NT;
    }
    if (!fp16 && !transA && !transB && key == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && !splitN
        && params.tileRows == 208) {
        return KernelKey::BALANCED_EXPANDED_ROWS;
    }
    if (!fp16 && !transA && !transB && key == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && !splitN) {
        return KernelKey::BALANCED_NN;
    }
    if (fp16 && transA && transB && key == ShapeKey::LARGE_TALL && splitN) {
        return KernelKey::SWAPPED_TT;
    }
    if (!fp16 && transA && !transB && key == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && splitN) {
        return KernelKey::BALANCED_TN;
    }
    if (fp16 && !transA && !transB && key == ShapeKey::TALL_NARROW && !splitN
        && CanTallResident(params)) {
        return KernelKey::TALL_RESIDENT;
    }
    if (fp16 && !transA && !transB && key == ShapeKey::TALL_NARROW && !splitN) {
        return KernelKey::TALL_TILED;
    }
    if (!fp16 && !transA && transB && key == ShapeKey::WIDE_SHALLOW && splitN
        && CanWideResident(params)) {
        return KernelKey::WIDE_RESIDENT;
    }
    if (!fp16 && !transA && transB && key == ShapeKey::WIDE_SHALLOW && splitN) {
        return KernelKey::WIDE_TILED;
    }
    if (fp16 && transA && transB && key == ShapeKey::SPLIT_K && !splitN
        && ((params.k + params.cores - 1) / params.cores + 15) / 16 * 16 <= 1024) {
        return KernelKey::SPLIT_K_RESIDENT;
    }
    if (fp16 && transA && transB && key == ShapeKey::SPLIT_K && !splitN) {
        return KernelKey::SPLIT_K_TILED;
    }
    throw std::logic_error("BatchMatmulMaxSum: tiling key selection mismatch");
}

void LaunchWithFallback(GM_ADDR x1, GM_ADDR x2, GM_ADDR scratch, GM_ADDR partial,
    GM_ADDR y, GM_ADDR workspace, const Parameters& params, aclrtStream stream,
    bool fp16, bool transA, bool transB, ShapeKey key, bool splitN, bool genericFallback, bool residentA)
{
    if (residentA) {
        ComputeResidentA<<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
    }
    const auto kernelKey = SelectKernelKey(params, fp16, transA, transB, key, splitN, genericFallback);
    switch (kernelKey) {
        case KernelKey::GENERIC: {
        if (fp16) {
            LaunchGeneric<half>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace,
                params, stream, transA, transB, splitN);
        } else {
            LaunchGeneric<bfloat16_t>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace,
                params, stream, transA, transB, splitN);
        }
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::BATCH_RESIDENT_NT: {
        ComputeBatchResidentNT<<<params.batch, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, y, params.m, params.n, params.k);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::BATCH_RESIDENT_TN: {
        ComputeBatchResidentTN<<<params.batch, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, y, params.m, params.n, params.k);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::DEFAULT_NN: {
        Compute<half, false, false, false, 32, 128, false, true>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::DEFAULT_TN: {
        Compute<half, true, false, false, 32, 128, false, true>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::DEFAULT_NT: {
        Compute<bfloat16_t, false, true, false, 32, 128, false, true>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::RESIDENT_TT: {
        if (params.tileRows == 112) {
            ComputeResidentTT<112, true><<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, params);
        } else {
            ComputeResidentTT<128, false><<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, params);
        }
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::BALANCED_TT: {
        Compute<bfloat16_t, true, true, true, LARGE_BALANCED_ROWS, LARGE_BALANCED_COLS, false, true,
            LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_COLS, LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_ROWS>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::BALANCED_COMPACT_ROWS: {
        Compute<half, false, true, false, 112, 1024, false, true, 256, 112>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::BALANCED_NT: {
        Compute<half, false, true, false, LARGE_BALANCED_ROWS, 1024, false, true,
            LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_COLS, LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_ROWS>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::BALANCED_EXPANDED_ROWS: {
        Compute<bfloat16_t, false, false, false, 208, 1024, false, true, 128, 208>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::BALANCED_NN: {
        Compute<bfloat16_t, false, false, false, LARGE_BALANCED_ROWS, 1024, false, true,
            LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_COLS, LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_ROWS>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::SWAPPED_TT: {
        ComputeSwappedTT<half, 256, 128, 256>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::BALANCED_TN: {
        Compute<bfloat16_t, true, false, true, LARGE_BALANCED_ROWS, 1024, false, true,
            LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_COLS, LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_ROWS>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::TALL_RESIDENT: {
        ComputeTallResidentNN<<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::TALL_TILED: {
        Compute<half, false, false, false, 416, 64, false, false>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::WIDE_RESIDENT: {
        ComputeWideResidentNT<<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::WIDE_TILED: {
        Compute<bfloat16_t, false, true, true, 64, 512, false, false, 256, 64>
            <<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::SPLIT_K_RESIDENT: {
        ComputeSplitKResidentTT<<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, params);
        return;
            }
        case KernelKey::SPLIT_K_TILED: {
        ComputeSplitK<half, true, true><<<params.cores, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, scratch, partial, y, workspace, params);
        return;
            }
    }
}

} // namespace batch_max_sum

extern "C" void run_kernel(GM_ADDR x1, const TensorGroupInfo& info_x1,
    GM_ADDR x2, const TensorGroupInfo& info_x2, GM_ADDR y, const TensorGroupInfo& info_y,
    int64_t availableCoreNum, aclrtStream stream, bool transposeX1, bool transposeX2)
{
    using namespace batch_max_sum;
    const auto& a = info_x1.tensors[0];
    const auto& b = info_x2.tensors[0];
    if (a.numDims != 3 || b.numDims != 3 || a.dtype != b.dtype || (a.dtype != 1 && a.dtype != 2)) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("BatchMatmulMaxSum: invalid input rank or dtype");
    }
    const int64_t batch = a.shape[0];
    const int64_t m = a.shape[transposeX1 ? 2 : 1];
    const int64_t k = a.shape[transposeX1 ? 1 : 2];
    const int64_t n = b.shape[transposeX2 ? 1 : 2];
    if (batch < 1 || batch > 64 || m < 1 || m > 8192 || n < 1 || n > 8192
        || k < 32 || k > 8192 || k % 8 != 0 || b.shape[0] != batch
        || b.shape[transposeX2 ? 2 : 1] != k || batch * m * k > (1LL << 26)
        || batch * n * k > (1LL << 26) || availableCoreNum <= 0
        || info_y.tensors[0].dtype != 0 || info_y.tensors[0].numDims != 1
        || info_y.tensors[0].shape[0] != batch) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("BatchMatmulMaxSum: invalid shape or core count");
    }
    const bool smallResidentCube = batch >= 5 && batch <= 8 && m <= 16 && n <= 32
        && k <= 128 && k % 16 == 0 && a.dtype == 1 && !transposeX1 && !transposeX2;
    if (smallResidentCube) {
        aclmdlRICaptureStatus captureStatus = ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_NONE;
        aclmdlRI capturedModel = nullptr;
        CheckAcl(aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo(stream, &captureStatus, &capturedModel), "aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo");
        const bool capturing = captureStatus == ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_ACTIVE;
        std::unique_ptr<DeviceMemory> scratchMemory(new DeviceMemory);
        scratchMemory->Allocate(static_cast<size_t>(batch) * 16 * 32 * sizeof(float));
        auto scratch = (GM_ADDR)scratchMemory->address;
        if (capturing) {
            CheckAcl(aclmdlRIDestroyRegisterCallback(capturedModel, DestroyCapturedDeviceMemory,
                scratchMemory.get()), "aclmdlRIDestroyRegisterCallback");
            scratchMemory.release();
        }
        ComputeSmallManualCube<half, false, false, 32><<<batch, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, scratch, y, static_cast<uint32_t>(m), static_cast<uint32_t>(n), static_cast<uint32_t>(k));
        if (!capturing) {
            CheckAcl(aclrtSynchronizeStream(stream), "aclrtSynchronizeStream");
        }
        return;
    }
    const bool smallVector = batch == 1 && k <= SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT
        && m * n <= SMALL_VECTOR_OUTPUT_LIMIT
        && ((m == 1 && n == 1 && a.dtype == 1)
            || (a.dtype == 2 && transposeX1 && !transposeX2));
    if (smallVector) {
        aclmdlRICaptureStatus captureStatus = ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_NONE;
        aclmdlRI capturedModel = nullptr;
        CheckAcl(aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo(stream, &captureStatus, &capturedModel), "aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo");
        if (m == 1 && n == 1 && a.dtype == 1) {
            ComputeSingleDot<half><<<4, nullptr, stream>>>(x1, x2, y, static_cast<uint32_t>(k));
        } else if (a.dtype == 2 && transposeX1 && !transposeX2) {
            ComputePackedCastGather<bfloat16_t, true, false><<<4, nullptr, stream>>>(
                x1, x2, y, static_cast<uint32_t>(m), static_cast<uint32_t>(n), static_cast<uint32_t>(k));
        }
        if (captureStatus != ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_ACTIVE) {
            CheckAcl(aclrtSynchronizeStream(stream), "aclrtSynchronizeStream");
        }
        return;
    }
    const bool smallBatchVector = batch >= 2 && batch <= SMALL_BATCH_LIMIT
        && m <= SMALL_BATCH_M_LIMIT && n <= SMALL_BATCH_N_LIMIT
        && k <= SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT
        && a.dtype == 1 && !transposeX1 && transposeX2 && (k & 15u) == 0;
    if (smallBatchVector) {
        aclmdlRICaptureStatus captureStatus = ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_NONE;
        aclmdlRI capturedModel = nullptr;
        CheckAcl(aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo(stream, &captureStatus, &capturedModel), "aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo");
        ComputeSmallBatchDots<half, false, true, true><<<batch, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, y, static_cast<uint32_t>(m), static_cast<uint32_t>(n), static_cast<uint32_t>(k));
        if (captureStatus != ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_ACTIVE) {
            CheckAcl(aclrtSynchronizeStream(stream), "aclrtSynchronizeStream");
        }
        return;
    }
    const bool mediumVectorOnMixedTask = batch >= 2 && batch <= 4
        && m <= 16 && n <= 16
        && k >= MEDIUM_BATCH_K_TILE && k <= MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT
        && (k & 63u) == 0 && a.dtype == 2 && transposeX1 && transposeX2;
    if (mediumVectorOnMixedTask) {
        aclmdlRICaptureStatus captureStatus = ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_NONE;
        aclmdlRI capturedModel = nullptr;
        CheckAcl(aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo(stream, &captureStatus, &capturedModel), "aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo");
        const bool capturing = captureStatus == ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_ACTIVE;
        std::unique_ptr<DeviceMemory> stagingMemory(new DeviceMemory);
        const uint32_t rowTiles = (static_cast<uint32_t>(m) + MEDIUM_BATCH_ROW_TILE - 1)
            / MEDIUM_BATCH_ROW_TILE;
        stagingMemory->Allocate(static_cast<size_t>(batch) * rowTiles
            * MEDIUM_BATCH_OUTPUT_STRIDE * sizeof(float));
        auto stagingAddress = (GM_ADDR)stagingMemory->address;
        if (capturing) {
            CheckAcl(aclmdlRIDestroyRegisterCallback(capturedModel, DestroyCapturedDeviceMemory,
                stagingMemory.get()), "aclmdlRIDestroyRegisterCallback");
            stagingMemory.release();
        }
        ComputeBatchStaticUB<bfloat16_t, true, true><<<8, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, stagingAddress, y, static_cast<uint32_t>(batch),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(m), static_cast<uint32_t>(n), static_cast<uint32_t>(k));

        if (!capturing) {
            CheckAcl(aclrtSynchronizeStream(stream), "aclrtSynchronizeStream");
        }
        return;
    }
    const bool compactBatchVector = batch >= 5 && batch <= 8
        && m <= 16 && n <= 32
        && k >= LARGE_BATCH_K_TILE && k <= MEDIUM_BATCH_K_LIMIT
        && (k & 63u) == 0 && a.dtype == 1 && !transposeX1 && !transposeX2;
    if (compactBatchVector) {
        aclmdlRICaptureStatus captureStatus = ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_NONE;
        aclmdlRI capturedModel = nullptr;
        CheckAcl(aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo(stream, &captureStatus, &capturedModel),
            "aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo");
        const bool capturing = captureStatus == ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_ACTIVE;
        std::unique_ptr<DeviceMemory> stagingMemory(new DeviceMemory);
        const uint32_t rowTiles = (static_cast<uint32_t>(m) + LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE - 1)
            / LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE;
        const uint32_t colTiles = (static_cast<uint32_t>(n) + LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE - 1)
            / LARGE_BATCH_COL_TILE;
        stagingMemory->Allocate(static_cast<size_t>(batch) * rowTiles * colTiles
            * LARGE_BATCH_M_TILE * sizeof(float));
        auto stagingAddress = (GM_ADDR)stagingMemory->address;
        if (capturing) {
            CheckAcl(aclmdlRIDestroyRegisterCallback(capturedModel, DestroyCapturedDeviceMemory,
                stagingMemory.get()), "aclmdlRIDestroyRegisterCallback");
            stagingMemory.release();
        }
        ComputeBatchDirectDots<half, false, false><<<batch, nullptr, stream>>>(
            x1, x2, stagingAddress, y, static_cast<uint32_t>(batch),
            static_cast<uint32_t>(m), static_cast<uint32_t>(n), static_cast<uint32_t>(k));
        if (!capturing) {
            CheckAcl(aclrtSynchronizeStream(stream), "aclrtSynchronizeStream");
        }
        return;
    }
    ShapeKey shapeKey = ShapeKey::DEFAULT;
    uint32_t tileRows = DEFAULT_ROWS;
    uint32_t tileCols = DEFAULT_COLS;
    if (batch >= 2 && batch <= 8 && m <= 16 && n <= 32
        && k > SMALL_VECTOR_K_LIMIT && k <= 128) {
        tileRows = 16;
        if (n <= 16) {
            shapeKey = ShapeKey::COMPACT_16;
            tileCols = 16;
        } else {
            shapeKey = ShapeKey::COMPACT_32;
            tileCols = 32;
        }
    } else if (batch == 1 && m <= 64 && n <= 64 && k >= 4096
        && availableCoreNum >= 2) {
        shapeKey = ShapeKey::SPLIT_K;
        tileRows = 64;
        tileCols = 64;
    } else if (batch == 1 && m >= 1024 && n >= 512) {
        const uint32_t cores128 = EstimateLargeCores(
            m, n, LARGE_BALANCED_ROWS, LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_COLS, availableCoreNum);
        const uint32_t cores256 = EstimateLargeCores(m, n, 256, 128, availableCoreNum);
        // 只有参与核数至少增加25%时采用更高行块，否则保留均衡块。
        if (cores256 * 4 >= cores128 * 5) {
            shapeKey = ShapeKey::LARGE_TALL;
            tileRows = 256;
            tileCols = 256;
        } else {
            shapeKey = ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED;
            tileRows = LARGE_BALANCED_ROWS;
            tileCols = LARGE_BALANCED_COLS;
        }
    } else if (n <= 64 && m >= 64) {
        shapeKey = ShapeKey::TALL_NARROW;
        if (m >= 512) {
            // 高窄默认块按16行对齐；驻留路径稍后按实际核数均衡。
            tileRows = 416;
        } else if (m >= 256) {
            tileRows = 256;
        } else if (m >= 128) {
            tileRows = 128;
        } else {
            tileRows = 64;
        }
        tileCols = 64;
    } else if (m <= 64 && n >= 512) {
        shapeKey = ShapeKey::WIDE_SHALLOW;
        tileRows = 64;
        tileCols = 512;
    }

    // 完整K的均衡大块加宽逻辑N，Matmul内部复用A，物理块仍为128×256。
    if (shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && !(transposeX1 && transposeX2)) {
        tileCols = 1024;
    }
    const bool swappedTT = batch == 1 && a.dtype == 1 && transposeX1 && transposeX2
        && m >= 1024 && n >= 512;
    if (swappedTT) {
        shapeKey = ShapeKey::LARGE_TALL;
        tileRows = 256;
        const uint32_t rowTasks = (m + tileRows - 1) / tileRows;
        const uint32_t nParts = std::max<int64_t>(1, availableCoreNum / rowTasks);
        tileCols = std::max<uint32_t>(128, ((n + nParts - 1) / nParts + 15) / 16 * 16);
    }
    // 以每核一份行任务为目标，在已编译的16行对齐基块间选择。
    const uint32_t balancedRows = ((m + availableCoreNum - 1) / availableCoreNum + 15) / 16 * 16;
    const bool compactRowTile = shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED
        && a.dtype == 1 && !transposeX1 && transposeX2
        && balancedRows > 64 && balancedRows <= 112;
    const bool expandedRowTile = shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED
        && a.dtype == 2 && !transposeX1 && !transposeX2
        && balancedRows > 128 && balancedRows <= 208;
    if (compactRowTile || expandedRowTile) {
        tileRows = compactRowTile ? 112 : 208;
        tileCols = 1024;
    }
    if (shapeKey == ShapeKey::TALL_NARROW && batch == 1 && a.dtype == 1
        && !transposeX1 && !transposeX2 && k <= 128 && k % 16 == 0) {
        tileRows = std::min<uint32_t>(512, std::max<uint32_t>(16, balancedRows));
    }
    Parameters params{};
    params.batch = batch;
    params.m = m;
    params.n = n;
    params.k = k;
    params.tileRows = tileRows;
    params.tileCols = tileCols;
    params.rowTiles = (m + tileRows - 1) / tileRows;
    const int64_t rowTasks = batch * params.rowTiles;
    const int64_t columnTiles = (n + tileCols - 1) / tileCols;
    // 大矩阵允许两路N分片，利用128行块减少行任务后留下的空闲核。
    // 其他路径保持原四路门槛；每片至少一个列块，所有分片一轮落到可用核上。
    const bool largeMatrix = shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED || shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_TALL;
    const uint32_t minimumParts = largeMatrix ? 2 : MIN_N_PARTS;
    bool splitN = rowTasks * minimumParts <= availableCoreNum && columnTiles >= minimumParts;
    const uint32_t maxParts = splitN
        ? std::min<int64_t>(availableCoreNum / rowTasks, columnTiles) : 1;
    // 保持最慢分片的列块数不增加，减少不能缩短临界路径的额外分片。
    // 例如 64 个列块、20 个空闲核：每片上限均为4块，16片即可覆盖。
    const uint32_t blocksPerPart = (columnTiles + maxParts - 1) / maxParts;
    uint32_t parts = splitN ? (columnTiles + blocksPerPart - 1) / blocksPerPart : 1;
    params.cores = std::min<int64_t>(availableCoreNum, rowTasks * parts);
    if (shapeKey == ShapeKey::SPLIT_K) {
        params.cores = std::min<int64_t>(availableCoreNum, (k + 1023) / 1024);
    }

    auto* platform = platform_ascendc::PlatformAscendCManager::GetInstance(aclrtGetSocName());
    if (platform == nullptr) {
        throw std::runtime_error("BatchMatmulMaxSum: cannot query platform");
    }
    matmul_tiling::MatmulApiTiling tiling(*platform);
    const auto dtype = a.dtype == 1 ? matmul_tiling::DataType::DT_FLOAT16
                                   : matmul_tiling::DataType::DT_BF16;
    tiling.SetAType(matmul_tiling::TPosition::GM, matmul_tiling::CubeFormat::ND, dtype,
        swappedTT ? false : transposeX1);
    tiling.SetBType(matmul_tiling::TPosition::GM, matmul_tiling::CubeFormat::ND, dtype,
        swappedTT ? false : transposeX2);
    tiling.SetCType(matmul_tiling::TPosition::GM, matmul_tiling::CubeFormat::ND,
        matmul_tiling::DataType::DT_FLOAT);
    // 固定基础块不能大于单核计算块；有效尺寸在核内通过 SetTail 指定。
    const int64_t singleCoreK = shapeKey == ShapeKey::SPLIT_K
        ? ((k + params.cores - 1) / params.cores + 15) / 16 * 16 : k;
    const uint32_t baseTileRows = expandedRowTile ? 208 : compactRowTile ? 112 : (shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED
        ? LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_ROWS : tileRows);
    const uint32_t baseTileCols = expandedRowTile ? 128 : shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED
        ? LARGE_BALANCED_BASE_COLS : tileCols;
    tiling.SetShape(swappedTT ? tileCols : tileRows,
        swappedTT ? tileRows : tileCols, singleCoreK);
    tiling.SetOrgShape(swappedTT ? n : m, swappedTT ? m : n, k);
    tiling.SetFixSplit(swappedTT ? 128 : baseTileRows,
        swappedTT ? 256 : (shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_TALL ? 128
            : (shapeKey == ShapeKey::WIDE_SHALLOW ? 256 : baseTileCols)));
    tiling.SetBias(false);
    tiling.SetBufferSpace(-1, -1, -1);
    // 专用块无法生成tiling时，仍应尝试合法输入的32×128通用块。
    const bool optimizedTilingValid = tiling.GetTiling(params.cube) == 0;

    // 大矩阵每个基本块只覆盖一块M/N；让A/B以相同的K批量搬入L1，
    // 减少一侧stepK=1时的细碎MTE2搬运。保持baseK和MMAD累加顺序。
    // 依照TCubeTiling约束：stepM/stepN=1，depth=stepK*2，A/B迭代数相等。
    // 尾K也尝试对称分段，降低细碎搬运次数。
    constexpr int32_t LARGE_K_STEP = 4;
    if (!expandedRowTile && largeMatrix && params.cube.stepM == 1 && params.cube.stepN == 1
        && params.cube.baseK > 0 && singleCoreK >= params.cube.baseK * LARGE_K_STEP) {
        uint64_t l1Bytes = 0;
        platform->GetCoreMemSize(platform_ascendc::CoreMemType::L1, l1Bytes);
        const uint64_t requiredBytes = static_cast<uint64_t>(params.cube.baseM + params.cube.baseN)
            * params.cube.baseK * LARGE_K_STEP * 2 * sizeof(uint16_t);
        if (requiredBytes <= l1Bytes) {
            params.cube.stepKa = LARGE_K_STEP;
            params.cube.stepKb = LARGE_K_STEP;
            params.cube.depthA1 = LARGE_K_STEP * 2;
            params.cube.depthB1 = LARGE_K_STEP * 2;
        }
    }

    // K有基础块尾部时保留A全载，只合并B的细碎搬运；完整K块沿用上面的四块策略。
    // A只有一轮K加载，B的迭代数与之天然成整数倍；B使用两个三块L1缓冲。
    constexpr int32_t TAIL_B_K_STEP = 3;
    if (largeMatrix && params.cube.stepM == 1 && params.cube.stepN == 1
        && params.cube.baseK > 0 && singleCoreK % params.cube.baseK != 0
        && singleCoreK > params.cube.baseK * TAIL_B_K_STEP
        && singleCoreK <= static_cast<int64_t>(params.cube.baseK) * params.cube.stepKa
        && params.cube.stepKb > 0 && params.cube.stepKb < TAIL_B_K_STEP) {
        uint64_t l1Bytes = 0;
        platform->GetCoreMemSize(platform_ascendc::CoreMemType::L1, l1Bytes);
        const uint64_t requiredBytes = (static_cast<uint64_t>(params.cube.baseM)
            * params.cube.depthA1 + static_cast<uint64_t>(params.cube.baseN) * TAIL_B_K_STEP * 2)
            * params.cube.baseK * sizeof(uint16_t);
        if (requiredBytes <= l1Bytes) {
            params.cube.stepKb = TAIL_B_K_STEP;
            params.cube.depthB1 = TAIL_B_K_STEP * 2;
        }
    }

    // 宽逻辑N块在片内重复使用A；完整K时尝试A全载，B保留双缓冲。
    // A只有一轮K迭代，因此与B任意正整数迭代数满足MDL整数倍约束。
    if (a.dtype != 1 && shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && singleCoreK % 64 == 0
        && params.cube.baseM == 128 && params.cube.baseN == 256
        && params.cube.baseK == 64 && params.cube.stepM == 1 && params.cube.stepN == 1) {
        uint64_t l1Bytes = 0;
        platform->GetCoreMemSize(platform_ascendc::CoreMemType::L1, l1Bytes);
        const int32_t fullAK = (singleCoreK + params.cube.baseK - 1) / params.cube.baseK;
        const int32_t initialStepB = 2;
        for (int32_t stepB = initialStepB; stepB >= 1; --stepB) {
            const uint64_t requiredBytes = (static_cast<uint64_t>(params.cube.baseM) * fullAK
                + static_cast<uint64_t>(params.cube.baseN) * stepB * 2)
                * params.cube.baseK * sizeof(uint16_t);
            if (requiredBytes <= l1Bytes) {
                params.cube.stepKa = fullAK;
                params.cube.depthA1 = fullAK;
                params.cube.stepKb = stepB;
                params.cube.depthB1 = stepB * 2;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    bool keepFastPath = false;
    switch (shapeKey) {
        case ShapeKey::SPLIT_K:
            keepFastPath = true;
            break;
        case ShapeKey::DEFAULT:
            keepFastPath = !splitN && MatchesStaticBase(params, DEFAULT_ROWS, DEFAULT_COLS);
            break;
        case ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED:
            keepFastPath = MatchesStaticBase(params, expandedRowTile ? 208 : (compactRowTile ? 112 : 128),
                expandedRowTile ? 128 : 256);
            break;
        case ShapeKey::LARGE_TALL:
            keepFastPath = splitN && MatchesStaticBase(params,
                swappedTT ? 128 : 256, swappedTT ? 256 : 128);
            break;
        case ShapeKey::TALL_NARROW:
            keepFastPath = CanTallResident(params) || tileRows == 416;
            break;
        case ShapeKey::WIDE_SHALLOW:
            keepFastPath = splitN;
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }
    const bool genericFallback = !optimizedTilingValid || !keepFastPath
        || !SupportsOptimizedCube(params, a.dtype == 1, transposeX1, transposeX2,
            shapeKey, splitN);
    if (genericFallback) {
        tileRows = DEFAULT_ROWS;
        tileCols = DEFAULT_COLS;
        params.tileRows = tileRows;
        params.tileCols = tileCols;
        params.rowTiles = (m + tileRows - 1) / tileRows;
        const int64_t genericRowTasks = batch * params.rowTiles;
        const int64_t genericColumns = (n + tileCols - 1) / tileCols;
        splitN = genericRowTasks * MIN_N_PARTS <= availableCoreNum
            && genericColumns >= MIN_N_PARTS;
        const uint32_t genericMaxParts = splitN
            ? std::min<int64_t>(availableCoreNum / genericRowTasks, genericColumns) : 1;
        const uint32_t genericBlocksPerPart = (genericColumns + genericMaxParts - 1) / genericMaxParts;
        parts = splitN ? (genericColumns + genericBlocksPerPart - 1) / genericBlocksPerPart : 1;
        params.cores = std::min<int64_t>(availableCoreNum, genericRowTasks * parts);

        // 旧专用块的base、步长和L1参数不能传入通用32×128核。
        matmul_tiling::MatmulApiTiling genericTiling(*platform);
        genericTiling.SetAType(matmul_tiling::TPosition::GM, matmul_tiling::CubeFormat::ND,
            dtype, transposeX1);
        genericTiling.SetBType(matmul_tiling::TPosition::GM, matmul_tiling::CubeFormat::ND,
            dtype, transposeX2);
        genericTiling.SetCType(matmul_tiling::TPosition::GM, matmul_tiling::CubeFormat::ND,
            matmul_tiling::DataType::DT_FLOAT);
        genericTiling.SetShape(tileRows, tileCols, k);
        genericTiling.SetOrgShape(m, n, k);
        genericTiling.SetFixSplit(tileRows, tileCols);
        genericTiling.SetBias(false);
        genericTiling.SetBufferSpace(-1, -1, -1);
        params.cube = {};
        if (genericTiling.GetTiling(params.cube) != 0) {
            throw std::runtime_error("BatchMatmulMaxSum: generic Matmul tiling failed");
        }
    }

    // 仅为已选定的原生TT驻留核重排任务；其计算不使用Matmul高阶tiling字段。
    // 保持N分片最大片数不增加，并为两份64列B预留L1容量。
    if (!genericFallback && a.dtype == 2 && transposeX1 && transposeX2
        && shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && splitN && CanResidentTT(params)) {
        const uint32_t residentRows = 112;
        const uint32_t nextRowTiles = (m + residentRows - 1) / residentRows;
        const uint64_t nextRowTasks = static_cast<uint64_t>(batch) * nextRowTiles;
        const uint64_t residentBytes = static_cast<uint64_t>(residentRows + 2 * 64)
            * ((k + 15) / 16 * 16) * 2;
        if (nextRowTasks * 2 <= availableCoreNum && residentBytes <= 512 * 1024) {
            const uint32_t nextMaxParts = std::min<uint64_t>(availableCoreNum / nextRowTasks, columnTiles);
            const uint32_t nextBlocks = (columnTiles + nextMaxParts - 1) / nextMaxParts;
            if (nextBlocks <= 2 && nextBlocks <= (columnTiles + parts - 1) / parts) {
                parts = (columnTiles + nextBlocks - 1) / nextBlocks;
                tileRows = residentRows;
                params.tileRows = residentRows;
                params.rowTiles = nextRowTiles;
                params.cores = nextRowTasks * parts;
            }
        }
    }

    // 仅按布局、分片和容量选择；域外仍使用原路径。
    uint64_t residentL1Bytes = 0;
    platform->GetCoreMemSize(platform_ascendc::CoreMemType::L1, residentL1Bytes);
    bool residentA = false;
    const uint64_t residentABytes = uint64_t(128) * k * sizeof(uint16_t);
    if (!genericFallback && a.dtype == 2 && transposeX1 && !transposeX2
        && shapeKey == ShapeKey::LARGE_BALANCED && splitN && tileRows == 128
        && tileCols == 1024 && m % 128 == 0 && k % 64 == 0 && n % 1024 == 0
        && params.cores == uint64_t(batch) * params.rowTiles * parts
        && n / 1024 >= parts * 2 && residentABytes + 65536 <= residentL1Bytes) {
        matmul_tiling::MatmulApiTiling residentTiling(*platform);
        residentTiling.SetAType(matmul_tiling::TPosition::TSCM, matmul_tiling::CubeFormat::NZ, dtype, true);
        residentTiling.SetBType(matmul_tiling::TPosition::GM, matmul_tiling::CubeFormat::ND, dtype, false);
        residentTiling.SetCType(matmul_tiling::TPosition::GM, matmul_tiling::CubeFormat::ND,
            matmul_tiling::DataType::DT_FLOAT);
        residentTiling.SetShape(128, 1024, k);
        residentTiling.SetOrgShape(128, n, k);
        residentTiling.SetFixSplit(128, 256, 64);
        residentTiling.SetBias(false);
        residentTiling.SetBufferSpace(residentL1Bytes - residentABytes, -1, -1);
        TCubeTiling residentCube{};
        if (residentTiling.GetTiling(residentCube) == 0 && residentCube.baseM == 128
            && residentCube.baseN == 256 && residentCube.baseK == 64) {
            // 固定每次迭代一个基础M/N块，B双缓冲容量与步长一致。
            residentCube.stepM = 1;
            residentCube.stepN = 1;
            residentCube.stepKa = k / 64;
            residentCube.depthA1 = k / 64;
            residentCube.stepKb = 1;
            residentCube.depthB1 = 2;
            params.cube = residentCube;
            residentA = true;
        }
    }

    aclmdlRICaptureStatus captureStatus = ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_NONE;
    aclmdlRI capturedModel = nullptr;
    CheckAcl(aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo(stream, &captureStatus, &capturedModel), "aclmdlRICaptureGetInfo");
    const bool capturing = captureStatus == ACL_MODEL_RI_CAPTURE_STATUS_ACTIVE;
    std::unique_ptr<KernelWorkspace> memory(new KernelWorkspace);
    const size_t scratchTiles = params.n > tileCols ? 2 : 1;
    memory->scratch.Allocate(static_cast<size_t>(params.cores) * scratchTiles
        * tileRows * tileCols * sizeof(float));
    const uint32_t partialStride = splitN ? tileRows : PARTIAL_STRIDE;
    memory->partial.Allocate(static_cast<size_t>(params.batch) * params.rowTiles * parts * partialStride * sizeof(float));
    const size_t workspaceBytes = platform->GetLibApiWorkSpaceSize();
    memory->system.Allocate(workspaceBytes);
    if (!capturing) {
        CheckAcl(aclrtMemset(memory->system.address, workspaceBytes, 0, workspaceBytes), "aclrtMemset");
    }
    auto scratchAddr = (GM_ADDR)memory->scratch.address;
    auto partialAddr = (GM_ADDR)memory->partial.address;
    auto workspaceAddr = (GM_ADDR)memory->system.address;
    if (capturing) {
        // 编译器生成的核内初始化随计算图一起重放，无须同步 Host 清零。
        // 注册成功后由计算图接管内存；run_kernel 返回时不能提前释放。
        CheckAcl(aclmdlRIDestroyRegisterCallback(capturedModel, DestroyCapturedWorkspace, memory.get()),
            "aclmdlRIDestroyRegisterCallback");
        memory.release();
    }
    LaunchWithFallback(x1, x2, scratchAddr, partialAddr, y, workspaceAddr,
        params, stream, a.dtype == 1, transposeX1, transposeX2, shapeKey, splitN, genericFallback, residentA);
    if (!capturing) {
        CheckAcl(aclrtSynchronizeStream(stream), "aclrtSynchronizeStream");
    }
}
